name: Gajševsko jezero
subtitle: akumulacija Gajševci
description:
Vas zanima kje loviti in kako loviti? Kliknite tukaj in preberite brezplačen vodič po jezeru Gajševci.

Gajševsko jezero je naš največji in najbogatejši ribolovni revir ter hkrati najbolj obiskan. V Gajševskem jezeru je veliko rib roparic, predvsem smuča in soma, manj je ščuk, veliko je krapa, saj se v zadnjih letih izredno uspešno drsti. Ogromno je mladic, obenem pa ga tudi vsako leto poribljavamo, prav tako je veliko srebrnega koreslja, ploščiča, rdečeok, navadnega ostriža in zelenik. En del jezera (10 ha) je ribji rezervat in je označen na tablah. Skupna površina jezera znaša 68,00 ha.

index.name: Gajševsko jezero
index.subtitle: akumulacija Gajševci

en.name: The lake Gajševsko jezero
en.subtitle: the reservoir Gajševci
en.description: The lake Gajševsko jezero is our biggest and richest fishing district and also the most visited one. It is home to many predatory fish, mostly to zanders and catfish, a little less to pikes but you can find large quantities of carps here which spawn very succesfully last few years. The number of young fish is huge and we also put in extra quantities every year. You can catch numerous silver carps, common breams, roaches, percoidei or bleaks here. One part of the lake (10 ha) is a fish reservation and is suitably marked. The total surface of the lake is 68 ha.

name: Akumulacija Kozlink
description: Idilično, majhno akumulacijsko jezero, skrito med vinorodnimi griči v Goriških brdih. Odličen revirj za kraparje, ki si želijo pogostih prijemov. Prevladuje gojeni krap, poleg njega pa so prisotni še kleni, štrkavci, tolstolobiki, primorske belice, ter redke ščuke. Po končanem ribolovu, pa se prileže tudi kozarček vrhunskega briškega vina v kakšni briški kleti, ki jih najdete v neposredni bližini...

en.name: The reservoir Kozlink
en.description: A little reservoir, hidden among vines in the hills Goriška brda. The bred carp is king here so the district is heaven for fishermen of carps but you can also find : chub, european chub, silver carp, bleak, pumpkinseed and even some pike. After the fishing has ended a cup of top quality wine from the Goriška region ( called briško vino) in some first class wine cellar nearby will improve your mood....

name: Akumulacijsko jezero v Javorniškem Rovtu
description:
Revir predstavlja umetno jezero, zgrajeno v letu 1901 za potrebe takratnih železarskih obratov. Jezero je smaragdne barve, temperatura vode pa redko preseže 12⁰C. V vodi je moč zaslediti potočno postrv in šarenko.

Jezero se nahaja na koncu ceste v Javorniškem Rovtu ob domu TRILOBIT. Jezero obsega 1 ha vodne površine.

en.name: The reservoir in Javorniški Rovt
en.description:
This district is a reservoir that was built in 1901 for the needs of the ironworks plants of that time. The lake is emerald green, the water temperature rarely exceeds 12 C. You can find brown and rainbow trout in this district.

The lake is situated at the end of the road in Javorniški rovt at the TRILOBIT lodge. The water surface of the lake measures 1 ha.

name: Akumulacijsko jezero Završnica
description:
Jezero, ki je zelo lahko dostopno, je nastalo ob pregradi zajezitve potoka Završnica za eno starejših elektrarn in prvo javno elektrarno v Sloveniji, ki pa ne obratuje več in je voda speljana na HE Moste. V jezeru imajo svoje domovanje potočne postrvi, šarenke in lipani.

Jezero se nahaja ob križišču ceste na Valvazorjev dom in ceste v dolino Završnice. Površnina jezera znaša 3 ha.

en.name: The reservoir Završnica
en.description:
The lake, that has a very easy access , was made by stemming the creek Završnica near the barrier behind one of the older powerplants and the first public power plant in Slovenia - it works no longer and its water has been channelled to the hydropower plant Moste. The lake is home to brown trouts, rainbow trouts and graylings.

The lake can be found at the crossing of the roads to the Valvazorjev dom lodge and to the valley of the Završnica. The water surface of the lake is 3 ha.

name: Bača
subtitle: od iztoka v Podbrdu do izliva
description: Bača se izpod Slatnika in Lajnarja odpravi na dolgo pot proti Idrijci po ozki Baški grapi, kjer jo ves čas spremljata in prečkata cesta in železnica. V Bači pri Modreju se reka Bača pridruži Idrijci. Pot reke Bače je dolga 21,4-kilometra. Prvi trije kilometri Bače so gojitvena voda za soško postrv, preostali del pa ribolovna voda. Zgornji del Bače naseljujejo vse vrste postrvi, razen šarenke, glavači, malo lipana in nekaj belic – mreniči , pisanci in blistavci ter veliko rakov koščakov. V spodnjem delu se pojavi še šarenka, tudi lipanov je več.

index.name: Bača
index.subtitle: od iztoka v Podbrdu do izliva

en.name: The river Bača
en.subtitle: from the outflow of the creek Mačji potok to the dam Kusterlov jez
en.description: The Bača winds through the narrow Baška Grapa valley, from below the mountains of Slatnik and Lajnar towards the Idrijca, all the while accompanied and crossed by the road and railroad. At the village of Bača pri Modreju, the river joins the Idrijca. It covers the distance of 21.4 km. The first three kilometres of the river are breeding waters for the marble trout, while the rest are fishing waters, which are divided into two sections by the dam in Klavže. The upper part is inhabited by all species of trout, save the rainbow trout, as well as Cottus gobio, some grayling and Alburnus a. alborell – Barbus meridionalis caninus, common minnow and Leuciscus souffia muticellus – as well as numerous Austropotamobius torrentium. In the lower part of the river, the rainbow trout is also present, and the grayling is more common.

name: Bazaršček
subtitle: ribnik Volčja Draga
description: Zanimiv manjši ribnik Bazaršček v naselju Volčja Draga je primeren za beličarjenje ali talni ribolov nekaterih krapovskih vrst.

index.name: Bazaršček
index.subtitle: ribnik Volčja Draga

en.name: Bazaršček
en.subtitle: Volčja Draga pond
en.description: The interesting small pond Bazaršček in the settlement of Volčja Draga is suitable for coarse fishing or ground fishing for certain cyprinid fish species.

name: Bela
subtitle: od mostu v Breginju do izliva
description: Bela izvira pod Stolom nad Breginjem in se po 4,7-kilometra dolgi poti pri Podbeli izliva v Nadižo. Njena struga je bila v tridesetih letih tega stoletja skoraj v celoti regulirana in pregrajena z različno visokimi pregradami. Pod njimi so se oblikovali globoki tolmuni, nad njimi pa prodnate plitvine. Prvi kilometer Bele je gojitvena voda, preostalo pa ribolovna voda. Belo naseljujejo vse vrste postrvi, veliko je glavačev in laških koščakov, v spodnjem delu pa najdemo tudi lipana in nekaj belic.

index.name: Bela
index.subtitle: od mostu v Breginju do izliva

en.name: The river Bela
en.subtitle: from the bridge in Breginje to the outflow
en.description: Its source is at the foot of the hill of Stol, above the village of Breginj, and it covers the distance of 4.7 km before entering the Nadiža at the village of Podbela. Its bed was almost completely regulated in the 1930s – it was split up by numerous barriers. Deep pools formed below these barriers, while above them, gravel banks appeared. The first kilometre of the Bela is breeding water, while the rest is open for fishing. The river is inhabited by all species of trout, numerous Cottus gobio and Austropotamobius italicus. In its lower stretches, one can find grayling and some Alburnus a. alborell as well.

name: Bičje s pritoki
subtitle: Od izvira do sotočja z Grosupeljščico
description: Bičje s pritoki je preplet manjših potočkov, večina vodotoka meandrira, zato so na nekaterih mestih odlični tolmuni za lov postrvi, klenov in ostrižev.

index.name: Bičje s pritoki
index.subtitle: Od izvira do sotočja z Grosupeljščico

en.name: The creek Bičje with tributaries
en.subtitle: from the spring to the confluence with the Grosupeljščica
en.description: The creek Bičje with tributaries is an intertwinement of smaller creeks where the waters meander and create some excellent pools to fish for trouts, chubs and perches.

name: Reka Bistra
subtitle: od izvira do izliva v reko Ljubljanico
description: Reki Bistra in Ljubija počasi vijugata po obrobju Ljubljanskega barja vse do izlivov v Ljubljanico. Sta tipično kraškega značaja, s kristalno čisto vodo, ki se počasi pretaka od okljuka do okljuka. Ljubija izvira na Verdu (Vrhnika), medtem ko Bistra izvira v kraju Bistra poleg znamenitega kartuzijskega samostana. Kljub kratki strugi veljata med ribiči za prava skrita bisera. Muharjenje na teh rekah prav gotovo ne spada med lažje, a poterplježljiv ribič bo z nekaj znanja lahko bogato nagrajen. Zaradi same konfiguracije struge imajo ribe odlične pogoje, da zrastejo do trofejnih velikosti. V obeh rekah prevladujejo predvsem lepe potočne postrvi, lipani in redke divje šarenke.

index.name: Reka Bistra
index.subtitle: od izvira do izliva v reko Ljubljanico

en.name: The river Bistra
en.subtitle: from the spring to the outflow into the river Ljubljanica
en.description: The rivers Bistra and Ljubija slowly meander through the outskirts of the Ljubljana Marshes up to their outflow into the Ljubljanica. They are typical karst rivers with crystal clear water which is slowly flowing from bend to bend. The Ljubija springs in Verd (Vrhnika), while the Bistra originates in the city next to the famous Carthusian monastery. Despite the short riverbed the fishermen consider them real hidden jewels. Fly fishing in these rivers is certainly not one of the easier ones; a patient fisherman with some knowledge can be richly rewarded. Due to the configuration of the channel, the fish are in excellent condition to grow to trophy size. The both rivers are dominated by beautiful brown trouts, graylings and rare wild rainbow trouts.

name: Reka Bistrica
subtitle: od izvira do izliva v Sotlo
description: Reka Bistrica je večji del svoje struge vrezala v triasne kamenine, obsežnejši prodni nanosi v strugi pa pričajo o njenem hudourniškem značaju. Slovi po svoji razgibanosti, bistri vodi, in pestrem menjavanju širših in ožjih dolinskih delov. Soteska med Trebčami in Zagajem je tako tesna, da je soteska neprehodna. Strugo večji del obdajajo strma, skalovita in gozdnata pobočja. Pestrost soteske dopolnjuje živa narava. V soteski uspevajo nekatere manj znane in ogrožene rastlinske vrste. Vodotok reke Bistrice pa se ponaša s postrvmi in potočnimi raki.

index.name: Reka Bistrica
index.subtitle: od izvira do izliva v Sotlo

en.name: The river Bistrica
en.subtitle: from the spring to the outflow into the Sotla
en.description: The river Bistrica cut the most of its channel through the triassic rocks and some vast pebble deposits show us its torrential character. It is known by its diversity, clear waters and sudden changes of wider and narrower areas in the valley. The canyon between Trebče and Zagaj is so tight that it is impassable. The channel is surrounded by steep, rocky and wooded areas. But the nature in the canyon is very lively. It is home to some less famous and endangered vegetable species. The basin of the Bistrica is also home to trouts and river crabs.

name: Potok Bistrica
description:
Tipični salmonidni revir, prisotni pa so tudi kleni, pohre, mrene, ki priplavajo v potok iz reke Mirne.

Potok je zelo vodnat, izvira v južnem delu Dolenjskega gričevja. V celotnem toku teče skozi obsežne gozdove in malo naseljeno območje. Le v izlivnem delu od kraja Šentrupert do izliva v Mirno, približno 2 km, se nekoliko umiri, ko priteče na ravnino. V potok se v rednih presledkih vlagajo potočne postrvi, pred leti so bile vložene tudi zlatovčice, ki so se dobro obdržale in se razmnožujejo same.

en.name: The creek Bistrica
en.description:
This district is typically salmonid in character but you can find some chubs, mediterranean barbels or barbels that swimm to the creek from the Mirna.

The creek is very rich in water, it springs in the southern part of the Dolenjsko gričevje hills. Its entire current runs through vast forests and scarcely habitated areas. Only in its last part, approximately 2 km before the outflow into the Mirna, near Šentrupert, it slows down coming to the plane. Brown trouts are being put in in the creek in regular intervals; some years ago even the brook trouts had been put in ; they survived and now reproduce naturally.

name: Potok Bistrica
description: V naselju Log pod Pečkami se dva srednje velika pohorska potoka združita v večji potok Bistrica, ki teče po okoli 3,5 km dolgi dolini in se v naselju Bistrica ob Dravi izliva v reko Dravo. Gre za tretji po velikosti pohorski potok v upravljanju RD Ruše. Naseljen je predvsem s potočno postrvjo, v spodnjem toku pa se najdejo tudi šarenka, klen, klenič in navadni globoček, ki ga ni dovoljeno loviti. Ribolov z dnevno dovolilnico je dovoljen od sotočja dveh krakov potoka v naselju Log do izliva potoka v reko Dravo. Dovoljeno je muharjenje in ribolov z vodno kroglico in uporabo ene umetne muhe.

en.name: Bistrica stream
en.description: In the settlement of Log pod Pečkami, two medium-sized streams from Pohorje merge into the larger Bistrica stream, which flows through a valley about 3.5 km long and flows into the Drava river in the settlement of Bistrica ob Drava. It is the third largest Pohorje stream managed by RD Ruše. It is mainly inhabited by brown trout, but in the lower reaches there are also rainbow trout, chub and gudgeon, which are not allowed to be fished. Fishing with a daily licence is permitted from the confluence of the two branches of the stream in the Log settlement to the outlet of the stream into the Drava River. Fly fishing and fishing with a bubble float and the use of one artificial fly is permitted.

name: Potok Bistrica
subtitle: od mostu na cesti Šmartno-Trije kralji do izliva v Ložnico
description:
Potok Bistrica je značilni vodotok na Pohorju. Izvira jugozahodno od Žigartovega vrha na Pohorju. Ima najmanj dva izvira: enega v okolici Bajgotovega vrha (1161 m) in drugega pod Povšetovim vrhom (1180 m). V srednjem toku teče skozi globoko vrezano sotesko Bistriški vintgar. V soteski so številne brzice ter slap Bistriški Šum, visok okoli 13 m. Potok v spodnjem delu teče skozi Zgornjo Bistrico in Slovensko Bistrico ter se pri naselju Lokanja vas izliva v Ložnico. Dolžina potoka znaša okoli 20 km.

V zgornjem toku je potok hitro tekoč, ima veliko kisika, voda je mehka, rahlo kisla in hladna s temperaturo med 2º in 14º C, kar pomeni odlične pogoje za življenje vseh salmonidnih vrst, od katerih prevladuje potočna postrv.

index.name: Potok Bistrica
index.subtitle: od mostu na cesti Šmartno-Trije kralji do izliva v Ložnico

en.name: The creek Bistrica
en.subtitle: from the bridge on the road Šmartno-Trije kralji to its outflow into the Ložnica
en.description:
The creek Bistrica is typical water of the mountain Pohorje. It springs in the southwest of the mountain Pohorje's peak Žigartov vrh- we are aware of its two springs: the first near the peak Bajgotov vrh (1161m) and the second under the peak Povšetov vrh (1180m). Its middle part runs through deeply cut canyon Bistriški vintgar where the rapids are many and the waterfall Bistriški Šum falls13m down. The creek in is lower part runs through Zgornja Bistrica and Slovenska Bistrica and flows into the Ložnica near the village Lokanja vas. The creek is approximately 20km long.

In its upper part the creek is fast, rich in oxygen, the water is soft, slightly sour and cold-the temperatures vary from 2C to 14C: excellent living conditions for all the salmonid species but brown trout is reigning here.

subtitle: Blaguško 096

name: Bloško
subtitle: Volčje) jezero
description: Površina umetnega jezera znaša 0,8 ha. Bloško jezero je ciprinidnega značaja, ki ga naseljujejo predvsem krapi in je v poletnih mesecih zanimiva točka za kopalce.

index.name: Bloško
index.subtitle: Volčje) jezero

en.name: The lake Bloško
en.subtitle: Volčje) jezero
en.description: The surface of this reservoir is 0,8 ha. The lake Bloško jezero is cyprinid in character and is home mostly to carps. In the summertime it is also very attractive spot for swimmers.

name: Bohinjsko jezero
description: Največje ledeniško jezero v Slovenji ponuja zanimiv ribolov jezerskih postrvi, jezerskih zlatovčic, potočnih postrvi, klenov in menkov. V jezeru živijo tudi nekatere druge ribje vrste, zanimive za športni ribolov.

en.name: The lake Bohinjsko jezero
en.description: The largest glacial lake in Slovenia offers great fishing of lake trout, lake char, brown trout, chubs and burbots. There are also some other fish species in the lake, interesting for sports fishing.

name: Potok Bolska
subtitle: od starega mostu v Ločici pri Vranskem do izliva v Savinjo
description: Bolska - pritok Savinje, kjer je dovoljeno muhariti in vijačiti na salmonide, kakor sta šarenka in potočna postrv. Poleg salmonidov v potoku lahko beličarimo še na ciprinide kot so: klen, podust, platnica in izredno borbene mrene. Potok naseljuje tudi zavarovani blistavec.

index.name: Potok Bolska
index.subtitle: od starega mostu v Ločici pri Vranskem do izliva v Savinjo

en.name: The creek Bolska
en.subtitle: from the old bridge in Ločica near Vransko to its outflow into the Savinja
en.description: The Bolska is the tributary of the Savinja where you can fly fish and spin fish for salmonids like rainbow and brown trouts. You can also float fish for cyprinids like chubs, common nases, Danube roaches and extremely feisty barbels. The creek is also home to protected souffia.

name: Reka Božna
description: Ribji stalež je predvsem salmoniden in to potočna postrv in lipan.

en.name: Božna
en.description: The fish stock is mainly salmonids, namely brown trout and grayling.

name: Braslovško jezero
subtitle: Jezero Braslovče
description: Vas zanima kje loviti? Katere vabe so najbolj uspešne? Kako pristopiti do jezera? Kliknite tukaj in preberite brezplačen vodič po Braslovškem jezeru.Braslovško jezero upravlja RD Šempeter. Zajema 4 ha vodne površine v kateri so naseljeni številnimi krapi, amurji, babuške, rdečeoke, zelenike in ploščiči. Roparice pa predstavljajo ščuke in smuči.

index.name: Braslovško jezero
index.subtitle: Jezero Braslovče

en.name: The lake Braslovče
en.description: The lake Braslovče is managed by the RD Šempeter. It spreads on 4ha of the water surface and is home to many carps, grass carps, gibel carps, common roaches, bleaks and common breams. Predatory fish are represented by pikes and zanders. It is allowed to fish for cyprinids and for predatory fish.

name: Reka Bregana
subtitle: Od vasi Grdanjci do mejnega prehoda Slovenska vas
description: Mejna reka iz Gorjancev. Iz Slovenske strani je dostopna do Breganskega sela. Po hrvaški strani je ob strugi speljana asfaltirana cesta. V sami reki prebivajo krasne potočne postrvi.

index.name: Reka Bregana
index.subtitle: Od vasi Grdanjci do mejnega prehoda Slovenska vas

en.name: The river Bregana
en.subtitle: from the village of Grdanjci to the border checkpoint Slovenska vas
en.description: The border river from the hills Gorjanci. You can access it on the road through Bregansko selo- from the Slovenian side of the border. From the Croatian side there is an asphalted local road that follows the channel. The river is home to many beautiful brown trouts.

name: Potok Cerkniščica
description: Potok je predvsem v svojem zgornjem toku neokrnjen in zelo blizu prvobitnemu stanju in ga naseljujejo predvsem potočne postrvi. Zaradi zaraščenosti je muharjenje sicer izredno zahtevno, vendar pa pristne potočnice s svojo lepoto in borbenostjo nedvomno zadovoljijo vse, ki iščejo neokrnjen mir skritih senčnih tolmunov v neokrnjeni naravi predvsem srednjega in zgornjega toka Cerkniščice. V primeru, da uživate v raziskovanju neokrnjenih, težje dostopnih kotičkov in skritih tolmunov, v katerih še vedno najdemo potomce avtohtonih potočnih postrvi, vas vabimo, da ga obiščete.

en.name: The creek Cerkniščica
en.description: The creek is mostly in its upper part intact and very close to the primordial condition and inhabited mainly by brown trout. Due to the grass overgrowth fly fishing is extremely challenging, but genuine brown trouts with their beauty and fighting spirit can undoubtedly satisfy those fishermen looking for untouched peace of hidden, shady pools in unspoilt nature- mainly in middle and upper part of the Cerkniščica. Do visit us if you enjoy exploring unspoilt places that are harder to access and hidden pools where we can still find the descendants of the indigenous brown trouts.

name: Cerkniško jezero
subtitle: od izvira Stržena do okljuka v »Ključih«
description: Svetovno znano presihajoče jezero med Slivnico in Javorniki je odličen revir za ribolov ščuk, linjev, klenov, krapov in nekaterih drugih rib.

index.name: Cerkniško jezero
index.subtitle: od izvira Stržena do okljuka v »Ključih«
index.clubName: Ribiška družina Zavod za ribištvo Slovenije

en.name: Lake Cerknica
en.subtitle: from the spring of the tributary Stržen to the meander "V Ključih"
en.description: The world-famous intermittent lake between Slivnica and Javorniki is an excellent fishing area for pike, tench, chub, carp and some other fish.

name: Cerkniško jezero - zahodni del
description: Športno - ribolovni revir presihajoče Cerkniško jezero obsega zahodni predel jezera in je ciprinidnega značaja. Površina revirja znaša 837 ha, ki se seveda z vodostajem zaradi polnjenja in presihanja jezera spreminja. V obdobju nizkega vodostaja obsega revir le ribnik za Rešetom površine 9 ha. Cerkniško jezero naseljujejo predvsem kapitalne ščuke, kleni, linji in krapi. V zadnjem času je zelo popularno tudi muharjenje na ogromne rdečeperke in previdne ostriže, ki lahko dosežejo zavidljivo velikost vse tja do 50 centimetrov. Za ribolov na Cerkniškem jezeru brez čolna je idealen vodostaj pod 200 cm.

en.name: The lake Cerkniško jezero-western part
en.description: The sports-fishing district of the drying up lake Cerkniško jezero consists of the western part of the lake and is cyprinid in character. Fishing area is 837 ha but it varies due to drying up and filling up of the lake. When the water levels are low, you can only fish on the pond behind Rešeto-an area of 9 ha. The lake Cerkniško jezero is home mostly to some first class pikes, chubs, tenches and carps. Fly fishing for huge common rudds and cautious perches has been very popular lately ; these fish can grow up to 50cm here. An ideal water level to fish on the lake Cerkniško jezero without a boat is below 200cm.

name: Črno jezero
description:
Črno jezero na Pohorju je jezero umetnega nastanka (zajezitev vode, ki je zagotavljala splavlanje hlodovine v dolino). Na dnu tega jezera so se leta in leta nabirali organski odpadki odmrlih rastlin in živali ter sčasoma ustvarili debelo plast mulja, ki je temne, tako rekoč črne barve. Jezero je zato na pogled, kot bi bilo polno črnila, čeprav je voda kristalno čista. Izgled jezera je zredno podoben barjem, ki jih najdemo na Finskem.

Jezero naseljuje le endemska vrsta potočne postrvi, črne barve z izrazito rdečimi pikami in leži v popolni divjini, zaradi česar je dostop mogoč le peš, po Slovenski planinski poti, približno 15-20 min od parkirišča.

en.name: The lake Črno jezero
en.description:
The lake Črno jezero in the mountain Pohorje is a reservoir (retainment of water previously used to bring the wood logs into the valley). The organic waste of dead plants and animals gathered on the bottom of this lake for years and eventually created a thick layer of dark, almost black ,silt. That is the reason that on your first look the lake looks full of ink despite the fact that the water is crystal clear. The lake itself looks remarkably similar to the bogs found in Finland.

The lake is home only to one endemic subspecie of brown trout -black with prominent red dots. The lake is situated in complete wilderness and you can access it only on foot- following the Slovenian mountain trail, approximately 15-20 min from the parking place.

description: Revir je namenjen ljubiteljem beličarjenja. V gramoznici prevladujejo krap, srebrni koreselj, ploščič, androga in zelenika.

name: Ribnik v Dobravski Krnici
description: Umetno jezero, ki je natalo kot posledica melioracij reke Vipave. Napaja se z vodo iz reke Vipave. Globina vode je do 3m. Ribnik je obkrožen z drevjem ki nudijo prijetno senco, urejeno je tudi parkirišče in piknik klopi. Vodo naseljujejo krapi, linji, štrkavci, grbe, podusti, zelenike, mazenice, sončni ostriži.

en.name: The pond in Dobravska krnica
en.description: A reservoir that was made due to land improvements around the river Vipava .The reservoir's waters come directly from the Vipava itself. The pond is up to 3m deep. The pond is surrounded with trees which offer very pleasant shadowvs, the parking lot has been provided for and even some picnic benches can be found. The waters are home to carps, tenches, European chubs, italian barbels, common nases, bleaks, South European roaches and pumpkinseed sunfish.

name: Dobrunjščica

en.name: Dobrunjščica
en.description: The lovely little spring creek Dobrunjščica is a small fishing district of the RD Vevče, where you can catch brown trout.

name: Dolska mlinščica
subtitle: od zajetja pri Ihanu do izliva v Savo
description: Dolska mlinščica je mešani revir, ki se začne od zajetja iz reke Kamniške Bistrice v Ihanu in se izliva v reko Savo v Dolskem. Gre za manjši, pretežno zaraščen potok, ki je zanimiv za ribolov pri bolj izkušenih ribičih, ki radi lovijo klena na sir ali češnjo. Izjemoma je mogoče ujeti tudi kakšno postrv na manjšo blestivko (št. 2 ali 3). Občasno se lahko ujame tudi kakšen večji primerek ščuke ali druge plenilke, ki prihaja na drst v Mlinščico iz Save.

en.name: The creek Dolska Mlinščica
en.subtitle: from the reservoir in Ihan to the outflow into the Sava
en.description: Dolska Mlinscica is a small river, which starts from the reservoir from the Kamniška Bistrica river in Ihan and flows into the Sava River in Dolsko. It is a small, mostly overgrown brook, which is interesting for more experienced fishermen who like to fish on a cheese or cherry. Exceptionally, it is possible to catch a trout on a small metal lure (No. 2 or 3). Occasionally, a large specimen of pike or another predator, which comes to spawn in Mlinščica from the Sava River, can also be caught.

name: Levi breg akumulacijskega jezera Drava Völkermarkt
subtitle: Drau Völkermarkter Stausee linksufrig
description: Revir občine Völkermarkt se nahaja na levem bregu akumulacije Völkermarkt in obsega skupno dolžino 12.440 m. Voda se razteza od Draubrücke 3 km navzdol v smeri Tainach in za jezom v smeri Lavamünd do izliva Lorenzibaches (prvi potok na levem bregu). Ribiški gostje, ki preživljajo počitnice v občini Völkermarkt in imajo svoje dovoljenje za goste, prejmejo popust za ribolovno dovolilnico (razen na letne in uradne gostujoče ribolovne dovolilnice). Karte za ribolov so na razpolago skozi vse leto v turističnem uradu Stadtgemeinde Völkermarkt in na uradih, ki jih izdajajo od aprila do oktobra vsako leto. Letne karte za ribolov so na voljo samo v turističnem uradu občine Völkermarkt (omejeno število sezonskih kart).

en.name: Left bank of the Völkermarkt reservoir
en.subtitle: Drau river
en.description: The fishing district of the municipality Völkermarkt is located on the left bank of the Völkermarkter reservoir and covers a total length of 12,440 m. The fish water extends from the Draubrücke 3 km upriver in the direction of Tainach and after the dam in the direction of Lavamünd to the mouth of the Lorenzibaches (first stream on the left bank). Fishing guests who spend their holidays in the municipality of Völkermarkt and have their guest registration card, receive a discount on the fishing licence (except annual and official guest fishing licences). Fishing licences are available year-round at the Tourist Office of Stadtgemeinde Völkermarkt and at the issuing offices from April to October each year. Annual fishery licences are only available in the tourist office of the municipality Völkermarkt (limited number of season licences).

name: Drau Völkermarkter Stausee rechtsufrig
description: Das Fischereirevier Nr. 20 liegt rechtsufrig des Völkermarkter Stausees und umfasst eine Gesamtlänge von 6.100 m. Das Fischwasser erstreckt sich von der Draubrücke in Seidendorf flussabwärts bis zum Merwitschfelsen in St. Lorenzen. Vorwiegend Karpfenangler haben in diesem Revier besonders gute Vorraussetzungen. Fische bis über 29 kg wurden hier bereits gefangen. Es gibt ausreichend viele Uferplätze – 4 direkte Zufahrten ans Wasser – Slipmöglichkeiten und Parkmöglichkeiten. Fischerkarten sind ganzjährig bei der Familie Hribernig erhältlich, sowie an den Ausgabestellen von März bis November jeden Jahres.

name: Reka Drava
subtitle: Trbonjsko jezero, od državne meje z Avstrijo do HE Vuzenica
description:
Koroška ribiška družina upravlja na reki Dravi z dvema revirjema. Revir Drava I sega od državne meje z Avstrijo pa do HE Dravograd. Revir Drava II pa od HE Dravograd pa do HE Vuzenica. Nad HE Dravograd je tudi črneški zaliv, v katerem se obeta dober ulov krapov, ploščičev, rdečeok, podusti. Zelo dober pa je tudi lov ščuke, smuča in soma. Prav v Črneškem zalivu je bila ulovljena najtežja ščuka v Sloveniji.

Pod HE Dravograd v revirju Drava II pa so predvsem ob sotočju Meže in Drave primerna mesta za lov ploščičev, podusti in mren. Neredko pa se ujame tudi kakšna ščuka. Vrata in Gortina so primerna mesta za uspešen lov ploščičev, krapov, mren, klenov, drobiža … So pa ta tudi odlična lovna mesta za ščuko, smuča in soma. Tako je že kar nekaj »profesoric« bilo ujetih v tem delu revirja. Zelo zanimiv del revirja pa je tudi Trbonjsko jezero, v katerem se nahajajo krapi, ploščiči, podusti, drobiž, pa tudi ščuke in somi so zelo pogosti. V obeh revirjih so dovoljene vabe kot so modni, črvi, kruh, koruza in umetne vabe za lov roparic. V času varstvene dobe ščuke je prepovedano vijačenje! Prav tako je prepovedan ribolov na živo ali mrtvo ribo!

en.name: The river Drava
en.subtitle: from the state border with Austria to the hydropower plant Vuzenica
en.description:
The Koroška ribiška družina manages two districts on the river Drava. The district Drava I extends from the state border with Austria to the hydropower plant Dravograd, the district Drava II extends from the hydropower plant Dravograd to the hydropower plant Vuzenica. In the vicinity of hydropower plant Dravograd there is the Črneče bay, where you can fish for carps, tenches, common breams, roaches, common nases. It can provide even the good catch of pike, zander or catfish. Right here, in the Črneče bay the heaviest pike in Slovenia has been caught.

Under the hydropower plant Dravograd, in the district Drava and especially in confluence of the Meža and the Drava you can find very appropriate places to fish for common breams, common nases and barbels. It is not even rare for some pike to get caught, too. Boštjan, Vrata and Gortina are your places to fish for common breams, carps, barbels, chubs, small fish...successfully. But those places are even great for fishing of pike, zander or catfish. Some of "the big fish" got caught here, in this part of the district. The most fascinating part of the district is the lake Trbonjsko jezero where you can find carps, common breams, common nases, small fish, but even pikes and catfish are not rare. The allowed baits in both districts are worms, bread, corn and artificial baits for the fishing of predatory fish. In the conservation period of the pike jigging is forbidden! And it is also forbidden to catch live or dead fish!

name: Reka Drava
subtitle: od jezu v Markovcih do državne meje s Hrvaško, spodnja stara struga
description:
To je stara struga reke Drave, po kateri teče cca 15 m3 vode na sekundo. Po treh kilometrih se vanjo izliva še reka Dravinja, katere pretok vode se zelo spreminja - v sušnem obdobju komaj še teče, drugače pa precej dopolni količino vode v stari strugi reke Drave-spodnji del. Površina revirja je cca 26 ha.

Dolžina revirja je cca 10 km. Je pretežno plitva struga, saj je globina vode redkokje večja od 1,5 m. V spodnjem delu se končuje na meji s Hrvaško, zato je tukaj potrebno obvezno imeti osebne dokumente, saj lahko mimogrede zaidete na Hrvaško stran meje in vas lahko njihova obmejna policija odpelje. Načini ribolova so omejeni na talni ribolov in beličarjenje s plovcem.

en.name: The river Drava
en.subtitle: from the dam in Markovci to the state border with Croatia; lower old channel
en.description:
This district is an old channel of the river Drava and it is flowing approximately 15m3/s. After three kilometres the river Dravinja flows into it and its waterflow is always changing - in the times of drought it is barely running but otherwise it fills the quantity levels of water in the Drava's old channel-lower part- nicely. The total surface of the district is around 26ha.

The district is approximately 10km long. The channel is mostly shallow; the depth rarely goes over 1,5m. In the lower edge the district borders with Croatia so it is mandatory to have your identification papers on you as it can happen that you wander on the Croatian part of the border unintentionally and its border police can take you away. You can only ground fish or float fish here.

name: Reka Drava
subtitle: od HE Ožbalt do HE Fala
description: Revir poteka 100 m od HE Ožbalt do 100 m pred HE Fala. V njem teče zmerno hitro tekoča reka z globino od 2 do 7 m. Naseljena je večinoma s podustjo, kleni, mrenami, somi, ščukami in seveda z manjšimi ribami. Primerna je za vse vrste ribolova: lov s plovcem, vijačenje, muharjenje in talni ribolov. Za različne načine ribolova so na voljo različne ribolovne dovolilnice. Ob nakupu posebne dovolilnice je dovoljen tudi nočni ribolov.

en.subtitle: from the hydropower plant Ožbalt to the hydropower plant Fala
en.description: The district spreads 100 m from the power plant Ožbalt to 100 m before the hydropower plant Fala.The waters are slow and approximately from 2 to 7 m deep. It is home to common nases,chubs, carps, catfish and pikes. All types of fishing can be performed here: float fishing, fishing with spoon lures and ground fishing. The fishermen can fish recreationally in accordance with Pravilnik o ribolovnem režimu v ribolovnih vodah ( Policy on fishing regime on the fishing waters ).

name: Reka Drava
subtitle: od HE Fala do HE Mariborski otok
description: Revir obsega akumulacijsko jezero od HE Fala do HE Mariborski otok. Počasi tekoča reka z globino od 2 do 12 m je druga največja zajezitev na reki Dravi. Naseljena je pretežno s podustjo, kleni, krapi, somi, ščukami in smuči. Primerna je za vse vrste ribolova: lov s plovcem, vijačenje, muharjenje in talni ribolov. Za različne načine ribolova so na voljo različne ribolovne dovolilnice. Ob nakupu posebne dovolilnice je dovoljen tudi nočni ribolov.

en.name: The river Drava
en.subtitle: from the hydropower plant Fala to the hydropower plant Mariborski otok
en.description: The district consists of accumulating waters from the hydropower plant Fala to the hydropower plant Mariborski otok. The waters are slow and this is the second biggest impoundment on the river Drva. It is home to common nases,chubs, carps, catfish and pikes. All types of fishing can be performed here: float fishing, fishing with spoon lures and ground fishing. The fishermen can fish recreationally in accordance with Pravilnik o ribolovnem režimu v ribolovnih vodah ( Policy on fishing regime on the fishing waters ).

name: Reka Drava
subtitle: Od Mariborskega otoka do jezu v Melju
description: Gre za počasi tekočo vodo od Koblerjevega zaliva do jezu v Melju. V tem revirju je veliko velikih somov, velikih mren, pogost pa je klen. Ribolovna mesta so ob relativno strmi brežinah. Globina vode je od 3 m pa vse do 7 m. Hitrost vode niha od stoječe, počasi tekoče do hitro tekoče, kar pogojujejo Dravske elektrarne s svojim režimom obratovanja.

index.name: Reka Drava

en.name: The river Drava
en.subtitle: from Mariborski otok to the dam in Melje
en.description:
The water in this district runs slowly all the way from the Kobler's bay to the dam in Melje. You can find numerous large catfish, large barbels and chub is also not hard to find. The places for fishing are on the relatively steep banks. The water's depth varies from 3 to 7 meters. The water's velocity also fluctuates from still, slow to fast, depending on working regime of the power plants on the Drava.

The district is situated in the urban part of the city of Maribor, there are walking paths along the river, the parking places are in the public parking lots or in front of Mariborski otok.

name: Reka Drava
subtitle: Od mostu za Malečnik do Šmartinskega broda
description: Ta revir je struga reke Drave in po njem se pretaka Drava v zagotovljenem biološkem minimumu. Ribolovna mesta so lahko dostopna, v neposredni bližini lovnih mest so številni parkirni prostori, le v predelu pod Mostom v Dupleku je potrebno na lovno mesto peš, ker je začetek krajinskega parka. To je voda v kateri dominirajo ciprinidi, najdejo se pa tudi salmonidi in roparji. Ribolovni revir krasi bujna vegetacija ob sami strugi, ki pa ni moteča za ribiča in številne ptice, med njimi tudi ribojede.

en.name: The river Drava
en.subtitle: from the bridge in Malečnik to the cable ferry
en.description:
This district is the Drava's channel and the Drava runs through it in guaranteed biological minimum. Places to fish have an easy access, numerous parking lots are in direct proximity of the fishing places - with the exception of the area under the bridge in Duplek, where you have to go on foot due to beginning of the landscape park.

These waters are dominated by cyprinids but you can also find some salmonids or predatory fish here. The fishing district is rich in vegetation near the channel but it doesn't disturb the fishermen and numerous birds - many of them fish-eating ones.

name: Reka Drava
subtitle: od Šmartinskega broda do sotočja z odvodnim kanalom SD 1, zgornja stara Drava
description:
Ta revir poteka po stari strugi reke Drave, po kateri je reka Drava tekla pred izgradnjo hidroelektrarne SD1. Z izgradnjo te, je preko jezu v Melju teklo le toliko vode, da je bil dosežen biološki minimum, kar je sedaj nekoliko povečano. Večji del struge je plitek, saj je globina vode do 1 m, z zjemo večjih globin, ki so ostale še od takrat, ko je reka Drava tekla neukročena po naravni rečni strugi.

Dostop do vode je zaradi vedno večje zaraščenosti v večini možen le peš, razen določenih predelov, kamor se je možno pripeljati z avtom. Potrebno pa je biti vedno pozoren, kaj se dogaja z nivojem vode, saj pri morebitnem naglem spustu vode preko jezu v Melju voda zelo hitro naraste in zalije nekatere nizko ležeče predele ob strugi Drave.

en.name: The river Drava
en.subtitle: from the cable ferry to the confluence with the drain SD 1, upper old Drava
en.description:
This district runs along the old channel of the river Drava - where the Drava used to run before the hydropower plant SD 1 was built. When it was built only enough water ran through the dam in Melje to sustain the environmental flow but now it increased a little. The most part of the channel is shallow (water is only up to 1 m deep) but there are some deeper places- the remains of time when the Drava ran untamed through its natural river channel.

Access to water is possible mostly on foot due to growing river vegetation but there are some places that can be reahed by car. You always need to pay attention to water levels, because if there is a sudden flow increase in the dam in Melje the water rises quickly and floods some lower areas along the Drava's channel.

name: Ptujsko jezero
subtitle: reka Drava od sotočja stare struge in kanala SD1 do jezu v Markovcih
description:
Nastalo je ob gradnji HE SD2. Površina revirja je 420 ha. Na jezeru je možno čolnarjenje ter opazovanje ptic, katerih je zaradi velikosti jezera prisotno veliko število preko celega leta. Jezero je razen v osrednjem delu, kjer poteka struga reke Drave, na nekaterih delih precej zamuljeno.

V jezeru prevladujejo krapi in ploščiči, v zadnjem času pa je vedno bolj prisotna ogrica. Od roparic je najbolj prisoten som, ki vedno bolj obvladuje življenski prostor rib v Ptujskem jezeru.

en.name: The lake Ptujsko jezero
en.subtitle: the river Drava from the confluence of the old channel and the drain of the SD 1 to the dam in Markovci
en.description: The lake was made when the hydropower plant SD 2 was built. The total surface of the district is 420ha. Boating and bird watching are always a possibility here -. due to largness of the lake the number of birds is high and constant throughout the year.The lake is pretty muddy in some parts-except in the middle where the Drava's channel runs through it.

name: Reka Dravinja
subtitle: od sotočja s Srednjo Dravinjo do mostu v Ločah
description:
Dravinja je reka na Štajerskem. Izvira na Pohorju, bolj natančno jugozahodno od Rogle na nadmorski višini okrog 1200 m. Njen najpomembnejši pritok je Polskava. Pomembnejši kraji, mimo katerih teče Dravinja, so Zreče, Slovenske Konjice, Poljčane, Makole, Majšperk, Ptujska Gora ter Videm.

V zgornjem toku ima reka velik strmec ter čisto vodo, bogato z ribami v katerem je mogoče muharjenje za potočnimi postrvmi.

en.name: The river Dravinja
en.subtitle: from the confluence with the Srednja Dravinja to the bridge in Loče
en.description:
The Dravinja is a river in region Štajerska. It springs in the mountain Pohorje, more accurately southwest from the resort Rogla in altitude of approximately 1200m. Its most important tributary is the Polskava. The Dravinja flows past Zreče, Slovenske Konjice, Poljčane, Makole, Majšperk, Ptujska Gora and Videm.

In its upper part the river is pretty steep but the waters are clear, rich in fish and ideal for fly fishing of brown trouts.

name: Reka Dravinja
subtitle: od mostu v Ločah do mostu v Makolah
description:
Dravinja je reka na Štajerskem. Izvira na Pohorju, bolj natančno jugozahodno od Rogle na nadmorski višini okrog 1200 m. Njen najpomembnejši pritok je Polskava. Pomembnejši kraji, mimo katerih teče Dravinja, so Zreče, Slovenske Konjice, Poljčane, Makole, Majšperk, Ptujska Gora ter Videm.

V zgornjem toku ima reka velik strmec ter čisto vodo, bogato z ribami. V njenem spodnjem delu pa je možen lov na ciprinide in roparice s tehniko muharjenja, vijačenja, talnega ribolova ali ribolova s plovcem. Ščuka se zadržuje predvsem v spodnjem delu revirja.

en.name: The Dravinja
en.subtitle: from the bridge in Loče to the bridge in Makole
en.description:
The Dravinja is a river in region Štajerska. It springs in the mountain Pohorje, more accurately southwest from the resort Rogla in altitude of approximately 1200m. Its most important tributary is the Polskava. The Dravinja flows past Zreče, Slovenske Konjice, Poljčane, Makole, Majšperk, Ptujska Gora and Videm.

In its upper part the river is pretty steep but the waters are clear and rich in fish. In its lower part you can fish for cyprinids and predatory fish: fly fishing, spin fishing, ground fishing or float fishing. The pikes tend to live in the lower part of the district.

description: Mešani revir ponuja zanimiv športni ribolov krapovcev in plenilk, upoštevajoč varstvene dobe, skozi celo leto.

name: Reka Dravinja
subtitle: od mostu v Doleni do Izliva v Dravo
description: Reka Dravinja je manjša reka, ki ob deževjih močno naraste in poplavi okolico. Takrat je ribolov nemogoč. Pri normalnem vodostaju pa je ob Dravinji polno kotičkov, kjer si lahko privoščite ribolov ob opazovanju lepe narave na obrobju Haloz. Ob reki Dravinji so privatna kmetijska zemljišča, zato vas bo zmotil ob opazovanju narave kakšen traktor, drugače pa boste lahko uživali ob ribolovu. Ne bo pa odveč, če boste imeli seboj kakšno pršilo proti komarjem.

index.name: Reka Dravinja
index.subtitle: od mostu v Doleni do Izliva v Dravo

en.name: The river Dravinja
en.subtitle: from the bridge in Dolena to the outflow into the Drava
en.description: The river Dravinja is a smaller river which rises very high when the rains are hard, floods the surroundings and also makes the fishing then impossible.But when its watercourse is normal there are many small places to be discovered - where you can fish and admire the beauty of the nature in Haloze simultaneously. There are many agricultural lands along the river Dravinja so you mustn't be surprised if a tractor disturbs your observing of nature but otherwise you will enjoy your fishing. And it wouldn't do you any harm if you carry some insect repellent with you.

name: Reka Dreta
subtitle: od izvira do sotočja s Savinjo v Nazarju
description: Revir Dreta, s katerim upravlja RD Mozirje se začne na izviru Drete pod Črnivcem in se konča na sotočju s Savinjo v vasi Nazarje. Dolg je 22 km. Povprečna globina Drete je med 0,5 in 1,0 m, razen v tolmunih in pod jezovi. Dno je lapornato ali pokrito z gramoznimi nanosi apnenca. V revirju se brzice izmenjujejo z mirnejšimi odseki reke. Reka je široka od 10 do 20 m. Povprečni pretok znaša 4 m3/s, povprečna temperatura je 5 st.C. Od izvira do vasi Kropa je Dreta razmeroma ozka in hitro tekoča. Od Krope do sotočja s Savinjo pa se razširi in ustvarja številne tolmune z brzicami, ki se prepletajo z mirnejšimi odseki reke. Revir nudi odlične pogoje za muharjenje, vendar zahteva izkušenega muharja, saj so brežine gosto poraščene z obrečno vegetacijo. Prisotne so vse vrste salmonidov (potočna postrv, lipan, šarenka, sulec) in nekatere ciprinidne vrste (mrena, klen).

index.name: Reka Dreta
index.subtitle: od izvira do sotočja s Savinjo v Nazarju

en.name: The river Dreta
en.subtitle: from the spring to the confluence with the Savinja in Nazarje
en.description: The district Dreta, which is managed by RD Mozirje starts at the Dreta's spring under the Črnivec and ends at the confluence with the Savinja in the village Nazarje. The district is 22 km long. The average depth of the Dreta is between 0,5 and 1,0 m except in pools and below dams. The bottom is marl or covered with gravel limestone. The current of water changes in this district; the rapid parts are followed by still waters. The river is 10 to 20 m wide. The average flowrate is 4m3/s, the average temperature is 5C. From the spring to the village Kropa is the Dreta very narrow and fast. After Kropa it widens until it reaches the Savinja and makes numerous pools with rapids that interlace with still waters. The district has excellent conditions for fly fishing, but the fishermen must be experienced because the banks are covered with river vegetation. You can find all the salmonid species here ( brown trout, grayling, rainbow trout and huchen) as well as some cyprinids ( barbel, chub).

name: Drtijščica 2
subtitle: od mlina pod Dolom do mostu v Soteski
description: Potok Drtijščica 2 je mešani revir, ki se začne od mlina pod Dolom do mostu v Soteski (pred Moravčami). Gre za manjši pretežno zaraščen potok, ki je zanimiv za ribolov pri bolj izkušenih ribičih, ki radi lovijo klena na sir ali češnjo. Izjemoma je mogoče ujeti tudi kakšno postrv na manjšo blestivko (št. 2 ali 3).

index.name: Drtijščica 2
index.subtitle: od mlina pod Dolom do mostu v Soteski

en.name: The creek Drtijščica 2
en.subtitle: from the mill under Dol to the bridge in Soteska
en.description: Drtijščica 2 stream is a mixed district, starting from a mill below Dol to the bridge in Soteska (before Moravče). It is a small predominantly overgrown brook, which is interesting for more experienced fishermen who like to fish on a cheese or cherry. Exceptionally, it is possible to catch a trout on a small metal lure (No. 2 or 3).

name: Drtijščica 3
subtitle: od mostu v soteski do izliva v Radomljo, brez GJ
description: Potok Drtijščica 3 je ciprinidni revir, ki se začne od mostu v Soteski ter izliva v Gradiško jezero (meander), nato je loven od izpustnega kanala za jezom Gradiškega jezera pa do izliva v potok Radomlja (v Trnjavi pri Lukovici). Gre za manjši, pretežno z grmovjem zaraščen potok, ki je zanimiv za ribolov pri bolj izkušenih ribičih, ki radi lovijo predvsem klena in ribji drobiž.

index.name: Drtijščica 3
index.subtitle: od mostu v soteski do izliva v Radomljo, brez GJ

en.name: The creek Drtijščica 3
en.subtitle: from the bridge in Soteska to the outflow into the Radomlja
en.description: Drtijščica 3 stream is a cyprinid district starting from the bridge in the Soteska and flowing into the Gradiško jezero (meander), then it is fishable from the drainage channel from the dam of the Gradiško lake to the estuary in the stream Radomlje (in Trnjava pri Lukovici). It is a small, predominantly overgrown creek, which is interesting for more experienced fishermen who love mainly chub and small fish.

name: Fischereirevier Stürzenbecher Neudenstein
description: Območje 10 se razteza v akumulacijskem jezeru Draustau Edling na levem bregu od meje Völkermarkt do meje Rakollach, pri črpalki. Poleg plenilk, npr. ščuke, smuča, soma in tako naprej, je ta voda znana kot koroški raj za ribolov ploščičev. Visoka vsebnost hranil in obrežna območja, vključno s stranskimi vodami, zagotavljajo optimalen življenjski prostor za številne ciprinide, kot so krap, linj, rdečeperka, rdečeoka, koreselj in druge. Izjemno bodo uživali ribiči, ki prisegajo na match tehniko, pa tudi kraparji ne bodo razočarani. Poleg tega je zelo dobra tudi populacija smučev. Sredi revirja je naravni rezervat z mnogimi otoki, jezovi in zalivi. Seveda je tam ribolov prepovedan. Zaradi tega, ker je območje eno najširših predelov v rezervoarju Völkermarkt, je tam veliko mest s počasnimi vodnimi tokovi.

en.name: Fischereirevier Stürzenbecher Neudenstein
en.description: The area 10 stretches in the reservoir Draustau Edling on the left bank from the Völkermarkter border to the border Rakollach, pumping station. In addition to predators, e.g. pike, zander, catfish and so on, this water is known as the Carinthian bream region. The high nutrient supply and the riparian areas including side waters also provide an optimal habitat for the cyprinids such as carp, tench, roach, rudd, gull, crucian carp and other carp-like fish. For matchfisher this area with the bream as leadfish is a paradise and carp anglers will also not be disappointed. Furthermore, zander fishermen will enjoy the very good zander stock. In the middle of the district there is a nature reserve with many islands, dams and bays. Of course, fishing is prohibited here. Due to the fact that this area is one of the widest areas of the Völkermarkter reservoir, there are many spots with slow currents.

name: Potok Globovnica
description: Potok Globovnica se izliva v jezero Radehova, kamor ribe tudi migrirajo. Potok Globovnica je naseljen s kapitalnimi primerki soma, krapa, amura, ščuke, smuča, ploščiča, androge, rdečooke, zelenike ter drobiža.

en.name: The creek Globovnica
en.description: The creek Globovnica flows into the lake Radehova and the fish migrate there on the regular basis. It is home to some first class specimens of catfish, carp, grass carp, pike, zander, common bream, silver bream, common roach, bleak and smallfish.

name: Potok Gračnica
description:
Salmonidni revir, ki poteka po kanjonu reke Gračnice, ki je izredno bogata z divjimi potočnimi postrvmi. V Gračnici so lovili že grofje Celjski pred več stoletji.

Gračnico lahko uvrstimo med bolj ohranjene vode vzhodne Slovenije. Njena pot se prične na nadmorski višini 460m in poteka po približno 20km dolgi strugi ter se izlije v reko Savinjo pri Rimskih Toplicah.

Na začetku je potok reguliran, nižje po toku pa oblikuje lepe meandre. Zaradi ravnine je v tem delu potok počasnega toka. Pot potok nadaljuje po čudoviti in raznoliki soteski Grohotje, kjer je tudi hitrost toka velika, po strugi pa ga ovirajo skale. V tem delu lahko občudujete tudi mali (Počerenski slap) in veliki (Slap pod Marofom) slap.

Potok se nato razširi v strugo, ki v določenih delih dosega širino tudi do 10m. V tem delu boste opazili številne pragove. Na Gračnici so ustvarjeni tudi trije jezovi, in sicer visoki jez v Jurkloštru, ki sega v višino 4m ter dva manjša v Brodnicah in Zagračnici.

en.name: The creek Gračnica
en.description:
The district is salmonid and spreads through the canyon of the creek Gračnica which is extremely rich in wild brown trouts. Even the counts of Celje had fished here centuries ago.

The creek Gračnica can be listed among better preserved waters in eastern Slovenia. Its journey begins on 460 m altitude and runs in approximately 20km long channel to the outflow into the Savinja near Rimske toplice.

The creek is regulated at the beginning and when you go downstream it creates beautiful meandres. Due to flat land the creek's current is slow. Its journey continues through the wonderful and varied chine Grohotje where the creek runs faster and rocks obstruct the channel. You can admire two waterfalls here: the little one (Počerenski slap) and the big one (Slap pod Marofom).

After that the creek widens into the channel that is occassionally even 10 m wide. You can notice numerous thresholds here. Three dams have been made on the Gračnica : the tall one in Jurklošter (4m) and smaller ones in Brodnice and Zagračnica.

name: Gradaščica
description: Gradaščica je voda v kateri so naseljene ciprinidne in salmonidne ribje populacije med katerimi pa Sulec zavzema lep delež.

en.name: Gradaščica
en.description: Gradaščica is a water inhabited by cyprinid and salmonid fish populations; among them the huchen occupies a fine share.

en.name: The gravel pit Gradišče-right, at the lodge
The gravel pit Gradišče skrajno desno

name: Gradiško jezero
description: Gradiško jezero je zadrževalnik visokih voda, ki je nastal leta 2004. Danes je prijeten revir za ribolov krapovcev, belic in roparic. Dostop je iz smeri Domžale proti Blagovici. V Lukovici zavijete desno in se peljete po nadvozu čez avtocesto. Ko prečkate potok Radomlja, zavijete levo in se peljete do vrha (kraj Gradišče). Na vrhu zavijete zopet desno in potem prvi odcep levo. Po ca. 1 km asfaltne ceste boste prispeli na plato parkirišča Gradiškega jezera.

en.name: The lake Gradiško jezero
en.description: Gradiško lake is a high water reservoir, which was created in 2004. Today, it is a pleasant district for carp fishing, fishing for white fish and predators. Access is from the direction of Domžale to Blagovica. Turn right into Lukovica and drive over the highway. When you cross the Radomlje stream, turn left and head to the top (village Gradišče). At the top turn right and then turn left. After 1 km of asphalt road you will arrive on the plateau of the parking lot of the Gradiško lake.

name: Gramoznica Babinci
description: Gramoznica Babinci obsega 13 ha vodne površine z največjo globino 30 m. Je gramoznica kjer še vedno kopljejo gramoz, zato je včasih voda malo bolj motna, vendar to bistveno ne vpliva na sam ribolov. V to gramoznico vsako leto vlagamo krape (najmanj 1000 kg) in merske smuče do 100 komadov.

en.name: The gravel pit Babinci
en.description: The gravel pit Babinci consists of 13 ha of the water surface and reaches the depth of 30 m. The gravel is still being excavated here so the waters are murky sometimes but it doesn't affect the fishing itself. The carps (at least 1000 kg of them) and zanders with a minimum length (up to 100 pieces) are being put in in this gravel pit every year.

en.name: The gravel pit Bakovci-near the playground
The gravel pit Banuta - in the woods

name: Gramoznica Boreci
description: Gramoznica je med manjšimi revirji v našem ribiškem okolišu, vendar je bogata z ribjim življem. Naseljujejo jo somi, ščuke in smuči, veliko je krapov, prav tako je bogata z srebrnim koresljem in ploščiči ter rdečeokami.

en.name: The gravel pit Boreci
en.description: This gravel pit is one of smaller districts in our fishing environment but it is very rich in fish life. It is home mostly to catfish, pikes and zanders, you can find large quantities of carps here as well as silver carps, common breams and roaches.

name: Gramoznica Boršt
description:
Do gramoznice Boršt lahko na medkrajevni cesti Krška vas – Cerklje ob Krki zavijemo namesto na Boršt (levo) na desno in se peljemo mimo oz. skozi cestno bazo, kjer nato na naši levi zagledamo gramoznico. Na tem delu je dostop z avtom do gramoznice.

Trenutno se v gramoznici nahajajo predvsem krap, amur, som, ščuka in smuč.

en.name: The gravel pit Boršt
en.description:
You can access the gravel pit Boršt from the local road Krška vas-Cerklje ob Krki- you turn right (even if Boršt is on the left), drive through the road base and then you'll see the gravel pit on your left - you can drive directly to it.

The gravel pit is currently home to cyprinid species like chub, carp, bleak and to some predatory fish as well.

name: Gramoznica Bunčani
description: Gramoznica Bunčani je eden naših manjših revirjev, saj je njena površina 4 ha. To je revir, ki ga obiskujejo bolj domačini in bližnji ribiči. Naseljujejo jo krapi, ščuke, kleni, rdečeoke, navadni ostriž, linj, rdečeperke in zelenike.

en.name: The gravel pit Bunčani
en.description: The gravel pit Bunčani is one of the smaller districts because it measures 4 ha only. This district is visited mainly by the local or nearby fishermen. It is home to carps, pikes, chubs, roaches, percoidei, tenches, common rudds and bleaks.

name: Gramoznica Duplek
description: Gramoznica Duplek leži v krajinskem parku, zato ima urejeno parkirališče ob vhodu v gramoznico. V njej živijo veliki somi, krapi, mnogo je ploščičev in rdečeok, pa tudi kakšen srebrni koreselj (babuška) in amur se najdeta v njej.

en.name: The gravel pit Duplek
en.description:
The gravel pit Duplek is situated in the landscape park and therefore the parking places are at the entrance to the gravel pit. It is home to some large catfish, carps, there is a plenty of common breams and roaches and even some crucian carp ( gibel carp ) or grass carp find themselves here.

The gravel pit Duplek is an old gravel pit and that is the main reason for its wealth in fish life, it is easy to access and is remote to the traffic.

index.subtitle: Belovič

en.subtitle: Belovič

name: Gramoznica Krapje
description: Gramoznica Krapje je revir, kjer še poteka eksploatacija gramoza, zato jo ribiči ne obiskujejo tako pogosto kot druge revirje v Ljutomerskem ribiškem okolišu. V gramoznici so ščuke, smuči in somi, prav tako je naseljena s krapi, srebrnim koresljem, rdečeoko, ploščičem, navadnim ostrižem, zeleniko.

en.name: The gravel pit Krapje
en.description: The gravel is still being excavated in this gravel pit and the fishermen don't visit it as often as other districts in Ljutomer's fishing environment. This gravel pit is home to pikes, zanders and catfish and you can also find many carps, silver carps, roaches, common breams, percoidei and bleaks here.

en.name: The gravel pit Krog - the large one

description: Ribolov je dovoljen po celotni površini zgornje in srednje gramoznice

name: Gramoznica Razkrižje
description: Revir gramoznica Razkrižje je eden manjših v našem ribiškem okolišu. Gramoznico obiskujejo predvsem domači ribiči. Gramoznica je površine 2,00 ha, naseljujejo jo ščuke, krapi, ploščiči, rdečeoke, navadni ostriži in rdečeperke. Gramoznico najdete ob poti od Razkrižja proti Srednji Bistrici (na desni strani ceste).

en.name: The gravel pit Razkrižje
en.description: The gravel pit Razkrižje is one of the smallest districts in our fishing environment. It is visited mostly by local fishermen. It is 2 ha big and is home to pikes, carps, common breams,roaches, percoidei and common rudds. You can find this gravel pit on the road from Razkrižje to Srednja Bistrica ( on the right side of the road).

en.description: od Tešanovci do -

name: Gramoznica Tržec
description:
Ribolovni revir Gramoznica Tržec se nahaja v gramozni jami med vasmi Videm, Tržec in Lancova vas. Vodna površina tega revirja je cca 8.5 ha.

Gramoznica Tržec je revir, ki je namenjen predvsem za izvajanje ribolova na kapitalno ribo na način ujemi & izpusti. Vsako leto vanj vložimo nekaj manjših krapov, ploščičev in ribjega drobiža ter neprestanoma stremimo k vlaganju kapitalnih rib. Gramoznica Tržec je t.i. odprta voda, kjer lahko ribarijo naši člani brez nakupa dnevne ribolovne dovolilnice. Za red v in ob vodi skrbijo upravljalci tega revirja, ki so istočasno tudi ribiški čuvaji.

en.name: The gravel pit Tržec
en.description:
The fishing district Gramoznica Tržec is situated in the gravel pit between the villages Videm, Tržec and Lancova vas.The total water surface of this district is approximately 8,5ha.

The gravel pit Tržec is a district that is particularly meant for the fishing of first class fish specimens in catch&release style. Some smaller carps, common breams and smallfish are being put in every year but we strive to put in some first class specimens as well. The gravel pit Tržec is so called "open" water where our members fish without buying the daily ticket. The managers of this district make sure everything is in order and work as fishing wards as well.

name: Gezove jame
subtitle: Golnik, Siget, Mala jama
description: Revir sestavljajo 4 gramoznice, režim ribolova je označen na tablah. Velika gramoznica z imenom Golnik je namenjena predvsem kraparjem s tehniko lova talni ribolov, v ta namen so tudi urejena ribolovna mesta. Gramoznica z imenom Siget je namenjena predvsem ljubiteljem ribolova s tehniko beličarjenja. Ribolov dovoljen z dvema ribiškima palicama. Mala športna jama je namenjena tekmovanjem.

index.name: Gezove jame
index.subtitle: Golnik, Siget, Mala jama

en.name: The gravel pits Gezove jame
en.subtitle: Golnik, Siget, Mala jama
en.description: The district consists of 4 gravel pits and the fishing regime is marked on boards. The big gravel pit Golnik is meant for fishing of carps using ground fishing technique and the fishing places are arranged accordingly. The gravel pit Siget is meant for fishermen who love to float fish. The fishing is allowed with 2 rods. The little sports cave is meant for competitions.

name: Potok Grosupeljščica
subtitle: Od Laznikovega mlina do mostu pri mlinu pri Boštanju
description: Skozi Grosuplje teče potok Grosupeljščica, ki ima od leta 1963 regulirano strugo. Potok priteče iz severnega obrobja Grosupeljske kotline. Potok je odličen za lov postrvi in klenov.

index.name: Potok Grosupeljščica
index.subtitle: Od Laznikovega mlina do mostu pri mlinu pri Boštanju

en.name: The creek Grosupeljščica
en.subtitle: from the mill Laznik to the bridge near the mill in Boštanj
en.description: The creek Grosupeljščica runs through the city of Grosuplje. Its channel has been regulated since 1963.The creek flows from the northern edges of the basin Grosuplje. It is an excellent place to fish for trouts and chubs.

name: Potok Hinja
description: Potok Hinja izvira v dveh krakih izpod hribov v okolici Šentjanža na Dolenjskem. Kraka se združita pri vasi Koludrje, tok se nadaljuje skozi kraj Krmelj in se nato izlije v reko Mirno pri vasi Tržišče. Hinja je salmonidna voda, v njej živijo predvsem potočne postrvi, v vodo zaide iz Mirne tudi klen. Je precej vodnata s številnimi tolmuni. Razen odseka skozi kraj Krmelj, kjer je regulirana, je povsem ohranila svojo naravno podobo. V delu skozi naselje Krmelj od betonskega cestnega mostu in gorvodno do konca regulacije je v dolžini cca 400 m rezervat, kjer je ribolov prepovedan. Voda je lahko dostopna, ob njej poteka lokalna cesta Tržišče - Krmelj - Šentjanž.

en.name: The creek Hinja
en.description: The creek Hinja springs in two canals below the hills near Šentjanž na Dolenjskem. The canals join into one near the village Koludrje, the current runs through Krmelj and then flows into the Mirna near the village Tržišče.The Hinja's waters are salmonid and are home to mostly brown trouts but some chubs can lose their way in it, coming from the Mirna. It is rich in water with numerous pools. Apart from the area near Krmelj where its waters are regulated, the Hinja kept its natural image. The area through Krmelj - from the concrete road bridge upstream to the end of regulation, approximately 400 m - is a reservation where fishing is forbidden. The waters are easily accessible due to local road Tržišče - Krmelj - Šentjanž that runs along them.

name: Homška mlinščica
subtitle: od zajetja v Homcu do izliva v Kamniško Bistrico
description: Homška mlinščica je salmonidni revir, ki se začne od zajetja iz Kamniške Bistrice v Homcu in vse do izliva v Kamniško Bistrico. Je manjša struga, ki teče delno v urbaniziranem naselju delno v poraščenem naravnem okolju. Večji primerki šarenk in lipanov se za ribolov skrivajo v naseljenih predelih, ki so za ribiča večinoma dostopni le po strugi. Pretežno je možno vijačiti na manjšo blestivko (št. 2 ali št. 3).

index.name: Homška mlinščica
index.subtitle: od zajetja v Homcu do izliva v Kamniško Bistrico

en.name: The creek Homska Mlinščica
en.subtitle: from the reservoir in Homec to the outflow into the Kamniška Bistrica
en.description: The Homska Mlinscica is a salmonid district starting from the Kamniška Bistrica in the Homec and to the mouth of Kamniška Bistrica. It is a small river that runs partially in a urbanized settlement partly in a sprawling natural environment. Large specimens of rainbow trout and grayling are hidden in some inhabited areas, which are mostly accessible to fishermen only via the riverbed. It can be mainly fished with a small metal lures (No. 2 or No. 3).

name: Horjulka
description: Reka ima mešano ciprinidno in salmonidno favno, vendar pa se lahko pohvali z lepo Ščuko.

en.name: Horjulka
en.description: The river has a mixed cyprinid and salmonid fauna, but boasts also with a beautiful pike.

name: Reka Hubelj
description: Revir Hubelj poteka od mosta avtoceste do sotočja z Vipavo.

en.name: The river Hubelj
en.description: The district Hubelj expands from the bridge on highway to the confluence with the Vipava.

name: Reka Hudinja
subtitle: od Krekove žage nad Vitanjem do naravne stopnje v Fužinah
description:
Reka Hudinja je dolga 32 kilometrov in ima na začetku zelo hiter tok, ki se kasneje v osrčju mesta Celje umiri.

V zgornjem delu reke najdemo ameriško in potočno postrv in naj kot zanimivost omenimo, da v delu reke nad Vitanjem najdemo samo divje potočne postrvi, kajti iz nižjega dela struge, zaradi visokih pregrad druga riba ne more. V tem delu je reka tudi izredno čista, saj je izredno bogata z nevretenčarji in jo lahko nad Vitanjem celo pijemo.

V mirnejšem delu struge, v delu od Višnje vasi do izliva v Voglajno, pa nam reka ponudi tudi ribolov podusti, klena, platnice in mrene s tehniko ribolova na plovec.

index.subtitle: od Krekove žage nad Vitanjem do naravne stopnje v Fužinah

en.name: The river Hudinja
en.subtitle: from the road bridge to Polže to the mill above Vitanje
en.description:
The river Hudinja is 32km long and its current is very fast at the beginning but it slows down when it reaches the middle of Celje.

In the upper course of the river we can find american (rainbow) and brown trout. Let's mention an interesting fact, too: in the part of the river above Vitanje you can only find wild brown trouts because other fish cannot croos high barriers due to lower part of the channel.

The river is very clean here because it is rich in invertebrates and in its part above Vitanje can even be drunk .

In the stiller part of the channel, from Višnja vas to the outflow into the Voglajna, the river offers us the float fishing for common nases, chubs, Danube roaches and barbels.

name: Idrijca
subtitle: od mostu v Stopniku do izliva Bače
description: Reka Idrijca ima poudarjen značaj kraške reke z značilno zelenkasto barvo in je ena muharsko najbolj zanimivih rek v Evropi. Idrijca vstopa v Tolminski ribiški okoliš v vasi Stopnik. Do Trebuše teče med bregovi, ki so do vode poraščeni z drevjem, skozi globoke tolmune in preko hitrih brzic in prelivov. Pri Trebuši se tok nekoliko umiri, pojavijo se manjša prodišča. Tolmuni so še vedno globoki in dolgi, posebno na Slapu ob Idrijci, le prelivi in brzice so počasnejši in bolj umirjeni. Pri Bači pri Modreju se ulije v akumulacijsko jezero za HE Doblar in se pri Mostu na Soči zlije s Sočo. Celoten revir Idrijce je dolg 16,2-kilometra in je riboloven. V Idrijci dobimo vse vrste rib, ki jih najdemo v Tolminskem ribiškem okolišu: vse postrvi, tudi velike soške postrvi, lipana, glavača, štrkavce, jate grb, mreničev, blistavcev, pisance in tudi rake koščake.

index.name: Idrijca
index.subtitle: od mostu v Stopniku do izliva Bače

en.name: The river Idrijca
en.subtitle: from the bridge in Stopnik to the outflow of the Bača
en.description: It is a river with a more pronounced karst character and typical greenish colour. Its waters are one of the most attractive flyfishing destinations in Europe. The Idrijca enters the Tolmin fishing district in the village of Stopnik. Until it reaches the village of Trebuša, it runs between heavily forested banks, through deep pools, rapids and straits. At Trebuša, its current slows down and gravel deposits appear. The pools are still long and deep, especially those by the village of Slap ob Idrijci; however, the straits and rapids are slower and gentler. At the village of Bača pri Modreju, it enters the Doblar reservoir and then, at Most na Soči, it flows into the Soča. The entire length of the river - 16.2 km - is open to fishing. All the species of fish found in the Tolmin fishing district can also be found here: all species of trout, even the large marble trout, grayling, Cottus gobio, Adriatic chub, schools of Italian barbel, Barbus meridionalis caninus, Leuciscus souffia muticellus, common minnow and Austropotamobius torrentium.

name: Reka Iščica
subtitle: od izvira do mostu v Hauptmancah
description: Izvirni odsek Iščice, največjega desnega pritoka Ljubljanice, je zanimiv kraški revir za muharjenje postrvi in lipanov.

index.name: Reka Iščica
index.subtitle: od izvira do mostu v Hauptmancah

en.name: The river Iščica
en.subtitle: from the spring to the bridge in Hauptmance

name: Reka Iščica
subtitle: Ižica
description: Vas zanima kje loviti? Katere vabe so najbolj uspešne? Kje pustiti avto? Kliknite tukaj in preberite brezplačen vodič po reki Iščici- RD Barje. Iščica je očarljiva kraška rečica. Ribiči lahko tam v miru ujamejo velike krape, ščuke, lepe platnice in ribji drobiž. Ribe iz Iščice so divje in borbene, zato revir priporočamo najzahtevnejšim ribičem.

index.name: Reka Iščica
index.subtitle: Ižica

en.name: The river Iščica
en.subtitle: Ižica
en.description: The Iščica is an enchanting valley carst river . You can peacefully fish for big carps and pikes, beautiful Danube roaches and small fish. The fish from the Iščica are extremely big, wild and feisty so the district is recommended to the most advanced fishermen.

name: Jezero Črnava
description:
Jezero Črnava se nahaja le nekaj kilometrov od samega mesta Kranj pri vasi Preddvor. Poleg jezera se nahaja tudi hotel Bor in Grad Hrib. Sam kraj nudi obiskovalcem mir, sprehode, izhodišče za planinske ture in različne športne dejavnosti.

V samem jezeru Črnava se nahaja plemenska jata lipana, zato je ribolov na to vrsto v jezeru prepovedan in je potrebno dosledno upoštevati navodila o dovoljenem načinu ribolova.

en.name: The lake Črnava
en.description: The lake Črnava is only a few kilometers away from the city of Kranj, in the little village called Preddvor.You can also find hotel Bor and Hrib castle there. The place offers a lot of peace, long walks, starting points for mountain trips as well as different sport activities.

name: Jezero Jasna
subtitle: Kranjska Gora
description:
Revir predstavlja medsebojno povezani umetni jezeri, ki sta nastali z odvzemon gramoza ob sotočju potokov Velike in Male Pišnice. Izjemno slikovita narava in pogled na Julijske Alpe ter prodnata okolica jezera predstavljajo izjemno dopolnilo ribolovu. V večjem delu sorazmerno hladne vode je moč ujeti potočno postrv ali šarenko, z malo sreče celo lipana.

Jezero Jasna se nahaja v idilični alpski dolini pred začetkom prvih zavojev ceste na Vršič, ki predstavlja najvišji cestni prelaz v Vzhodnih Julijskih Alpah (1611m). Vodna površina jezera znaša 2,2 ha.

index.name: Jezero Jasna
index.subtitle: Kranjska Gora

en.name: The lake Jasna
en.subtitle: Kranjska Gora
en.description:
This district consists of two connected reservoirs that were made by taking away the gravel from the confluence of the creeks Velika and Mala Pišnica. An additional supplement to fishing can be the extremely picturesque nature and the view to the Julijske Alpe mountains as well as the pebbled surroundings of the lake itself. In the most parts of the pretty cold water you can catch brown, rainbow or brook trouts.

The lake Jasna is situated in an idyllic alpine valley just before the first turns of the road to the mountain passage Vršič - the highest road passage in the Eastern Julijske Alpe mountains ( 1611m ). The water surface measures 2,2 ha.

name: Jezero Klivnik
description: Jezero Klivnik leži v osrčju Brkinov pod vasjo Tominje pri Ilirski Bistrici. V dolžino meri tri kilometre. Ribolov je dovoljen čez celotno dolžino jezera razen v drstišču, katero je označeno z opozorilnimi tablami. Jezero navdušuje s čudovito naravo in vam ponuja ulove trofejnih smučev ter vseh vrst postrvi.

en.name: The lake Klivnik
en.description: The lake Klivnik is situated in the heart of the Brkini hills under the village Tominje near Ilirska Bistrica. It is three km long. The fishing is allowed on the entire length of the lake, except in the spawning place, which is suitably marked. The lake inspires you with beautiful nature and offers you the catch of trophy zanders as well as all kinds of trouts.

name: Jezero Mola
description: Jezero Mola se nahaja na obrobju Brkinov pod vasjo Soze pri Ilirski Bistrici. Razteza v dolžini štirih kilometrov. V srcu neokrnjene narave, ki ga obdaja, daleč stran od mestnega trušča ga vsekakor morate obiskati in doživeti. Dodaten čar jezeru prav gotovo daje tudi ribiški dom, ki stoji ob njegovi obali. V gostišču lahko uživate v nadvse okusni kavi ali osvežilni pijači. S terase je čudoviti pogled na jezero Mola. Med vikendi so gostom na voljo tudi različne jedi z žara in enolončnice. V njegovem pritličju je z možnostjo najema urejena večja dvorana z letno kuhinjo, namenjena različnih družabnih dogodkov. Dom ponuja tudi tri sobe z osmimi ležišči, WC, kopalnico, brezplačen WI-FI ter predstavlja enkraten prostor za pogovor ter omogoča čudovit razgled na jezero. Jezero Vam ponuja edinstven in razburljiv ribolov kapitalnih krapov, amurjev, smučev in ščuk. Na jezeru Mola je vzpostavljen tudi kraparski revir na katerem je dovoljen ribolov po načelu Ujemi in Spusti. V ta namen je na kraparski trasi v dolžini dveh kilometrov urejenih petnajst ribolovnih mest, kjer je med izvajanjem ribolova mogoče tudi kampiranje.

en.name: The lake Mola
en.description: The lake Mola is situated on the banks of the Brkini hills under the village Soze near Ilirska Bistrica. It is four km long. In the heart of the unblemished nature that surrounds it, far away from city jungle it calls you to come visit and live it. You will be additionally charmed by fishing lodge that stands on its shore. In the restaurant, you can enjoy delicious coffee or a refreshing drink. From the terrace there is a wonderful view of Lake Mola. During the weekends, guests are also offered a variety of grilled dishes and stews. Or you can rent its ground floor (nicely decorated hall with kitchen) for organization od various social events. The lodge has three rooms with eight beds, three toilets, bathroom, free Wi-Fi and a great hall that is suitable for different activities. The lake offers you the unique and exciting fishing for some first class carps, grass carps, pikes and zanders. On the lake Mola there is also a carp district where we fish only by principle Catch and Release. That's why we arranged 15 fishing spots in the length of 2 km on the carp course. There you can also camp while fishing.

passes.name: Smuč in ščuka (samo ujemi in spusti)

name: Jezero Pristava
description: Jezero Pristava (ujemi in spusti) je bogato z večjimi krapi in amurji (10 kg in več). Dostop je skozi Mengeš. Na glavnem križišču (pri gasilskem domu) v smeri ceste Trzin - Kamnik, zavijete proti cvetličarni, pošti oz. bivši Melodiji Mengeš. Po cesti se peljete do prvega odcepa, kjer zavijete desno in sledite usmerjevalnim tablam za dostop do izdelovalca harmonik Zupan. Ko prečkate manjši most čez Pšato, zavijete levo in sledite asfaltirani cesti proti novemu naselju hiš. Zadnji objekt na tem odseku je skladiščni objekt SCT-ja (sedaj last Petrola). Po 100 m prispete na jezero.

en.name: The lake Pristava
en.description: Lake Pristava (C&R) is rich with larger carp and grass carp (10 kg and more). Access is through Mengeš. At the main intersection (at the fire station) in the direction of the road Trzin - Kamnik, turn towards the flower shop, post office, former Melodija Mengeš. Follow the road to the first branch where you turn right and follow the information signs for access to the producer of the accordion Zupan. When crossing a small bridge over Pšata, turn left and follow the asphalt road towards the new settlement of the houses. The last object on this section is the SCT storage facility (now owned by Petrol). After 100 m you arrive at the lake.

name: Jezero Radehova
description: Jezero Radehova je prijetno jezero za športni ribolov v katerega se steka potok Globovnica. Naseljen je s kapitalnimi primerki soma (tudi preko 60 kg), krapa, amurja, ščuke, smuča, ploščiča, androge, rdečooke, zelenike ter drobiža.

en.name: The lake Radehova
en.description: The lake Radehova is a cozy lake for recreational fishing. The creek Globovnica flows into it. The lake is inhabited with some first class specimens ( some over 60 kg) of catfish, carp, grass carp, pike, zander, common bream, silver bream, common roach, bleak and smallfish.

name: Jezero Sveta Trojica
subtitle: Gradiško jezero
description: V jezero Sveta Trojica ali Gradiškem jezeru se steka potok Velka. Najbolj loven je ravno izliv potoka v jezero, kjer plavajo številni kapitalnimi primerki soma, krapa, amurja, ščuke, smuča, ploščiča, androge, rdečooke, zelenike ter številne jate ribjega drobiža.
