en.subtitle: the lake Gradiško jezero
en.description: The creek Velka flows into the lake Sveta Trojica ( the lake Gradiško jezero). The mouth of the creek is the most ideal place to fish; some first class specimens of catfish, carp, grass carp, pike, zander, common bream, silver bream, common roach, bleak and smallfish swim there.

name: Kamniška Bistrica 2
subtitle: od mostu pod izvirom do mostu v Stranjah
description: Kamniška Bistrica 2 je salmonidni revir, ki se začne pod izvirom - rezervatom v Kamniški Bistrici (od kamnitega mostu) in vse do mostu v Zgornjih Stranjah (pri gostilni Uršič). Gre za matično reko, ki se v modrini pretaka skozi kanjone in postopoma razliva proti Kamniku. Bistrico naseljuje predvsem avtohtona gensko čista potočna postrv in lipan. Zaradi alpskega sveta je potrebno pazljivo priti z muharico do vode, ribo pa po fotografiranju obvezno vrniti nazaj v njeno vodno okolje.

index.name: Kamniška Bistrica 2
index.subtitle: od mostu pod izvirom do mostu v Stranjah

en.name: The river Kamniška Bistrica 2
en.subtitle: from the bridge under the spring to the bridge in Stranje
en.description: Kamniška Bistrica 2 is a salmonid river, which begins under a spring - a reserve in Kamniška Bistrica (from a stone bridge) and all the way to the bridge in Stranje (at the Uršič inn). It is a river that flows through the canyons and gradually goes towards Kamnik. Bistrica is mainly inhabited by a native genetically clean brown trout and grayling. Due to the Alpine world, it is necessary to approach water carefully and the fish should be returned to its environment.

name: Kamniška Bistrica 3
subtitle: od mostu v Zg. Stranjah do jezu pri Homcu in Titanova mlinščica
description: Kamniška Bistrica 3 je salmonidni revir, ki se začne od mostu v Zgornjih Stranjah pa vse do dvoprekatnega jezu v Homcu (meja je na prvem prekatu). Vodotok je ves čas v konstantnem vodostaju. Vsak vodni prag je obogaten s šarenkami in potočnimi postrvmi. Lipana je mogoče najti v počasi tekočih prelivih prodnatega dna.

index.name: Kamniška Bistrica 3
index.subtitle: od mostu v Zg. Stranjah do jezu pri Homcu in Titanova mlinščica

en.name: The river Kamniška Bistrica 3
en.subtitle: from the bridge in Stranje to the dam near Homec
en.description: Kamniška Bistrica 3 is a salmonid river, starting from the bridge in the Upper Stranje to the two-story dam in Homec (the border is on the first chamber). The water has a constant flow. Each water cascade is enriched with rainbow trout and brown trout. Grayling can be found in slowly flowing current.

name: Kamniška Bistrica 4
subtitle: od jezu pri Homcu do izliva v Savo
description: Kamniška Bistrica 4 je mešani revir. Začne se od prvega prekata jezu v Homcu pa vse do izliva v Savo. Zgornji tok je praviloma v nižjem vodostaju, saj odvzameta del vode Radomeljska in Homška mlinščica. Zgornji tok revirja je predvsem lipanski pas (do sotočja z Račo), od tam naprej je zaradi pritoka Rače večja naseljenost šarenke, klena, mrene, podusti in sulca. Za vsakega markiranega sulca, kjer sporočite njegovo serijsko številko, nahajališče in velikost, vam Zavod za ribištvo Slovenije podeli darilo v obliki ribiške majice.

index.name: Kamniška Bistrica 4
index.subtitle: od jezu pri Homcu do izliva v Savo

en.name: The river Kamniška Bistrica 4
en.subtitle: from the dam near Homec to the outflow into the Sava
en.description: Kamniška Bistrica 4 is a mixed district. It starts in the first part of the dam at the Homec dam and flows to the Sava. The upper stretch has lower water levels, as the water is taken away by the Radomeljska and Homska Mlinscica streams. The upper stretch of the river is in the grayling zone (to the confluence of with the Raca river), from there downwards rainbow trout, chub, barbel, nase and huchen are more frequent. Each tagged huchen you see, informs us about the size, location and the serial number. The Fisheries Institute of Slovenia gives you a thank you gift (t-shirt).

name: Kneža
description: Kneža je tipična alpska rečica, ki zbira svoje vode med Voglom in Rodico ter se po ozki dolini, skozi soteske prebija v dolino Bače, ki se ji med Knežo in Klavžami tudi pridruži. Njena pot je dolga 8,3-kilometra. Kneža je ves svoj tok ribolovna voda z vsemi vrstami postrvi razen šarenke, prisoten je tudi glavač.

en.name: The river Kneža
en.subtitle: from the spring to the outflow
en.description: The Kneža is a typical alpine stream, which collects its waters between the mountains of Vogel and Rodica and courses its way down a narrow valley towards the Bača river, which it joins between Kneža and Klavže. It runs for 8.3 km. It is suitable for fishing throughout its course, and inhabited by all species of trout except for rainbow trout. It is also home to Cottus gobio.

name: Reka Kokra
description: Kokra je prava alpska reka, ki izvira na višini med 1100 in 1300m. V Spodnjem Jezerskem se združi z Jezernico, ki priteče iz Planšarskega jezera. Do Preddvora ima Kokra izrazito hudourniški značaj. V spodnjem delu reke, nekako do betonskega jezu pri Oljarici v vasi Britof, žive lipani, potočnice, šarenke in kleni, navzgor od Britofa pa se kleni ne pojavljajo, lipana pa zasledimo do jezu v Preddvoru. Gorvodno vedno bolj prevladuje avtohtona potočnica. Ribolov je dovoljen le z umetno muho brez zalustika ali s stisnjenim zalustnikom z možnostjo uporabe šibre do 5mm in muharjenju primernega indikatorja prijema.

en.name: The river Kokra
en.description:
The Kokra is true alpine river.Its spring is between 1100 and 1300 m altutude. In Spodnje Jezersko it unites with the Jezernica, which flows in from the Planšarsko jezero. Up to Preddvor is the Kokra a wild torrent.

In the lower part of the river, to the concrete bridge at the dam in Oljarica- in the village Britof- live mostly graylings, brown trouts, rainbow trouts and chubs, the chubs cannot be found upstream from Britof but the grayling can be spotted in the dam at Preddvor. The area upstream is mostly home to the indigenous brown trout. The fishing is allowed with barbless artificial fly only-but it is possible to use shot up to 5 mm and a grip indicator that is appropriate for fly fishing.

name: Potok Koretan
subtitle: Karantan, Korentan
description: Potok Koretan izvira ob cesti Hruševje – Orehek. Voda je odlične kakovosti, saj se jo v občini Postojna uporablja kot rezervno zajetje pitne vode. Na njegovi poti se mu pridružijo številni manjši pritoki, ki pa bistveno ne vplivajo na njegovo vodnatost. Potok je hudourniške narave in je v času padavin hitro tekoč in večkrat poplavlja, kar je njegova značilnost po celotnem toku. Kakor hitro naraste, se tudi dokaj hitro vrne nazaj v svojo strugo, ki je naravna in nedotaknjena. Čeprav je potok manjši, v svojih tolmunih in skrivališčih skriva tudi nekaj kilogramov težke potočne postrvi, ki so v dobri kondiciji in čudovitih barv. Zaradi narave in prehodnosti v okolici potoka je ribolov težak predvsem v zgornjem odseku, vendar ko nas nagradi z lepo ribo, je občutek fantastičen. V njegovi okolici opazimo vodomca, kosca in veliko ostalih divjih živali.

index.name: Potok Koretan

en.name: Stream Koretan
en.subtitle: Karantan, Korentan
en.description: The Koretan stream originates along the road Hruševje - Orehek. The water is of excellent quality, it is also used in the municipality of Postojna as a reserve drinking water. A number of smaller tributaries join him on his journey, but they do not significantly affect his wateriness. The stream is of a torrential nature and is rapidly flowing in the time of precipitation and flooding several times, which is its characteristic throughout the stream. As soon as it grows, it also quickly returns back to its streamline, which is natural and intact. Although the creek is smaller, in its pools and hideouts there are also some heavy brown trout that are in good shape and beautiful colors. Due to its nature and its passage in the vicinity of the stream, fishing is difficult primarily in the upper section, but when it rewards us with beautiful fish, the feeling is fantastic. In its surroundings, we see a kingfisher and many other wildlife.

subtitle: od sotočja Žventarske in Hude grape do izliva
description: Koritnica je majhna rečica, ki nastane z združitvijo potokov pod vasjo Rut in se po 4,7-kilometra dolgi poti v vasi Koritnica izliva v Bačo, ki teče po Baški grapi. Bregovi Koritnice so gosto porasli z drevjem, njej tok je hiter, tik nad vasjo Koritnica se strmo spusti v dolino Bače. Koritnico naseljujejo vse postrvi razen šarenke in glavač.

en.description: This is a small river that forms from several streams below the village of Rut and runs for 4.7 km before entering the Bača in the village of Koritnica. Its banks are heavily wooded and its current is very swift. Just above the village of Koritnica, it drops steeply into the Bača valley. It is inhabited by Cottus gobio and all species of trout except for rainbow trout.

description: Kozarica je pritok reke Voglajne. Ribe iz Voglajne redno zahajajo v Kozarico na drst. Glavne vrste rib v Kozarici so: klen, ostriž, pohra, in rdečeoka.

en.description: The creek Kozarica is the Voglajna's tributary. The fish from the Voglajna come here to spawn regularly. You can fish mostly for chubs, perches, Mediterranean barbels and common roaches here.

name: Krimsko jezero
subtitle: Podpeško jezero, Podpeč
description: Vas zanima kje loviti? Katere vabe so najbolj uspešne? Kako pristopiti do jezera? Kliknite tukaj in preberite brezplačen vodič po Krimskem jezeru. V Krimskem (Podpeškem) jezeru lahko ujamete lepe in zdrave krape, ščuke, klene, redkejše linje, ostriže in velike tolstolobike. Jezero je del Krajinskega parka Ljubljansko barje in pravi naravni biser. Ribolov je mogoč tudi pozimi, saj površina jezera le redko zamrzne. Ob jezeru je prijazna gostilna z okusno slovensko hrano.

en.subtitle: Podpeško) jezero
en.description: In the lake Krimsko (Podpeško) jezero (up to 51m deep) you can fish for big and healthy carps, pikes, beautiful chubs, tenches, perches as well as huge silver carps. The lake is part of the landscape park Ljubljansko barje and is a true jewel of nature! You can even fish in the winter time because the lake's surface rarely freezes. There is a cozy inn near the lake serving slovenian food.

name: Reka Krka
subtitle: od jezu HE v Zagradcu do jezu v Soteski
description: Struga reke Krke je sestavljena iz številnih naravnih pragov, ki so obloženi s lehnjakom. Številni tolmuni in kaskade so porasle z zelenim mahom, ki nudijo ribam številna skrivališča. Temperatura vode je razmeroma stabilna, tako da so razmere za življenje rib ves čas optimalne. Spomladi in v zgodnjem poletju je ob rojenju enodnevnic, majskih muh, šašev in prodnic izjemno uspešen lov s suho muho. Najprimernejši čas ribolova je od začetka aprila do konca junija. Aprila, okoli opoldneva, ko vsak dan močnejše pomladansko sonce vzpodbuja rojenje, je pravi čas ribolova s suho muho. Že v toplih aprilskih večerih pa se začne tudi večerni skok, katerega višek je maja in v začetku junija. Skok v toplem večeru traja pozno v noč.

index.name: Reka Krka

en.name: The river Krka
en.subtitle: from the dam of the hydropower plant Zagradec to the dam in Soteska
en.description: The riverbed of the river Krka is composed of many natural thresholds, which are sheated in tufa (a variety of limestone). Many pools and cascades are overgrown with green moss and offer many hiding places for the fish. The water temperature is relatively stable, so that the living conditions for fish are always optimal. In spring and early summer, when the Mayflies, sedges and stoneflies emerge, the fishing with dry flies is extremely successful. The best time for fishing is the beginning of April to the end of June. In April, around noon, when the warm spring sun encourages the swarming of the flies, is the exactly right time for fishing with dry flies. In the warm April evenings the evening rise begins, which then culminates in May and early June. An evening rise on a warm evening lasts late into the night.

name: Reka Krka
subtitle: od jezu v Soteski do Mršeče vasi
description: Osrednji in spodnji del revirja na reki Krki sta bogata z mnogimi ciprinidnimi vrstami, med katerim prevladujejo platnice, kleni, podusti, ščuke in somi. Od Novega mesta do Otočca je z jezov, znamenitih za Krko, v vročih poletnih dneh odličen ribolov platnice ali podusti ter ščuke. Užitek si dodatno lahko popestrimo ob ribolovu s čolna, saj je že sama vožnja z njim po zeleni lepotici pravi užitek. Ob ribolovu ščuke na Krki je mogoče ujeti tudi soma, ki ga pretežno lovimo s talnim ribolovom v poletnih večerih.

index.name: Reka Krka

en.name: The river Krka
en.subtitle: from the dam in Soteska to Mršeča vas
en.description: The central and lower part of the fishing district on the river Krka are rich with many cyprinid species, among which dominate Danube roaches, chubs, common nases, pikes and catfish. From Novo mesto to Otočec the fishing is great from dams-the Krka is famous for them-especially in the hot summer days whether you fish for Danube roaches,common nases or pikes. You can additionally liven up your pleasure if you fish from a boat, since the drive itself on the green beauty is already an event. When fishing for pike on the river Krka it is even possible to catch a catfish, which we mainly ground fish for in the summer evenings.

name: Längsee
description: V lepi pokrajini osrednje Koroške leži sredi zaščitenega območja jezero, veliko približno 75 hektarjev. Nedotaknjene obale z velikimi vodnimi lilijami in pasovi trstičja, kjer še vedno gnezdijo številne redke vrste ptic, pričarajo v Längseeju posebno ribiško izkušnjo na 550 m nadmorske višine. Jezero ima največjo globino približno 21 metrov, dolžina celotne obale je več kot 3,8 km. Vzhodno od jezera je samostan Sv. Georgen, del škofije, v kateri sta izobraževalna ustanova in hotel. Južno od jezera leži slikovit grad Hochosterwitz. Odlična kakovost vode omogoča, da se temperature vode dvignejo do 27 °C. Krape se lahko lovi celo leto. Na grajski plaži lahko v času od maja do oktobra najamete čoln, če je prost in imate pisno dovoljenje.

en.name: Längsee
en.description: In the lovely landscape of Central Carinthia lies in the middle of the protected area a nice lake, approximately 75 hectares large. The pristine shores, with large water lily and reed belts, where many rare species of birds still have their nesting sites, make fishing in the Längsee a special nature experience at 550m above sea level. The lake has a maximum depth of about 21 meters and has a shoreline length of over 3.8 km. East of the Längsee is the St. Georgen Abbey, a part of the Diocese of Gurk, in which an educational building and a hotel are housed. South of the lake lies the picturesque castle Hochosterwitz. The excellent water quality allows water temperatures to rise up to 27 ° C. Carp can be fished all year-round. You are welcome to hire boats at your own risk for the period from May to October in the Castle Bath, as long as there is free space and written permission has been obtained.

en.name: The creek Lipnica
en.description: The creek Lipnica is the Sava's first tributary on the right side after the confluence of the Sava Bohinjka and the Sava Dolinka. It flows into the Sava in the vicinity of the village Ovsiše. The creek accummulates its waters on the northeast slopes of the plateau Jelovica, from which three major creeks flow into the Lipnica.

name: Reka Ljubija
subtitle: od izvira do izliva v reko Ljubljanico
description: Reki Bistra in Ljubija počasi vijugata po obrobju Ljubljanskega barja vse do izlivov v Ljubljanico. Sta tipično kraškega značaja, s kristalno čisto vodo, ki se počasi pretaka od okljuka do okljuka. Ljubija izvira na Verdu (Vrhnika), medtem ko Bistra izvira v kraju Bistra poleg znamenitega kartuzijskega samostana. Kljub kratki strugi veljata med ribiči za prava skrita bisera. Muharjenje na teh rekah prav gotovo ne spada med lažje, a poterplježljiv ribič bo z nekaj znanja lahko bogato nagrajen. Zaradi same konfiguracije struge imajo ribe odlične pogoje, da zrastejo do trofejnih velikosti. V obeh rekah prevladujejo predvsem lepe potočne postrvi, lipani in redke divje šarenke.

en.subtitle: from the spring to the outflow into the river Ljubljanica
en.description: Fly fishing in these rivers is certainly not one of the easier ones; a patient fisherman with some knowledge can be richly rewarded. Due to the configuration of the channel, the fish are in excellent condition to grow to trophy size. The both rivers are dominated by beautiful brown trouts, graylings and rare wild rainbow trouts.

name: Reka Ljubljanica
subtitle: od cestnega mostu v Podpeči do Plečnikovih zapornic na Ambroževem trgu
description: Vas zanima kje loviti? Kakšne vabe so uspešne? Kje pustiti avto? Kliknite tukaj in preberite brezplačen vodič po reki Ljubljanici - RD Barje. Reka Ljubljanica je raj za ribiče! Ob njej uživajo predvsem beličarji in ščukarji, pa tudi ribiči, ki muharijo ciprinide. Rib je veliko, najpogosteje pa ujamemo platnice, rdečeoke, krape, ščuke in velike sulce. Zahtevnejšim ribičem priporočamo uporabo čolna, vendar se zelo lepo lovi kar v središču mesta, v četrti Trnovo, z obrežja, ki ga je zasnoval svetovno znani slovenski arhitekt Jože Plečnik.

index.name: Reka Ljubljanica

en.name: The river Ljubljanica
en.subtitle: from the road bridge in Podpeč to the Plečnik's barriers on the square of Ambrož
en.description: The river Ljubljanica is heaven for fishermen! Mostly for the ones who float fish or fish for pikes but also for the ones who fly fish for cyprinids. There is plenty of fish, the most common to get caught are Danube roaches, roaches, carps, pikes and big huchens. We recommend the use of boats for the advanced fishermen but you can also fish in the middle of the city - in the neighbourhood Trnovo- from the hills that were designed by the world known slovenian architect Jože Plečnik.

name: Ljubljanica 8 + Gruberjev prekop
subtitle: od Plečnikovih zapornic na Ambroževem trgu do Papirnice Vevče; od zapornic na Roški cesti do sotočja z Ljubljanico v Štepanjskemu naselju
description:
Revir poteka dolvodno od Plečnikovih zapornic na Ambroževem trgu (Cukrarna) do jezu pri Papirnici Vevče na Vevčah. Obsega tudi Gruberjev prekop od zapornic na Roški cesti do sotočja z Ljubljanico v Štepanjskemu naselju. Razgiban revir z brzicami, prelivi in globokimi tolmuni ter tudi "mestno zabetonirano" reko.

Ribolov "sredi mesta", kjer lahko ujamete veliko potočno postrv, lipana, sulca ali ščuko, uživate v talnemu ribolovu mrene ali krapa ali pa se pozabavate z beličarjenjem na klena, podust in platnico.

index.name: Ljubljanica 8 + Gruberjev prekop
index.subtitle: od Plečnikovih zapornic na Ambroževem trgu do Papirnice Vevče; od zapornic na Roški cesti do sotočja z Ljubljanico v Štepanjskemu naselju

en.name: Ljubljanica 8 + Gruberjev prekop
en.subtitle: from the Plečnik dam on Ambrožev trg to Papirnica Vevče; from the dam near Roška cesta to the confluence with the Ljubljanica in Štepanjsko naselje
en.description:
The district spreads downstream from the Plečnik's barriers in Ambrož square (so called Cukrarna) to the dam at the paper factory Papirnica Vevče in Vevče. It also covers the Gruber canal from the dam near Roška cesta to the confluence with the Ljubljanica in Štepanjsko naselje. It is dynamic district with rapids, channels and deep pools and even some areas in the city that are engulfed in concrete.

It is fishing in the middle of the city where you can catch big brown trouts, graylings, huchens or pikes, enjoy in ground fishing for barbels or carps or have fun while float fishing for chubs, common nases or Danube roaches.

en.description: This is the lower district where the Ljubljanica leaves the city. The river's channel is wider here with deeper pools and backwaters, followed by shallower canals and pebbled ground. All the fish species living in the Ljubljanica are present here.

name: Potok Lobnica
description: Pohorski potok iz čiste, neokrnjene narave. Potok Lobnica z znanim slapom Šumnik izvira delno iz Črnega jezera na Pohorju. Naseljen je s potočno postrvjo, v spodnjem toku pa tudi s šarenko in lipanom. Dovoljeno je muharjene. Ribolov je z dnevno dovolilnico dovoljen od mostu v naselju Smolnik do izliva v reko Dravo.

en.name: The creek Lobnica
en.description: It is a creek typical for the Pohorje mountain, coming from the clear, unspoilt nature. The Lobnica creek with its famous waterfall Šumnik springs partly from the lake Črno jezero in the Pohorje mountain. It is home to brown trouts but some rainbow trouts and graylings can be found in the lower part. Fly fishing is allowed. Fly fishing is allowed with daily ticket from the bridge in the settlement Smolnik to the outflow into the Drava.

You can fly fish or float fish on this part of the river. You can fly fish for salmonids: brown trouts, rainbow trouts and graylings or cyprinids: barbels, common nases, chubs and Danube roaches. description: Vas zanima kje loviti? Katere muhe so najbolj uspešne? Kje pustiti avto? Kliknite tukaj in preberite brezplačen vodič po potoku Mali graben. Mali graben je manjša reka, ki se blizu središča Ljubljane izliva v Ljubljanico. Ribiči v njem čez leto lovijo lepe klene, mrene, podusti in redkejše lipane, pozimi pa sulce, ki jih je v tolmunih Malega grabna še kar veliko.

index.name: Mali graben
index.subtitle: od jezu na Bokalcih

en.name: Mali graben
en.subtitle: from the dam in Bokalci
en.description: The Mali graben is a small river which flows into the Ljubljanica in the centre of Ljubljana. The fishermen fish for chubs, barbels, trouts and graylings here all year long but the winter time is ideal to fish for huchens and the pools of the Mali graben hide many of them.

name: Reka Mestinjščica
subtitle: od vasi Podplade do izliva v Sotlo
description: Reka Mestnjiščica s svojimi zaraščenimi bregovi nudi odlično kritje za vse ribe, predvsem dobro se počutijo ščuke.

index.name: Reka Mestinjščica
index.subtitle: od vasi Podplade do izliva v Sotlo

en.name: The river Mestinjščica
en.subtitle: from the village Podplat to the outflow into the Sotla
en.description: The river Mestinjščica ,with its vegetation covered banks, offers excellent shelter to all the fish, but the pikes feel extremely welcome here.

name: Reka Meža
subtitle: od izvira do jezu za KD v Mežici
description: Revir Meža 1,2 poteka od izvira do jezu za Kulturnim domom v Mežici. V revirju se nahajata pretežno potočna postrv in lipan. Dovoljene vabe so samo umetna muha ali potezanka.

index.name: Reka Meža
index.subtitle: od izvira do jezu za KD v Mežici

en.name: The river Meža
en.subtitle: from the spring to Mežica
en.description: The districts Meža 1,2 extend from the spring to the dam behind Kulturni dom in Mežica. You can find mostly brown trouts and graylings there. It is allowed to catch three fish, but only one over 50 cm. The catch of graylings is forbidden. You can use only artificial flies or streamers.

name: Reka Meža
subtitle: od mostu pri Domu upokojencev Mežica do vodnega rova na Prevaljah
description: Revir Meža 3 poteka od mostu pri Domu upokojencev v Mežici do vodnega rova na Prevaljah. V revirju se nahajata pretežno potočna postrv in lipan. Dovoljene vabe so samo umetna muha ali potezanka.

index.name: Reka Meža
index.subtitle: od mostu pri Domu upokojencev Mežica do vodnega rova na Prevaljah

en.name: The river Meža
en.subtitle: from Mežica to Prevalje
en.description: The Meža 3 district extends from the dam behind Dom upokojencev in Mežica to water tunnel in Prevalje. In this district you can mostly find brown trouts and graylings. Allowed catch is 3 pieces of trouts, but only one piece over 50 cm. The catch of graylings is forbidden. The allowed baits are only artificial fly or streamer.

name: Reka Meža
subtitle: od vodnega rova na Prevaljah do železniškega mostu v Ravnah
description: Revir Meža 4 poteka od vodnega rova na Prevaljah do betonskega železniške mostu (med Dravogradom in Ravnami), kjer se prične označen trofejni revir. V revirju se nahajajo pretežno potočna postrv, šarenka in lipan. Dovoljene vabe so samo umetna muha ali potezanka.

index.name: Reka Meža
index.subtitle: od vodnega rova na Prevaljah do železniškega mostu v Ravnah

en.name: The river Meža
en.subtitle: from Prevalje to Ravne na Koroškem
en.description: The Meža 4 district extends from water tunnel in Prevalje to concrete railway bridge (between Ravne na Koroškem and Dravograd) and there begins the marked trophy district..You can find mostly brown trouts and graylings in this district. The allowed catch of trouts is 3 pieces but only one over 50 cm. The catch of graylings is forbidden. The allowed baits are only an artificial fly or streamer.

name: Reka Meža
subtitle: Trofejni revir, od železniškega mostu v Ravnah do starega mostu pred sotočjem z Mislinjo
description: V tem revirju velja izključno režim ujemi-izpusti! Namenjen je ribičem, ki si želijo ujeti lepih kapitalnih primerkov rib in jih potem vrniti v reko. V tem revirju je dovoljen ribolov z eno muharico in eno umetno muho, obvezna pa je uporaba trnka brez zalusti oz. s stisnjeno zalustjo. Trofejni revir sega od starega lesenega mostu, to je približno 300m nad sotočjem z reko Mislinjo pa v smeri proti Ravnam do prvega betonskega železniškega mostu čez reko Mežo. V njem se nahajajo lepi primerki lipanov, potočnih postrvi in šarenk.

index.name: Reka Meža
index.subtitle: Trofejni revir, od železniškega mostu v Ravnah do starega mostu pred sotočjem z Mislinjo

en.name: The river Meža
en.subtitle: Trophy district, from Ravne to the place where the Meža flows into the Mislinja
en.description: In this district only catch and release is valid! It is meant for fishermen who are eager to catch beautiful fish and then release them back into the river. It is allowed to fish using only one fly rod and one artificial fly and hooks without barbs are mandatory. This trophy district expands from the old wooden bridge ( approximately 300m up from where the Meža meets the Mislinja, in the direction of Ravne na Koroškem, to the first concrete railway bridge across the Meža). It contains beautiful pieces of graylings, brown trouts and rainbow trouts.

name: Reka Meža
subtitle: komercialni revir, od lesenega mostu pred sotočjem z reko Mislinjo do izliva v Dravo
description: Ta revir ima status mešanega revirja, naseljujejo ga ciprinidi in salmonidi. Namenjen je izključno v komercialne namene. Ribolov je dovoljen samo z eno muharico in eno umetno muho, zaželena je uporaba brezzalustnika oz. trnka s stisnjeno zalustjo. Komercialni revir sega od starega lesenega mostu, to je približno 300 m nad sotočjem z reko Mislinjo pa do izliva v reko Dravo. Skupna dolžina revirja je cca. 2 km. Od salmonidnih vrst sta prisotna avtohtona potočna postrv in lipan. Zaradi komercialnega namena pa se revir dodatno poribljava s približno 800 kg ameriške postrvi. Komercialni revir je bogat z ribami in privablja vedno več muharjev. Neredko se ujamejo lipani med 30 in 45 cm, kar nekaj pa jih je tudi nad 50 cm! V tem delu so tudi lepi primerki podusti, mren in klenov, kar samo dviguje nivo adrenalina pri muharjenju. Dovoljene vabe so samo umetna muha ali potezanka.

index.name: Reka Meža
index.subtitle: komercialni revir, od lesenega mostu pred sotočjem z reko Mislinjo do izliva v Dravo

en.name: The river Meža
en.subtitle: commercial district, from where the Meža meets the Mislinja to the Mislinja's outflow into the Drava
en.description: This district is considered as mixed type so basically it is populated only by cyprinids and salmonids. It is meant for commercial purposes only. The fishing is allowed using only one fly rod and one artificial fly and it is desired to use only hooks without barbs or with barbs pressed. The allowed daily catch is three trouts or one over 50 cm and two smaller ones.This commercial district expands from the old wooden bridge-approximately 300m up from where the Meža meets the Mislinja to the Mislinja's outflow into the Drava. It is approximately 2 km long. From the salmonid family there are indigenous brown trouts and graylings to be found. Due to commercial purpose of the district about 800 kg of american trout has been added. This district is very rich in fish and more fishermen are coming all the time. It is even possible to catch a grayling between 30 and 45 cm, sometimes even over 50 cm! You can also find beautiful common nases, barbel and chubs here and that elevates the fishing adrenalin . The allowed baits are only the artificial fly or streamer.

name: Reka Mirna
subtitle: od cestnega mostu pri žagi v Dolenjem Boštanju do izliva v reko Savo
description: Voda je zelo počasi tekoča, je praktično zaliv reke Save. Izjemno bogata z vsemi ribami in je idealno prebivališče plenilk. Revir je dolg le 600 m. Povsod je lahko dostopen. V vodi živijo najrazličnejše vrste rib, zaradi tega pa so prisotne tudi plenilke, zlasti ščuke.

index.name: Reka Mirna
index.subtitle: od cestnega mostu pri žagi v Dolenjem Boštanju do izliva v reko Savo

en.name: The river Mirna
en.subtitle: from the road bridge at the sawmill in Dolenji Boštanj to the outflow into the Sava
en.description: The waters are running so slow that this is almost a bay of the Sava river. The water is extremely rich in fish species and is an ideal home for predatory fish. The district is only 600 m long and easily accessible everywhere. The waters are home to different fish species even the predatory ones; especially pikes.

name: Reka Mirna
subtitle: od železniškega mostu v kraju Mirna do mostu v zaselku Križišče
description: Reka Mirna v tem delu toka teče pretežno po ravnici Šentruperškega in Mokronoškega polja in ima značilnosti dolinskega toka. Ohranjenih je še veliko meandrov in mrtvic. Bogata je z vsemi ciprinidi (platnica, podust, klen, mrena), pa tudi salmonidi (potočna postrv, šarenka, sulec). Pogosta je ščuka. Dostopnost do revirja je dobra, ob njem poteka deloma regionalna cesta Trebnje - Sevnica in deloma lokalne ceste v okolici kraja Mokronog.

index.name: Reka Mirna
index.subtitle: od železniškega mostu v kraju Mirna do mostu v zaselku Križišče

en.name: The river Mirna
en.subtitle: from the railroad bridge in Mirna to the bridge in the little village Križišče
en.description: The river Mirna in this part runs mostly through the planes of the fields of Šentrupert and Mokronog and has all the characteristics of the valley river. Plenty of meanders and backwaters can be still seen. It is rich in all the cyprinids ( Danube roach, common nase, barbel) as well as in salmonids (brown and rainbow trouts, huchen). Even pikes are not rare. Acces to the district is good because the regional road Trebnje - Sevnica runs along it and also some local roads in the vicinity of Mokronog.

name: Reka Mirna
subtitle: od mostu v zaselku Križišče do izliva potoka Grahovica v Boštanju
description: Reka Mirna v tem odseku spet pridobi značaj dolinske reke, ko se prebija skozi ozko dolino Dolenjskega gričevja na poti k izlivu v Savo. Brzice se izmenjujejo s tolmuni. Pretežno salmonidni revir s prisotnostjo nekaterih ciprinidov (podust, platnica, klen). V ta revir se intenzivno vlagajo potočne postrvi, šarenke, lipani in sulec. Je glavni sulčarski revir v RD Sevnica. Dostop do revirja je vseskozi odličen, ob Mirni poteka regionalna cesta Trebnje - Sevnica.

index.name: Reka Mirna
index.subtitle: od mostu v zaselku Križišče do izliva potoka Grahovica v Boštanju

en.name: The river Mirna
en.subtitle: from the bridge in the little village Križišče to the outflow of the creek Grahovica in Boštanj
en.description: The river Mirna becomes a typical valley river in this area where it runs through the narrow valley of the Dolenjsko gričevje hills on its way to meet the Sava. Rapids follow pools. This district is mostly salmonid in character with some cyprinids present ( common nase, Danube roach, chub). Brown trouts, rainbow trouts, graylings and huchens have been intensively put in in this district. It is the main district for huchens in the RD Sevnica. Access to the district is excellent everywhere because the local road Trebnje- Sevnica runs along the Mirna.

name: Reka Mirna
subtitle: od vasi Moravče do železniškega mostu v kraju Mirna
description:
Neokrnjena narava in odsotnost industrije ter večjih naselij zagotavlja popolno naravnost vodotoka. Številni tolmuni, izmenjujoči se z brzicami in predeli mirnega toka zagotavljajo obilo življenjskega prostora potočni postrvi, šarenki, občasno zaidejo v revir tudi kleni.

Dostop do vode je vseskozi dober, ker poteka po dolini lokalna cesta Mirna - Gabrovka.

index.name: Reka Mirna
index.subtitle: od vasi Moravče do železniškega mostu v kraju Mirna

en.name: The river Mirna
en.subtitle: from the village Moravče pri Gabrovki to the railroad bridge in the city of Mirna
en.description:
Due to the unblemished nature and the lack of industry and bigger settlements this district guarantees a completely natural basin. Numerous pools that are followed with rapids and areas of the calmer current give plenty of living space to brown and rainbow trouts, but also chubs can wander into the district.

Access to water is good everywhere along the local road Mirna - Gabrovka that runs through the valley.

name: Reka Mislinja
subtitle: od izvira do mostu v Šmartnem pri SG
description: Revir Mislinja 1,2 se nahaja od izvira Mislinje do mostu v Šmartnem pri Slovenj Gradcu. V revirju se nahajata pretežno potočna postrv in lipan. Dovoljene vabe so samo umetna muha ali potezanka.

index.name: Reka Mislinja
index.subtitle: od izvira do mostu v Šmartnem pri SG

en.name: The river Mislinja
en.subtitle: from the spring to the bridge in Šmartno near Slovenj Gradec
en.description: The district Mislinja1,2 extends from the spring of the Mislinja to the bridge in Šmartno near Slovenj Gradec. You can find mostly brown trout and grayling in this district. It is allowed to catch three trouts, but only one can be over 50 cm long. The catch of grayling is forbidden. The allowed baits are only artificial fly and streamer.

name: Reka Mislinja
subtitle: od mostu v Šmartnem pri Slovenj Gradcu do mostu v Jederti
description: Celoten revir poteka od mostu v Šmartnem pri Slovenj Gradcu do mostu v Jederti (most glavne ceste čez Mislinjo). V revirju se nahajata pretežno potočna postrv in lipan. Dovoljene vabe so samo umetna muha ali potezanka.

index.name: Reka Mislinja
index.subtitle: od mostu v Šmartnem pri Slovenj Gradcu do mostu v Jederti

en.name: The river Mislinja
en.subtitle: from the bridge in Šmartno near Slovenj Gradec to the bridge in Bukovska vas
en.description:
The whole district extends from the bridge in Šmartno near Slovenj Gradec to the bridge in Jedert ( the bridge across the Mislinja on the main road). Mostly brown trouts and graylings can be found here. The allowed catch is three trouts, but only one over 50 cm. The take of grayling is forbidden. The allowed baits are only artificial fly or streamer.

Special feature of this district is the trophy part which spreads from the dam at Merkur in Slovenj Gradec to the car salon Kajža in Pameče near Slovenj Gradec and you can only fish " catch and release" here.

name: Reka Mislinja
subtitle: od mostu glavne ceste v Jederti do sotočja z reko Mežo
description: Revir Mislinja poteka od mostu glavne ceste v Jederti do sotočja z reko Mežo. V revirju se nahaja pretežno potočna postrv, šarenka in lipan. Dovoljen ulov je 3 kom postrvi od tega je dovoljen uplen samo ene postrvi nad 50 cm. Dovoljene vabe so samo umetna muha ali potezanka.

index.name: Reka Mislinja
index.subtitle: od mostu glavne ceste v Jederti do sotočja z reko Mežo

en.name: The river Mislinja
en.subtitle: from the bridge in Bukovska vas to the outflow into the Meža
en.description: The district Mislinja extends from the bridge across the main road in Jedert to confluence with the Meža. You can mostly find brown trouts, rainbow trouts and graylings here. It is allowed to catch three trouts but only one over 50 cm. The catch of grayling is forbidden. The allowed baits are only artificial fly or streamer.

name: Morje Slovenije
subtitle: morski ribolov

club.name: Upravljavec Zveza za športni ribolov na morju Slovenije (ZŠRMS)

description:
Slovenska obala meri nekaj preko 40 kilometrov in sodi med najkrajše evropske obale. Meji na Italijo in Hrvaško, oblivajo jo pa Koprski, Strunjanski ter Piranski zaliv, delijo si jo pa občine Koper, Izola in Piran. Struktura dna je ponekod poraščena in skalnata ali prekrita z muljem. Najglobja točka slovenskega morja sega 37m, v povprečju pa je globina okoli 17m.

V mesecih, kjer prevladuje sončno in toplo vreme, v vodi prevladujejo riboni, skuše, orade ipd., v ostalih mesecih pa nas vabijo lignji, sipe, ipd...

Slovenska obmorska mesta vas bodo brez izjeme navdušila, saj boste izredno uživali v starih mestnih jedrih ter v pogledu na slovenske Alpe naravnost iz morja!

V kolikor nimamo letne ribolovne dovolilnice, za rekreativni ribolov iz čolna na morju potrebujemo dnevno ali tedensko dovolilnico. Pri rekreativnem ribolovu na morju iz obale pa dovolilnice NE potrebujemo.

Na čolnu lahko lovimo na vleko ali v mirovanju, z dvema palicama oz. vrvicama s po največ tremi navezanimi trnki ali ježki.

POZOR: Kupljene dovolilnice preko portala www.ribiskekarte.si za rekreativni ribolov na morju NI potrebno tiskati. S seboj imejte unikatno kodo, ki je vidna na kupljeni dovolilnici (RKxxxxxxxxx) ter vaš veljaven osebni dokument. Ribolovno dovolilnico je potrebno kupiti VSAJ ENO URO pred izvajanjem ribolovom, v nasprotnem primeru ribolovna dovolilnica ni veljavna!

Tedenska ribolovna dovolilnica za rekreacijski ribolov na morju

en.name: The sea of Slovenia
en.subtitle: sea fishing
en.description:
The Slovene coast is only approximately 40km long and it belongs to the shortest European coasts. It borders on Italy and Croatia and is bathed by the bays of Koper, Strunjan and Piran. Its territory is divided between municipalities of Koper, Izola and Piran. The structure of the bottom is somewhere covered with sea vegetation and a bit rocky or just covered in silt. The deepest point of the Slovene sea is 37m but the depth in average is around 17m.

During the months when the weather is sunny and warm the sea is reigned by common pandoras, Atlantic mackerels, gilt-head breams and others, the rest of the year belongs to sqid, cuttlefish and similar species....

The Slovene seaside towns will impress you with no exception because you can enjoy the old town centres very much and have the view on the Slovene Alps directly from the sea !

If you don't possess the annual fishing licence for recreational boat angling on the sea you need a daily or weekly one. If you fish from the shoreline you DO NOT need the ticket.

You can tow from the boat or just fish from it when it is standing still, with two rods or lines with up to three hooks or squid jigs tied.

NOTE: If you buy the tickets via website www.ribiskekarte.si for the sea fishing you DO NOT HAVE TO PRINT the ticket. You only have to have the unique code that is visible on the bought ticket (RKxxxxxxxx) and valid ID on you. The fishing ticket must be bought AT LEAST ONE HOUR before the fishing otherwise it is not valid!

name: Potok Mostnica
description: Slikovit potok je primeren za ribiške sladokusce, ki obožujejo muharjenje potočnih postrvi, šarenk in lipanov v majhnih in neokrnjenih revirjih. Obisk je omejen na 5 ribičev na dan!

en.name: The creek Mostnica
en.description: The picturesque brook is suitable for anglers who adore fly fishing for brown trout, rainbow trout and grayling in small and unspoilt districts. The visit is limited to 5 anglers per day!

name: Potok Motnišnica
subtitle: Od zgornjega mostu v Motniku
description: Motnišnica je 5km dolg potok, ki se izliva Bolsko. Gre za muharski revir, kjer se boste naužili neokrnjene narave in lovili šarenke ter potočne postrvi.

index.name: Potok Motnišnica
index.subtitle: Od zgornjega mostu v Motniku

en.name: The river Motnišnica
en.subtitle: from the upper bridge in Motnik
en.description: The Motnišnica, a 5km long tributary of the Bolska, offers you extremely beautiful brown and rainbow trouts. The creek is situated in very quiet surroundings and is a little heaven for recreational fishermen.

subtitle: mrtvica Valek
description: Nekdanji rokav reke Sotle s katerim skrbno gospodari RD Sotla.

en.subtitle: the backwater Valek
en.description: This former channel of the river Sotla is being managed by the RD Sotla very carefully.

name: Mrtvica Cola
description:
V mrtvici Cola plavajo krapi, somi, ščuke, zelenike, rdečeperke in amuri. Žal pa je ta čez poletno-jesensko obdobje preraščen z debelo plastjo plavajočih rastlin, tako da je ribolov v tem času onemogočen.

Dostop je pod avtocesto Ljubljana-Obrežje, zavijemo dol pri motokros progi Prilipe.

en.name: The backwater Cola
en.description:
The backwater Cola is home to carps, catfish, pikes, bleaks, common rudds and grass carps. Unfortunately, the backwater is covered with thick layer of floating plants during summer and autumn so fishing is not possible.

You can access this backater by leaving the highway Ljubljana-Obrežje at the motocross road Prilipe.

description: Mrtvica Hoken pri Ceršaku je bivši rokav reke Mure, kjer prebivajo razne ribe od somov do platnic.

en.name: The backwater Hokn
en.description: The backwater Hokn near Ceršak is a former channel of the river Mura and is home to various fish, from catfish to Danube roaches.

name: Mrtvica Ribče - Sava
subtitle: od Ribč do Save
description: V tesni dolini Save leži pri Kresnicah mrtvica Ribče, kjer boste lepo lovili krape, linje, nekatere belice in ščuke.

name: Mrtvica Topla struga
description:
Zaradi razraščanja vodnih rastlin je revir čez poletno-jesensko obdobje preraščen z vodnim rastlinami kar onemogoča ribolov.

V mrtvici plavajo kleni, somi, krapi, babuške, zelenike, rdečeperke..

en.name: The backwater Topla struga
en.description:
The warm water enables fishing throughout the year. Due to thermal water the district is home to some exotic inhabitants; frogs can be seen even during the winter. The fishing is impossible in summer and autumn because the backwater gets covered with thick layer of floating plants.

This backwater is home to chubs, catfish, carps, gibel carps, bleaks, rudds and even tilapias.

Revir je ciprinidnega značaja, saj v reki Muri prevladujejo ciprinidne vrste rib, predvsem podust, mrena, ogrica, klen, klenič, ploščič, ščuka, smuč, som, rdečeoka, platnica, menek in še druge vrste, ki pa za športni ribolov niso zanimive.

en.description: The river Mura with its tributaries and backwaters is the district that spreads on the right bank of the river Mura from the cable ferry in Vučja vas to the outflow of the river Ščavnica into the Mura in Gibina including all the tributaries and backwaters.This district is cyprinid in character and is home to cyprinid fish species, mostly common nase, barbel, vimba vimba fish, chub, common dace, common bream, pike,zander, catfish, roach, Danube roach, burbot and other different fish which hold no interest for recreative fishing.

name: Nadiža
subtitle: po območju republike Slovenije
description: Nadiža izvira v Italiji in se po 11,9-kilometra dolgem toku vanjo tudi vrne. Do pod Sedla je skrita v ozki dolini polni brzic in globokih tolmunov. Od tu dalje pa začne teči po vedno širši in prodnati dolini in se pod Robičem skoraj izgubi v širokih prodnih nanosih. Reko Nadižo naseljujejo vse vrste postrvi, lipan, glavač in v velikem številu tudi vse vrste belic, ki se pojavljajo v naših vodah – štrkavec, grba, primorski blistavec, mrenič, pisanec in tudi laški koščak.<

index.name: Nadiža

en.name: The river Nadiža
en.subtitle: within Slovenia
en.description: The source of the Nadiža is in Italy. The river makes an almost 12-km loop through Slovenia before returning there. Until it reaches the village of Sedlo, it is hidden in a narrow valley full of rapids and deep pools. From that point onwards, however, it enters a widening gravelly valley and almost disappears in its own deep gravel deposits below the village of Robič. Its waters are inhabited by all species of trout, grayling, Cottus gobio, as well as large numbers of all the species of Alburnus a. alborell, found in our waters – Adriatic chub, Italian barbel, Leuciscus souffia muticellus, Barbus meridionalis caninus, common minnow as well as Austropotamobius italicus.

name: Nanoščica II. A
description: Nanoščica izvira kot potok Globoščak izpod gore Nanos, po kateri je reka dobila ime. Glavni pritoki Nanoščice so potok Žabovec, Šmiheljski potok, Koretan in številni manjši pritoki, ki jo oskrbujejo z vodo. Reka je hudourniške narave in je v času padavin hitro tekoča in večkrat poplavlja, kar je njena značilnost po celotnem porečju. Kakor hitro naraste, se tudi zelo kmalu vrne nazaj v svojo strugo, ki je naravna in nedotaknjena. Na ravnicah se reka umiri, je polna prečudovitih meandrov, globokih tolmunov, ki so polni raznovrstnih rib. Kot zanimivost naj navedemo, da je povprečna teža ulovljenih ščuk v Nanoščici nad 3 kilograme. V njeni okolici opazimo vodomca, kosca in ostale divje živali.

en.name: Nanoščica II. A
en.description: The Nanoščica originates as a stream Globoščak under the Nanos Mountain, after which the river was named. The main tributaries of Nanoščica are the Žabovec stream, Šmiheljski potok, Koretan and numerous smaller tributaries, which supplies it with water. The river is of a torrential nature and is rapidly flowing and flooding during the precipitation period, which is its characteristic throughout the river basin. As soon as it grows, it also very soon return to its riverbed, which is natural and intact. On the plains the river is calm, it is full of beautiful meanders, deep pools full of various fish. It is interesting to note that the average weight of pike that are caught in Nanoščica is over 3 kilograms. In its surroundings, we notice a kingfisher, corn crake and other wild animals.

name: Nevljica 2
subtitle: od sotočja s Šumščico do izliva v Kamniško Bistrico
description: Potok Nevljica 2 je salmonidni revir, ki se prične od sotočja s Šumščico (v Šmartnem pri Tuhinju) in izliva v Kamniško Bistrico. Vodotok nudi prijeten vodostaj za muharjenje s krajšo palico, večji primerki rib pa se skrivajo pod skalnimi previsi v globelih. Za ribolov je zanimiv predvsem predel od Vrhpolj pri Kamniku do izliva v Kamniško Bistrico.

en.subtitle: from the confluence with the Šumščica to the outflow into the Kamniška Bistrica
en.description: The Nevljica 2 stream is a salmonid river that starts from the confluence with the Šumščica (in Šmartno pri Tuhinju) and flows into Kamniška Bistrica. The watercourse offers a pleasant possibility for fly fishing with a shorter rod, larger fish specimens are hidden under rocky overhangs in the gorges. For fishing, the area is most interesting from Vrhpolje near Kamnik to the confluence with the Kamniška Bistrica.

name: Pesnica
description:
Reka Pesnica je navidezno manjši potok, ki pa ob obilnem jesenskem deževju močno naraste in preti z razlitjem preko varovalnih nasipov, ki so bili zgrajeni ob regulaciji. Ravno takšne vode pa so skopale v regulirano rečno strugo polno jam, v katerih se skrivajo tudi kapitalni primerki somov in krapov. Reka Pesnica je s svojo razmeroma ozko strugo primerna za tiste ribiče, ki si želijo preživeti v Pesniški dolini miren dan ob nemotenem ribolovu.

Dostop do struge je nekoliko otežen zaradi zaraščenosti, ob slabem vremenu pa je najprimerneje prevozno sredstvo pustiti nekje ob utrjenem cestišču - z gramozom posuti poljski poti.

en.name: The river Pesnica
en.description:
At the first sight the river Pesnica looks like a smaller creek but when the heavy autumn rains fall it rises high and threatens to flood the protection embankments that were made when the river was regulated. Those quantities of water dug a river channel full of caves-an ideal hiding place for some first class catfish or carps.The river Pesnica with its narrow channel is suitable for fishermen who want to spend a quiet day fishing smoothly in the valley Pesniška dolina.

Due to thick vegetation it is rather difficult to access the channel and if the wether is bad the best choice is to leave your vehicle somewhere along the road-field path covered with gravel,

code: Pesnica, Svečniški, Dobrenjski, Cirknica, Gačniški, Vrtički, Jakobski
name: Reka Pesnica s pritoki
description: Reka Pesnica s pritoki je v zgornjem delu, od meje v Juriju do železniškega viadukta v Pesnici, salmonidna-ciprinidna športno ribolovna reka naseljena s potočno postrvjo, šarenko, podustjo, klenom, kleničom, rdečeoko, zelenika in drugim ribjim drobižom. V spodnjem delu, od jezu v Pernici do Gočevskega mostu, pa je naseljena s krapom, klenom, somom, smučem, ščuko, koresljem, rdečeoko, rdečeperko, zeleniko, ostrižem in drugim ribjim drobižom.

en.name: The river Pesnica with tributaries
en.description: The river Pesnica with tributaries is - in its upper part, from the state border in Jurij to the railroad viaduct in Pesnica- a salmonid-cyprinid river meant for recreational fishing and is home to brown trouts, rainbow trouts, common nases, chubs,common daces, common roaches, bleaks and other smallfish. In its lower part - from the dam in Pernica to the bridge in Gočeva- it is home to carps, chubs, catfish, zanders, pikes, crucian carps, common roaches, common rudds, bleaks, perches and other smallfish.

subtitle: od sotočja z potokom Jesenek do izliva v Voglajno
description: Pešnica priteče v Voglajno v Šentjurju. V Pešničo redno migrirajo ribe kot so: ploščič, babuška, klen, krap, linj, ostriž, podust, pohra, rdečeoka, rdečeperka, zelenika pseudorazbora, platnica. Predstavnik roparic pa sta: smuč in ščuka.

en.description: The creek Pešnica flows into the Voglajna in Šentjur. The fish that regularly migrate to the Pešnica are: common bream, gibel carp, chub, carp, tench, perch, common nase, Mediterranean barbel, common rudd, common roach, bleak, stone moroko, Danube roach. Some zanders and pikes can be found as well.

name: Piroški potok
subtitle: Sušica/Pirošica
description: Na Piroškem potoku je ribolov boljši v spodnjem delu potoka od Gornje Pirošice proti Krki navzdol. V njem prevladujejo potočne postrvi, v spodnjem delu pa ribe iz Krke. Sam potok je dostopen iz ceste med Gor. in Sp. Pirošico.

en.subtitle: creeks Sušica and Pirošica
en.description: In the district Piroški potok the fishing is better in the lower part- from Gornja Pirošica to the Krka downstream. It is home mostly to brown trouts; in its lower part to the fish from the Krka, too. You can access the district from the road between Gornja Pirošica and Spodnja Pirošica.

name: Pivka
description: Reka Pivka izvira na območju Zagorja, vendar je njena struga v zgornjem delu večina leta suha. Lovna je predvsem od sotočja z Nanoščico do ponora v znamenito Postojnsko jamo. V njej prevladujejo predvsem veliki ciprinidi in roparice, zlasti ščuke, ki dosegajo velikosti krepko čez meter, ter veliki krapi, ki so v revirju zelo pogosti.

en.name: Pivka
en.description: The Pivka river springs out in the Zagorje region, but its river bed stays almost completely dry in the upper stretch for the majority of the year. It is fishable mainly from the confluence with Nanoscica river until it goes underground to the famous Postojna cave. It is mainly dominated by large cyprinids and predators, especially pike, which reach the size boldly over a meter, and large carps that are very common in the river.

name: Planšarsko jezero
description: Planšarsko jezero je nastalo s poglobitvijo močvirnatega travnika in zajezitvijo. Jezerce pred zasipavanjem Jezernice ščiti jez in vodni zadrževalnik, saj hudourniški potok v času poplav nanaša izpod gora obilo proda. Jezerce je nastalo zaradi turistične izrabe in ima največjo globino okoli 2 m, naraven živelj v njem pa so majhne potočnice, ki se pozimi, ko jezerce na debelo prekrije led, umaknejo po potoku navzgor. RD vsako leto vanj vloži tudi šarenke, ki zelo hitro rastejo saj je voda zelo bogata s postranicami.

en.name: The lake Planšarsko jezero
en.description: The lake Planšarsko lake was made by sinking the swampy meadows and then stemming it. The little lake is protected from the Jezernica with a dam and a reservoir, because this creek can bring a lot of pebbles from the mountains in the flood period. It was meant for tourist purposes only and its highest depth is 2m, the natural habitants are small brown trouts, who migrate upstream in the winter time, when the lake is covered in ice. RD puts in rainbow trouts every year and they grow really fast because the water is rich in. little crustaceans.

name: Poljanska Sora
subtitle: od jezu na Hotavljah do mostu na Logu nad Škofjo Loko
description: Tu, pod Blegošem, se razprostira svet, o katerem je že pred 100 leti s posebno ljubeznijo pisal pisatelj dr. Ivan Tavčar. Tu je narava, kjer lahko človek polno zadiha in se spočije ob pogledih na slikovito pokrajino, polno lepot in zelenja. Tu je reka Poljanska Sora s številnimi tolmuni in brzicami, ki s svojim tokom in bogatim ribjim življem krasi dolino. V Poljanski Sori kraljuje kralj sladkovodnih rib, sulec, značilna ribja vrsta pa je atraktivni lipan in še številne druge. V Poljanski dolini boste našli svoj prostor pod soncem za sprostitev in rekreacijo. Poleg kakovostnega športnega ribolova lahko uživate v izvrstnih kulinaričnih dobrotah številnih dobrih gostišč.

index.name: Poljanska Sora
index.subtitle: od jezu na Hotavljah do mostu na Logu nad Škofjo Loko

en.name: Poljanska Sora
en.subtitle: from the dam in Hotavlje to the bridge at the Log nad Škofjo Loko
en.description: Here, below Blegoš, the world lies like on a palm of your hand, about which the famous Slovene author dr. Ivan Tavčar already wrote. Here is nature, where one can breathe fully and relax while looking at the picturesque landscape, full of beauty and greenery. Here is the river Poljanska Sora with many pools and rapids, which adorns the valley with its flow and rich fish life. Poljanska Sora is ruled by the king of freshwater fish, the huchen, while the typical fish species is the attractive grayling as well as many other species. In Poljanska dolina valley, you will find your place under the sun for relaxation and recreation. In addition to quality sports fishing, you can enjoy the excellent culinary delicacies of many good inns.

name: Reka Poljanska Sora
subtitle: od pritoka Petruzovega grabna v Logu do sotočja obeh Sor
description: Poljanska Sora je reka izrazito hudourniškega značaja, z izvirom na meji alpskega in kraškega sveta. Reka spada v skupino salmonidnih voda, saj ima čisto vodo in dobro ohranjene vodne habitate. Na večjem delu toka ima naravno ohranjeno strugo prepleteno s številnimi tolmuni, brzicami in prelivi. V njej živi več ribjih vrst, zaradi katerih je tudi uvrščena v Naturo 2000. V reki prebiva kralj naših voda sulec, ki je v tem delu kar dobro zastopan. Poleg sulca so ribolovno pomembne ribje vrste: šarenka, mrena, podust in klen. V tem revirju je mogoč tudi ribolov sulca. Za ribolov sulca se prosimo obrnite na RD Sora (kontakt).

index.name: Reka Poljanska Sora
index.subtitle: od pritoka Petruzovega grabna v Logu do sotočja obeh Sor

en.name: The river Poljanska Sora
en.subtitle: from the tributary Petruzov graben in Log to the confluence of both Sora rivers
en.description: Poljanska Sora is a river of torrential character, with a spring on the border of the Alpine and Karst world. The river belongs to the group of salmonid waters as it has clean water and well preserved aquatic habitats. On a large part of the stream, the naturally preserved riverbed is intertwined with numerous pools, rapids and overpasses. In it, there are several species of fish that make it a Natura 2000. The river is still inhabited by huchen. In addition to the huchen, rainbow trout, barbel, nase and chub are also important. Huchen fishing is also possible in this district. For huchen fishing please contact RD Sora (contact).

name: Potok Polskava
subtitle: od mostu v Medvedcih do izliva v Dravinjo
description:
Manjši vodotok, v katerem živi več vrst ciprinidnih vrst rib-predvsem manjših. V poletnih mesecih skoraj presahne, posebej še v sušnih obdobjih. Vodna površina tega revirja je cca 3,6 ha.

Potok Polskava je po velikosti najmanjši ribolovni revir med odprtimi vodami, s katerim upravlja RD Ptuj. Naseljenost predvsem z manjšimi vrstami rib privablja ribojede ptice, na nekaterih predelih skoraj popolnoma izpraznijo potok. Se pa je pojavilo večje število srebrnega koreslja, pa tudi ameriški somič ni redek. Kljub vsemu pa se pojavi tu in tam tudi kakšen krap, poskusno pa smo vložili tudi manjšo količino potočnih postrvi.

index.name: Potok Polskava
index.subtitle: od mostu v Medvedcih do izliva v Dravinjo

en.name: The creek Polskava
en.subtitle: from the bridge in Medvedci to the outflow into the Dravinja
en.description:
This watercourse is small and is home to many cyprinid fish species-especially smaller ones. It almost dries out in summertime especially when the drought hits. The total surface of this district measures approximately 3,6ha.

According to the size the creek Polskava is the smallest fishing district among the open waters managed by the RD Ptuj. It is home to smaller fish species and these always attract the fish eating birds which then almost empty the creek. The number of crucian carps grows constantly and blue catfish is not hard to find. Some carps appear occasionally and we also put in small quantity of brown trouts- to see if it works.

name: Potok Polskava
subtitle: od sotočja Male Polskave do mostu na cesti Slovenska Bistrica - Pragersko
description:
Potok Polskava je dolg 40 kilometrov. Izvira na Pohorju, blizu Areha, teče mimo Šmartnega na Pohorju, Zgornje Polskave, Spodnje Polskave, Pragerskega, Lovrenca na Dravskem polju in se kot levi pritok izlije v Dravinjo pri Vidmu.

Po Polskavi pritečejo čiste vode iz pohorja v njih pa prebivajo tako ciprinidne kot tudi salmonidne vrste rib, na slednje pa je mogoč lov z muharico. V delu nad Lahovim jezom prevladuje potočna postrv, v delu pod mostom na regionalni cesti Maribor - Celje pa najdemo tudi klena.

index.name: Potok Polskava
index.subtitle: od sotočja Male Polskave do mostu na cesti Slovenska Bistrica - Pragersko

en.name: The creek Polskava
en.subtitle: from the confluence of the Mala Polskava to the bridge on the road Slovenska Bistrica-Pragersko
en.description:
The creek Polskava is 40km long. It springs in mountain Pohorje near the peak Areh, flows past Šmartno na Pohorju, Zgornja Polskava, Spodnja Polskava, Pragersko, Lovrenc na Dravskem polju and then flows into the Dravinja at Videm as its left tributary.

The Polskava brings down the clear waters from the mountain Pohorje which are home to cyprinid as well as salmonid fish species; the latter you can fly fish for .Brown trouts reign in the area above the lake Lahovo jezero, under the bridge on the local road Maribor-Celje some chubs can also be found.

name: Potok Velka
description: Potok Velka je pritok jezera Sveta Trojica oba revirja sta naseljena s kapitalnimi primerki soma, krapa, amurja, ščuke, smuča, ploščiča, androge, rdečooke, zelenike ter drobiža.

en.name: The creek Velka
en.description: The creek Velka is tributary of the lake Sveta Trojica. Both districts are inhabitated with some first class specimens of catfish, carp, grass carp, pike, zander, common bream, silver bream, common roach, bleak and smallfish.

en.name: The gravel pit Pri Barnu
en.subtitle: the cave Okrogla jama

en.name: The gravel pit at the embankment Petanjci

name: Pšata 2
subtitle: od pod ribogojnico v Pšati do mlina v Sr. Zalogu in Reka 2
description: Potok Pšata 2 je salmonidni revir, ki se začne v vasi Pšata, neposredno pod Krvavcem (pod rezervatom - jez za ribogojnico Vodomec), pa vse do mlina v Srednjem Zalogu. Vodotok je ožji in primeren za vijačenje, izjemoma za muharjenje, za tiste, ki so bolj spretni in seveda s krajšo palico. Gre za ožjo strugo, ki teče delno v urbaniziranem naselju delno v obraščenem naravnem okolju.

index.name: Pšata 2
index.subtitle: od pod ribogojnico v Pšati do mlina v Sr. Zalogu in Reka 2

en.name: The creek Pšata 2
en.subtitle: from the reservation at the spring to the mill in Srednji Zalog
en.description: The Pšata 2 stream is a salmonid river starting in the village of Pšata, just below Krvavec (under the reserve - dam for the Vodomec fish farm), and flows all the way to the mill in Srednji Zalog. The watercourse is narrower and suitable for spinning, exceptionally for fly fishing, for those who are more skilled and, of course, with a shorter rod. It is a narrower river that runs partially in an urbanized settlement partly in an overgrown natural environment.

name: Pšata 3
subtitle: od mlina v Srednjem Zalogu do jezu v Mostah
description: Potok Pšata 3 je mešani revir, ki se začne od mlina v Srednjem Zalogu ter vse do jezu v Mostah pri Komendi. Vodotok teče delno v urbaniziranem naselju delno v obraščenem naravnem okolju. Primerno je predvsem beličarjenje na kruh, češnjo ali sir, saj so prisotni pretežno kleni, mrene, podusti, in pa vijačenje, kjer se najde kakšna večja šarenka ali potočna postrv.

index.name: Pšata 3
index.subtitle: od mlina v Srednjem Zalogu do jezu v Mostah

en.name: The creek Pšata 3
en.subtitle: from the mill in Srednji Zalog to the dam in Moste
en.description: The Pšata 3 stream is a mixed district starting from a mill in the Srednji Zalog and flowing all the way to the dam at the Moste pri Komendi. The watercourse flows partially in an urbanized settlement partly in an overgrown natural environment. In particular, it is appropriate to fish it with bread, cherry, or cheese, since it is dominated by chub, barbel, nase. Spinning is also interesting since there is a few nice trouts - brown trout and rainbow trout.

name: Pšata 4
subtitle: od jezu v Mostah do odvodnega kanala v Mengšu
description: Potok Pšata 4 je ciprinidni revir, ki se začne od jezu v Mostah pri Komendi in vse do odvodnega kanala - razbremenilnika v Mengšu. Pretežno so prisotni kleni, mrene, podusti in ribji drobiž. Vodotok je reguliran, kjer teče delno skozi vasi, delno v naravnem okolju.

index.name: Pšata 4
index.subtitle: od jezu v Mostah do odvodnega kanala v Mengšu

en.name: The creek Pšata 4
en.subtitle: from the dam in Moste to the drain canal in Mengeš
en.description: The Pšata 4 stream is a cyprinid river starting from the dam in Most at Komenda and flowing all the way to the discharge canal in Mengeš. Predominantly there are chub, barbel, nase and small fish. The watercourse is regulated where it runs through the villages, partly it is located in the natural environment.

name: Pšata 5
subtitle: od odvodnega kanala v Mengšu do izliva v Kamniško Bistrico
description: Potok Pšata 5 je ciprinidni revir, ki se začne od odvodnega kanala - razbremenilnika v Mengšu ter izliva v Kamniško Bistrico. Ta del revirja je daljši in teče skozi večja naselja, Mengeš, Trzin, Dragomelj. V naravnih meandrih se skrivajo tudi večji primerki klenov, podusti, platnic in drugih belic.

index.name: Pšata 5
index.subtitle: od odvodnega kanala v Mengšu do izliva v Kamniško Bistrico

en.name: The creek Pšata 5
en.subtitle: from the drain canal in Mengeš to the outflow into the Kamniška Bistrica
en.description: The Pšata 5 stream is a cyprinid river that starts from the drainage channel - the discharge in Mengeš and flows into Kamniška Bistrica. This part of the district is longer and runs through the larger settlements, Mengeš, Trzin, Dragomelj. In natural meanders, there are also large specimens of chub, nase, danube roach and other white fish.

name: Rača 3
subtitle: od mostu v Vrhpolju do sotočja z Radomljo
description: Potok Rača 3 je ciprinidni revir, ki se začne od mostu v Vrhpoljah pri Moravčah ter izteka v Radomljo v Dobu (pri Močilniku). Gre za potok, ki se pretaka skozi dve večji zajezitvi, ki sta lovni. Struga potoka je bogata s kleni, ostriži in drobižem, medtem ko se v bobrovem svetu lahko nalovite primerkov divjih krapov, ščuke, bolena in drugih belic. Ribolov v naravnem okolju obeh zajezitev, ki sta poleti preraščeni z vodnimi rastlinami, bo izziv za bolj spretne beličarje.

index.name: Rača 3
index.subtitle: od mostu v Vrhpolju do sotočja z Radomljo

en.name: The creek Rača 3
en.subtitle: from the bridge in Vrhpolje to the confluence with the Radomlja
en.description: The Rača 3 is a cyprinid district, which starts at the bridge in Vrhpolje near Moravče and flows into Radomlja in Dob (near Močilnik). It is a stream that flows through two major dams that are fishable. The stream is rich with chub, perch and small fish, while in the beaver world you can fish wild carp, pike, asp and other fish. Fishing in the natural environment of both dams, which are overgrown with aquatic plants in summer, will be a challenge for more skilled anglers.

name: Rača 4
subtitle: od sotočja z Radomljo do izliva v Kamniško Bistrico
description: Potok Rača 4 je ciprinidni revir, ki se začne od sotočja z Radomljo v Dobu (pri Močilniku) ter izteka v Kamniško Bistrico. V potok se združijo Rača, Radomlja in Radomeljska mlinščica. Od sotočja naprej je struga regulirana in globja ter poraščena z visokim vejevjem. Bogata je predvsem s ciprinidnimi vrstami rib, med njimi tudi s podustjo.

index.name: Rača 4
index.subtitle: od sotočja z Radomljo do izliva v Kamniško Bistrico

en.name: The creek Rača 4
en.subtitle: from the confluence with the Radomlja to the outflow into the Kamniška Bistrica
en.description: The Rača 4 is a cyprinid district, starting from the confluence with Radomlja in Dob (near Močilnik) and flowing into Kamniška Bistrica. Rača, Radomlja and Radomeljska Mlinščica are joined into the brook. From the confluence, the channel is regulated and deeper and covered with a high branch. It is rich mainly with cyprinid fish species, including the nase.

name: Potok Račna - Šica
subtitle: od izvira v vasi Mala Račna do ponora v Zatočni jami na vzhodnem robu polja pod Malo Rebrijo
description: Potok Šica -Račna izvira na jugu polja pod vasjo Mala Račna in ob obilju vode bruha iz podzemlja. Šica se meandrasto vije po polju tako skoraj za trikrat poveča dolžino svojega toka. Ponikuje v Zatočni jami. Zaradi svojega kraškega značaja oblikuje številne spodjede, ki so odličen habitat za večje potočne postrvi. Ribolov na samem potoku izredno težaven in je primernejši za izkušenejše ribiče.

index.name: Potok Račna - Šica
index.subtitle: od izvira v vasi Mala Račna do ponora v Zatočni jami na vzhodnem robu polja pod Malo Rebrijo

en.name: The creek Račna-Šica
en.subtitle: from the spring in the village Mala Račna to the place it goes underground: in the cave Zatočna jama on the east edge of the field under Mala Rebrija
en.description: The creek Šica-Račna springs in the south of the field under the village Mala Račna but the plenty of its waters come from underground. The Šica winds meandering throughout the field and thus increases its current three times. It disappears in the cave Zatočna jama. Due to its carst characteristics it erodes the banks on many places which make an excellent home to bigger brown trouts.The fishing on this creek is extremely difficult and suitable for more experienced fishermen.

name: Potok Radeščica
subtitle: Radešca
description: Radeščica je desni pritok reke Krke pod Sotesko. Njegov izvir je kraško jezerce v podnožju Kočevskega roga. Nekaj kilometrov dolg potok teče mimo Dolenjskih Toplic in je v celotnem toku dobro naseljen s potočno postrvjo in šarenko, lipan pa se jima pridruži v spodnjem delu. Občasno vanj zaide tudi sulec iz Krke. Kot na večini kraških voda sta tudi na Radeščici najuspešnejša pomladanski in zgodnji poletni ribolov.

index.name: Potok Radeščica
index.subtitle: Radešca

en.name: The creek radeščica
en.subtitle: Radešca
en.description: The Radeščica is a right tributary of the river Krka below Soteska. Its source is in a karst lake at the foot of Kočevski Rog. A few kilometers long stream runs past Dolenjske Toplice and is in full flow well inhabited by brown and rainbow trouts, graylings join them in the lower part. Occasionally some huchen from theKrka wanders in it.. As with most karst waters even in the Radeščica the most successful are spring and early summer fishing.

name: Potok Radoljna
description: Ribolovni revir Radoljna obsega potok Radoljna od izvira do izliva. Voda je čista, iz neokrnjene narave in teče v idiličnem okolju. To je salmonidni revir, tipični pohorski potok, v katerem živijo v glavnem potočne postrvi. Dovoljeno je muharjenje. Ribolov z dnevno dovolilnico je dovoljen od mostu pri gostilni Kores (Puščava) do izliva v reko Dravo.

en.name: The creek Radoljna
en.description: The Radoljna creek springs high in the woods of the Pohorje mountain. The fishing district Radoljna consists of the Radoljna creek from its spring to its outflow. The water is very clear , coming from the unspoilt nature and runs through almost idyllic environment.The district is salmonid and the creek is a typical mountain creek which provides home to mainly brown trouts. Fly fishing is allowed. The fishing with daily ticket is allowed from the bridge at the Kores inn ( Puščava ) to the outflow in the Drava.

name: Radomeljska mlinščica
subtitle: od zajetja v Volčjem potoku do izliva v Račo
description: Radomeljska mlinščica je salmonidni revir, ki se začne od zajetja iz Kamniške Bistrice v Volčjem Potoku ter do izliva v Račo na Viru. Je umetna manjša struga, ki teče dve tretjine v urbaniziranem naselju ostalo v poraščenem naravnem okolju. Primerki šarenk in potočnih postrvi se skrivajo predelih, ki jih je potrebno poiskati. Pretežno je možno vijačiti na manjšo blestivko (št. 2 ali št. 3), izjemoma tudi muhariti s krajšo palico.

index.name: Radomeljska mlinščica
index.subtitle: od zajetja v Volčjem potoku do izliva v Račo

en.name: The creek Radomeljska Mlinščica
en.subtitle: from the reservoir in Volčji potok to the outflow into the Rača
en.description: The Radomeljska Mlinscica is a salmonid river starting from the Kamniška Bistrica in Volčji Potok and flowing to the outflow into Rača at Vir. It is an artificial small river that runs two thirds in an urbanized settlement, the remaining part is in a natural environment. The specimens of rainbow trout and brown trout are quite hidden but they are there. It is predominantly possible to spin with a small metal lure (No. 2 or No. 3), exceptionally also fly fishing with a shorter rod is possible.

name: Radomlja 2
subtitle: od Blagovice do sotočja z Drtijščico
description: Potok Radomlja 2 je salmonidni revir, ki se začne od nekdanje gostilne Benkovič (v Blagovici) ter do sotočja z Drtijščico (v Trnjavi pri Lukovici). Reguliran vodotok teče po naravnem okolju, kjer je primeren za vijačenje na manjše blestivke (št. 2 ali št. 3). Šarenke ali potočne postrvi se najpogosteje zadržujejo za vodnimi pragovi in preprekami. Tam jih zagotovo ulovite.

index.name: Radomlja 2
index.subtitle: od Blagovice do sotočja z Drtijščico

en.name: The creek Radomlja 2
en.subtitle: from Blagovica to the confluence with the Drtijščica
en.description: The Radomlja 2 is a salmonid river starting from the former Benkovič Inn (in Blagovica) and flowing to the confluence with Drtijščica (in Trnjava pri Lukovici). The regulated watercourse flows through a natural environment where it is suitable for spinning with smaller metal lures (No. 2 or No. 3). Rainbow trout or brown trout are most often held behind water thresholds and obstacles. There, you can catch them for sure.

name: Radomlja 3
subtitle: od sotočja z Drtijščico do sotočja z Račo
description: Potok Radomlja 3 je mešani revir, ki se začne od sotočja z Drtijščico (v Trnjavi pri Lukovici) do sotočja z Račo v Dobu. Reguliran vodotok teče pretežno po naravnem okolju, kjer je primeren za vijačenje na manjše blestivke (št. 2 ali št. 3). Voda je bogata tudi z belicami (klen, mrena, drobiž).

index.name: Radomlja 3
index.subtitle: od sotočja z Drtijščico do sotočja z Račo

en.name: The creek Radomlja 3
en.subtitle: from the confluence with the Drtijščica to the confluence with the Rača
en.description: The stream Radomlja 3 is a mixed district starting from the confluence with Drtijščica (in Trnjava pri Lukovici) to the confluence with Raca in Dob. The regulated watercourse flows predominantly in a natural environment where it is suitable for spinning with small metal lures (No. 2 or No. 3). Water is also rich with white fish (chub, barbell, small fish).

name: Reka Radovna
subtitle: od srednje Radovne do Vintgarja
description: Tesno in slikovito alpsko dolino si Radovna skozi ves tok deli s cesto, ki pelje od izvira navzdol do vasi Gornje in Spodnje Gorje. Ta nezahtevna, zabavna in intimna alpska rečica leži v osrčju Triglavskega narodnega parka, kjer kristalno čista voda in neokrnjena narava ustvarjata edinstveno kuliso za ribolov.Radovna je idealna izbira za muharja, ki se ni namenil lovu na trofejno ribo, temveč si želi številnih prijemov na lahki, prožni muharici. Med bredenjem lahko sproščeno preiskuje tokove nizvodno in počez, ne da bi bil hkrati pripravljen do naveličanosti brskati po škatlici, ali ima kje kakšno izjemno uspešno muho, primerno prav za Radovno.Prav tako je odlična izbira za vse, ki si želijo pobegniti od bolj obiskanih voda, kot je Bohinjka, ali pa preprosto preživeti sproščeno popoldne v naravi. Po uri ali dveh muharjenja se lahko usedejo na travnik ob reki, pomalicajo in uživajo v miru ene najlepših alpskih dolin v Sloveniji.Poletni meseci so idealen čas za obisk Radovne. Hladna alpska reka tudi v najbolj vročih dneh ohranja prijetno temperaturo, kristalno čista voda in senca okoliških gozdov pa ustvarjata odlične razmere za klasično muharjenje.

index.name: Reka Radovna
index.subtitle: od srednje Radovne do Vintgarja
index.clubName: Ribiška družina Zavod za ribištvo Slovenije

en.name: The river Radovna
en.subtitle: from Srednja Radovna to Vintgar
en.description: The narrow and picturesque Alpine valley of the Radovna follows the road that runs from the river's source down to the villages of Gornje Gorje and Spodnje Gorje. This easy-going, enjoyable, and intimate Alpine stream lies in the heart of Triglav National Park, where crystal-clear water and unspoiled nature provide a unique setting for fly fishing.The Radovna is an ideal choice for the fly angler who is not chasing a trophy fish but rather enjoys plenty of takes on a light, flexible fly rod. While wading, anglers can comfortably cover the water downstream and across the current without constantly rummaging through their fly box in search of that one supposedly perfect pattern for the Radovna. It is also an excellent choice for those looking to escape busier rivers such as the Bohinjka, or simply spend a relaxing afternoon in nature. After an hour or two of fly fishing, you can sit down on the grassy riverbank, enjoy a snack, and take in the peace and quiet of one of Slovenia's most beautiful Alpine valleys. The summer months are the perfect time to visit the Radovna. Even on the hottest days, the cold Alpine river remains pleasantly cool, while its crystal-clear water and the shade of the surrounding forests create excellent conditions for traditional fly fishing.
