name: Potok Rak
description: Površina potoka je 4,8 ha. Potok Rak je mešanega značaja med salmonidno in ciprinidno vodo.Naseljujejo ga naslednje vrste rib: ščuke, kleni, linji, potočne postrvi, mrene, kapeljni, globočki, pisanci in babice. V potoku so redkejše alohtone ribe, kot so lipani, rdečeperke in ostriži. V Raku je predvsem ob nekoliko višjem vodostaju zelo zanimiv ribolov na klena, ki išče hrano na poplavljenih travnikih ob potoku. Drugače pa teren omogoča tudi dokaj uspešno muharjenje nanj, predvsem v poletnih in jesenskih mesecih. V oknih goste trave se skrivajo tudi lepe ščuke. V času zimske in poletne suše lahko revir Rak v celoti presahne, kar onemogoča ribolov.

en.name: The creek Rak
en.description: The creek's surface is 4,8 ha and is both salmonid and cyprinid in character. It is home to following fish species: pikes, chubs, tenches, brown trouts, barbels, European bullheads,gudgeons, minnows and stone loaches. Allochthonous fish species as greylings, common rudds and perches are harder to find in this creek. The most interesting fishing time in the creek Rak is when the water levels are somewhat higher-then you fish for chubs that search food in the flooded meadows along the creek. But the terrain also allows you to fly fish for chubs, too-pretty successfully- especially during summer and autumn. Some beautiful pikes also hide in deep grass. During the winter and summer drought, the Rak district can dry up completely, which makes fishing impossible.

name: Potok Rakitnica-Obrh
subtitle: od izvira do ponora
description: Rakitnica-Obrh je izrazito salmonidna voda v bližini naselja Rakitnica, naseljena s potočno postrvjo. Sama struga leži v okolju, kjer industrija ni prisotna, tako da je lepota in čistoča vode zajamčena. Velika nihanja vodne gladine omogočajo, da je voda izredno bogata s hrano, kar dokazujejo lepi primerki ujetih postrvi. Vse jezove na potoku je RD pred kratkim obnovila.

index.name: Potok Rakitnica-Obrh
index.subtitle: od izvira do ponora

en.name: The creek Rakitnica-Obrh
en.subtitle: from the spring to the place where it goes underground
en.description: The Rakitnica-Obrh is extremely salmonid water in the vicinity of the settlement Rakitnica and is full of brown trouts. The channel flows through the area with no industry at all so the beauty and the purity of water are guaranteed. The great fluctuations of water levels enable it to be very rich in food, which can be proven with beautiful specimens of the caught trouts. All the dams on the creek have recently been renewed by the RD.

name: Jezero Rauschelesee
description: Ribolov na jezeru Rauschelesee. Rauschelesee je s svojo površino 19 ha drugo največje jezero v občini Keutschach. Velik del obale je pokrit s trstjem in podvodnimi rastlinami. Rastlinstvo nudi raznolikim malim živalim primeren življenjski prostor. Na primer, na področju jezera so našli in prvič opisali različne hrošče in druge žuželke. Kot vsa druga jezera je Rauschelesee zelo priljubljeno pri ribičih. Karte za ribolovno sezono so na voljo samo domačinom in članom kluba. Dnevna karta velja od 6:00 do 21:00. Nočna karta velja od 21:00 do 6:00. Karta velja tudi za zgornji ribnik Spintikteich!

index.name: Jezero Rauschelesee
index.clubName: Ribiška družina Gemeinde Keutschach am See

en.name: Lake Rauschelesee
en.description: Fishing at Rauschele lake. The Rauschelesee is with its area of 19 ha, the second largest of the lakes in the municipality Keutschach. Large parts of the shore are covered with reeds and underwater plants. The vegetation offers a variety of small animals a suitable habitat. For example, the cattail bug and a rare water bug were first found in the field of Rauschelesees. Like all other lakes, the Rauschelesee is very popular with anglers. Fishing season licences are only available to locals and club members. A daily licence is valid from 6:00 to 21:00. A night licence is valid from 21:00 to 6:00. The licence is also valid for the nearby pond Spintikteich!

name: Reka Bistrica
subtitle: od mostu v Globeli do ponora v Goriči vasi
description: Reka Bistrica teče skozi mesto Ribnica. Njena struga poteka ob obzidju ribniškega gradu ter Gallusovem nabrežju. Teče tudi skozi nekatere mostove: Most med Škrabčevim trgom in ribniškim gradom, Francoski most (zgrajen je bil v času Ilirskih provinc), cestni most ter skozi brv v bližini cerkve sv. Štefana. V Bistrici prevladujejo lepi primerki potočne postrvi, lipana ter klena.

index.name: Reka Bistrica
index.subtitle: od mostu v Globeli do ponora v Goriči vasi

en.name: The river Bistrica
en.subtitle: from the bridge in Globel to the place where it goes underground in Goriča vas
en.description: The river Bistrica flows through the city of Ribnica. Its channel follows the walls of the fishing castle and the banks of Gallusovo nabrežje. It also flows under many bridges: the bridge between Škrabčev trg and the fishing castle, the bridge Francoski most ( it was built during the time of illyric provinces), the road bridge as well as under the footbridge in the vicinity of the church of Saint Stephen. The Bistrica is home for nice specimens of brown trouts, graylings and chubs.

name: Reka Iška
subtitle: od sotočja z Zalo do cestnega mostu v Lipah
description: Vas zanima, kje loviti? Katere muhe so najuspešnejše? Kje pustiti avto? Kliknite tukaj in preberite brezplačen vodič po reki Iški. Iška je simpatična muharska destinacija. Sredi neokrnjene narave, v kristalno čisti in pitni vodi, so doma majhne domorodne potočne postrvi z do 96 %! gensko čistostjo in šarenke. Pozor: območje medveda!

en.name: The river Iška
en.description: The river Iška is cute destination for fly fishing where you can even meet some famous local and foreign entrepreneurs and statesmen. In the unblemished nature - in crystal clear water which is just waiting for you to drink it- live indigenous brown trouts and rainbow trouts. Warning: active bear area!

en.name: The river Mura
en.subtitle: from Ceršak to the bridge in Trate
en.description: The river Mura is alpine river with fast current, deep pools and with big flux oscillations (from 50 to 1400 m3/s). It is home to many fish species-52 are registered.

name: Reka Rašica
subtitle: od Sotočja Robarke in Kovparce do ponikalnice v Ponikvah
description: Reka Rašica poteka skozi kraj Rašica, ki je najbolj znan kot rojstni kraj Primoža Trubarja. Rašica vključuje dolino potokov Rašica, Robarica, Veliki Graben (Mišja dolina) in Kozmanjka s stranskimi dolinami manjših potočkov (Kobilji curek, Črna voda, Črni graben, Stara voda, Kališki potok, Kozmanjka, Podleščica, Kozarščica itd.), do ponora pri vasi Ponikve. Povirna in nizka barja, ekstenzivno gospodarjeni in opuščeni močvirni in vlažni travniki, močvirja s šašjem in trstičjem, poplavni gozdovi, grmišča in mejice, bogata obrežna zeliščna, grmovna in drevesna vegetacija, tople in vlažne doline s svetlimi, mladimi sestoji predvsem velikega jesena in trepetlike, omrežje makadamskih cest in drugih golih (peščenih, skalnatih) površin ter ekstenzivno gospodarjeni suhi travniki in gozd na pobočjih. Voda Rašica je naseljena s potočno postrvjo, divjo šarenko, kleni in lipanom.

index.name: Reka Rašica
index.subtitle: od Sotočja Robarke in Kovparce do ponikalnice v Ponikvah

en.name: The river Rašica
en.subtitle: from the confluence of the Robarka and the Kovparca to the subterranean river in Ponikve
en.description: The river Rašica flows through the city of Rašica, the place that is mostly recognized as the birth place of Primož Trubar. Rašica district includes the valley of the creeks: the Rašica, the Robarica, the Veliki Graben ( Mišja dolina) and the Kozmanjka together with side valleys of even smaller creeks ( the Kobilji curek, the črna voda, the Črni graben, the Stara voda, the Kališki potok, the Kozmanjka, the Podlešćica, the Kozarščica etc, ) up to the place where the water goes underground in the village Ponikve. The bogs are low, the marshy and humid meadows are extensively treated or abandoned, the moorlands are surrounded with sedges and reeds, flooded forests, shrubs and hedges; the vegetation on the banks is herbs, shrubs and trees; the warm and moist valleys grow light, young stands of mostly great ash and aspen trees; the macadam roads and other bare surfaces ( sandy, rocky) entwine, the dry meadows are treated well and the forest envelopes the slopes. The waters of the Rašica are home to brown trouts, wild rainbow trouts, chubs and graylings.

name: Reka Ribnica
subtitle: od izvira do ponora
description: Reka Ribnica izvira v dveh kraških izvirih blizu male vasi Zadolje, pod Veliko goro. Po vlažni travnati ravnini se vije v velikih vijugah. Zaradi zakraselosti območja voda ponika v ponorih vzhodno od Dolenje vasi. Ob visokih vodah Ribnica podaljša svoj tok in teče naprej po fosilni strugi čez dolenjevaško polje do Zadnje Rinže. Na polju je več požiralnikov. Vode se zlivajo v reki Rinžo in Krko. V njej prebivajo ščuke, postrvi, linji, kleni, ostriži, rdečeoke pa tudi kakšen krap se najde.

index.name: Reka Ribnica
index.subtitle: od izvira do ponora

en.name: The river Ribnica
en.subtitle: from the spring to the place where it goes underground
en.description: The river Ribnica springs in two carst springs in the vicinity of the little village Zadolje under the Velika gora mountain. It winds across moist, grass plane , forming great arches. Because this area is mainly carst, the water goes under the ground through little abysses east from Dolenja vas. When waters are high, the Ribnica increases its stream and flows forward along the fossil channel, across the field of Dolenja vas until it reaches Zadnja Rinža. There are many water pipes in the field. The waters then flow into the Rinža and the Krka. Those waters provide home for pikes, trouts, tenches, chubs, percoidei, roaches and even for some carps.

name: Reka Ljubljanica
subtitle: od izvirov Ljubljanice do pritoka Pekovega grabna), Podlipščica in Črni graben
description: Počasen tok v običajnem vodostaju predstavlja beličarjem užitek v pričakovanju prijema kapitalne ribe. Tam kjer je globina je tudi obvodno rastlinje redko in riba se zadržuje v večjih količinah. Platnica na plovec ali mrena na talni ribolov, rdečeoka na štek, morda celo rečni krap z bojliji. Možnosti je veliko. Globina se v povprečju še poveča, brzic ni več, edine točke, kjer se poveča pretok je pri izlivih pritokov. Najzanimivejša ribolovna vrsta je ščuka, prisotni so tudi lipani, potočna postrv, šarenka. Pri uporabi manjših vab lahko preseneti klen. Ta del je mešan revir in je tudi vidno več bele ribe. Ribolov otežuje obvodno rastlinje in v poznem poletju tudi vodno rastlinje. Lipana se tukaj lahko pogosto lovi na suho muho, ki pa mora biti zelo realen posnetek trenutnega dogajanja na vodi. V tem revirju Ljubljanica predstavlja klasično kraško reko s počasnim tokom in redkimi brzicami, globino in vodnim rastlinjem.

index.name: Reka Ljubljanica
index.subtitle: od izvirov Ljubljanice do pritoka Pekovega grabna), Podlipščica in Črni graben

en.name: The river Ljubljanica
en.subtitle: from the Ljubljanica's springs to the tributary Pekov graben
en.description: The slow current in the usual water levels represents great joy for all the fishermen who float fish when they wait for the first class specimen to be caught. Where the waters are deep, the river vegetation is scarse and the fish gather here in larger numbers.The Danube roach with floats, the barbel with ground fishing, roach with pole fishing, maybe even river carp with boilies. The number of possibilities is great. The depth gets even deeper, the rapids are gone, the only points where the flowrate increases is where the tributaries flow in. The most interesting fish to fish for is definitely pike, but you can count on graylings, brown troats, rainbow trouts as well. The chub might surprise you when fishing with smaller baits. It is a mixed district and the quantity of the whitefish increases. The shore vegetation and- in summertime- the river vegetation, too make the fishing hard. You can fish for grayling using dry fly very often but you have to react to the happenings in the water very quickly. In this district the Ljubljanica is classical carst river with slow current and rare rapids, with the depth and water vegetation.

name: Reka Ljubljanica
subtitle: od pritoka Pekovega grabna pri Kaminih / Bevke do mostu čez Ljubljanico v Podpeči), Borovniščica, Zrnica, Podpeški graben
description:
Počasen tok v običajnem vodostaju predstavlja beličarjem užitek med pričakovanjem kapitalnega prijema. Tem kjer je globina je tudi obvodno rastlinje redko in riba se zadržuje v večjih količinah. Platnica na plovec ali mrena na talni ribolov, rdečeoka na štek, morda celo rečni krap. Možnosti je veliko.

Kraška lepotica se še razširi in upočasni. Ovinki tvorijo globoke tolmune. V tem mešanem revirju so zastopane vse vrste v Ljubljanici: potočne postrvi, lipani, šarenke, sulci, ščuke, platnice, podusti, ploščiči, rdečeoke in ostale. Uspeh prinaša tih prihod do obale in natančno predložena vaba ob vodnih ovirah. Ob večeru je viden večerni skok.

index.name: Reka Ljubljanica
index.subtitle: od pritoka Pekovega grabna pri Kaminih / Bevke do mostu čez Ljubljanico v Podpeči), Borovniščica, Zrnica, Podpeški graben

en.name: The river Ljubljanica
en.subtitle: from the tributary Pekov graben at Kamini / Bevke to the bridge across the Ljubljanica in Podpeč
en.description:
The slow current in the usual water levels represents great joy for all the fishermen whofloat fish when they wait for the first class specimen to be caught. Where the waters are deep, the river vegetation is scarse and the fish gather here in larger numbers.The Danube roach with floats, the barbel with ground fishing, roach with pole fishing, maybe even river carp. The number of possibilities is great.

The carst beauty widens and slows down. Its detours make deep pools. In this mixed district you can see all the Ljubljanica's species : brown trouts, graylings, rainbow trouts, huchens, pikes, Danube roaches, common nases, common breams, roaches and others. The success brings you to the shore quietly and the bait must be very accurately put. At dusk you can even see some night jumps.

code: Revir I. – reka Reka s pritoki
name: Reka Reka s pritoki
description: Vas zanima kje loviti? Katere muhe so najbolj uspešne? Kje pustiti avto? Kliknite tukaj in preberite brezplačen vodič po reki Reki Reka Reka je največja slovenska reka ponikalnica. Izvira na južni strani pobočja Snežnika na Hrvaškem. Na svoji 47 kilometrov dolgi poti se vije mimo krajev Zabiče, Ilirska Bistrica, Prem, Ribnica, preko Vremske doline do Škocjana, kjer nato ponikne v Škocjanske jame. Reka Reka je idealna destinacija za vse Vas, ki želite doživeti enkraten ribolov v neokrnjeni kraški naravi in pri tem uživati v muharjenju prelepih soških in potočnih postrvi ter njihovih križancev. Povodje reke Reke naseljujejo poleg postrvjih vrst še grba (mrena), klen, krap, smuč in ščuka. Vsem ljubiteljem športnega ribolova Vam je na delu reke Reke v Vremski dolini v dolžini dveh kilometrov (Fevžnarjev jez – Cerkvenikov mlin) na voljo muharski revir, kjer je ribolov dovoljen po načelu Ujemi in Spusti. V tem delu je reka Reka še posebej veličastna in bogata z vsemi vrstami postrvi.

en.name: The river Reka with tributaries
en.description: Do you want to know where to fish? Where to leave your car? What kind of of a fly do you need? Just click here and read for free the guide for the district river Reka The river Reka is slovenian largest subterranean river. Its spring is on the south hill of the Snežnik mountain in Croatia. On its 47 km long road it passes Zabiče, Ilirska Bistrica, Prem, Ribnica, across the Vremska dolina valley to Škocjan and there it goes under into the Škocjanske jame caves. The river Reka is an ideal destination for everyone who wants to enjoy unique fishing in the unspoiled karst nature, while fly fishing for beautiful marble or brown trouts or their hybrids. In the Reka's basin besides trouts we can also find italian barbel, chub, carp, zander and pike. To all the lovers of recreational fishing, you have a part of the Reka in the Vremska dolina ,2 km long ( from the Fevžnar's dam to the Cerkovnik's mill) to enjoy. It is a fly fishing district, where we fish only by principle Catch and Release. The Reka is especially glorius and rich in all the species of trouts in this part.

name: Ribčev ribnik pri Bistri
description: Ribnik je nastal zaradi izkopavanja gline. Ko so se izkopi ustavili je voda zalila področje in tako smo vrhniški ribiči dobili zanimiv ribnik, ki ponuja obilico možnosti za ribolov in sprostitev. Ponekod prihaja do zaraščanja z lokvanjem, vendar je večina ribnika lovna skozi vse leto.

en.name: The pond Ribčev ribnik near Bistra
en.description: The pond came to life due to the clay excavations. When those stopped, the water flooded the area and that is how the fishermen of Vrhnika got an interesting pond that offers plenty possibilities for fishing and relaxing. At some points it is overgrown with water lillies but the most of the pond is suitable for fishing throughout the year.

name: Ribnik Bajer Grobišče
description: Je plod lastnega dela RD. V njem prevladujejo krapi vseh velikosti in teže. RD letno v bajer vloži do 400 kg konzumnega krapa, veliko pa je tudi manjših krapov, ki so plod drsti v prejšnjih letih. V bajerju so prisotne še rdečeperke in rdečeoke.

en.name: Grobišče pond
en.description: It was built entirely by the members of the Fishing family Postojna. It is dominated by carps of all sizes and weights. The fishing family stocks up to 400 kg of carps annually. There is also a large number of smaller carps as a result of previous years' spawn, and other cyprinid fish species.

name: Ribnik Betnava
description: Ribnik Betnava leži v neposredni bližini nakupovalnih centrov v Mariboru. Tudi v največji vročini in pripeki boste lahko brezskrbno lovili v senci stoletnih dreves. Ribnik je bogato naseljen s krapi, nekaj pa je tudi srebrnega koreslja. V prijetni brunarici je prostor za srečanja, nudi pa tudi varni zavetje ob poletnih nevihtah. Parkirna mesta so ob vstopu k ribniku, jekleni konjički pa v senci.

en.name: The pond Betnava
en.description: The pond Betnava is situated in the close proximity of the shopping malls in Maribor.Even in the strongest heat you can fish here without worries because hundred years old trees make perfect shadows.The pond is rich in carps but there are some crucian carps as well. The cozy cabin offers great meeting place or a shelter from summer storms. The parking places are at the entrance of the pond and our steel pets in shadows.

name: Ribnik Blato
description: Ribnik Blato je v idiličnem okolju dolenjskih gričev, nedaleč od Trebnjega. Ribnik obsega 1,2 ha, v njem pa so različne ciprinidne vrste: največ je krapov, sledijo jim linji, ploščiči in smuči. Ribnik in njegova okolica sta izredno lepo urejena, za kar vzorno skrbijo ribiči – člani Ribiške družine Novo mesto, kar pomeni, da na njem ribiči ne bodo uživali le v dobrem ribolovu, ampak tudi v lepi naravi in urejeni okolici.

en.name: The pond Blato
en.description: The pond Blato is situated in an idyllic setting of the hills of the region Dolenjska, not far from Trebnje. The pond is 1.2 ha big and in it there are various cyprinid species: most of them carps, followed by tenches, common breams and zanders. The pond and its surroundings are very nicely decorated, for which fishermen - members of the fishing family Novo mesto -take great care, which means that the fishermen will not only enjoy the good fishing, but also the beautiful nature and attractive surroundings.

name: Ribnik Boštanj
subtitle: Boštanj
description: Krajinski park Radensko polje je naravni biser, ki se nahaja sredi dolenjskega krasa jugovzhodno od Grosuplja, na obronku Grosupeljske kotline. Na obrobju krajinskega parka se nahaja ribnik Boštanj, ki je vrstno zelo bogat. Poleg ribnika se nahaja dom grosupeljskih ribičev. Odličen je za krapolov in lov roparic.

index.name: Ribnik Boštanj
index.subtitle: Boštanj

en.name: The pond Boštanj
en.subtitle: Boštanj
en.description: The landscape park Radensko polje is a natural beauty, situated in the middle of the carst in Dolenjska region, just southeast of Grosuplje on the edges of the basin Grosuplje. You can find the pond Boštanj on the very edges of the park. It is home to various fish species and fishermen of Grosuplje' have s fishing lodge there. An excellent place to go fishing for carps and predatory fish.

name: Ribnik Brdinje
description: Med Ravnami in Kotljami se razprostira Ribnik Brdinje, last Koroške ribiške družine, v izmeri nad 12.000 m2 površine. V ribniku se nahajata približno dve toni rib, od krapov, linjev, podusti, platnic, klenov, drobiža, in nekaj kapitalnih ščuk. Ribnik je na zelo lepi lokaciji in je ponos Koroške ribiške družine. Ribolov je na voljo članom Koroške ribiške družine in ostalim ribičem (turistom). V koči ob ribniku se lahko ribiči v vročih dneh tudi odžejajo.

en.name: The pond Brdinje
en.description: Between Ravne and Kotlje there is the pond Brdinje, which is owned by the Koroška ribiška družina and is over 12.000 m2 big.You can find approximately two tons of fish in the pond; from carps, tenches, common nases, Danube roaches, chubs, some small fish to some first class pikes.The location of the pond is extremely beautiful and it makes the Koroška ribiška družina very proud. The fishing is allowed for the members of the Koroška ribiška družina as well as for the other fishermen and tourists. In the cabin by the lake the fishermen can drown their thirst when the days grow hot..

name: Ribnik Bruna vas
subtitle: Grajski ribnik
description: Na tem mestu so že stoletja obstajali grajski ribniki. Sedaj so ohranjeni še trije, ki leže v kaskadah. Lovna sta spodnja 2 ribnika. Dostop z magistralne ceste Trebnje - Sevnica, odcep približno 1 km od kraja Mokronog v smeri Sevnice. Okoli ribnika je na eni strani gozd, na drugi pa travniki. Okolica je redno vzdrževana in urejena, parkirati je možno v gozdičku poleg ribiške kočice. V ribnik se redno vlagajo krapi za pod trnek, sicer pa v vodi žive še babuške, amurji in ribji drobiž.

index.name: Ribnik Bruna vas
index.subtitle: Grajski ribnik

en.name: The pond Bruna vas
en.subtitle: The castle's pond
en.description: For centuries this has been original place of the castle's ponds. Only three are left and they are situated in cascades. The lower two ponds are meant for fishing. You can access them from the main road Trebnje - Sevnica, the turn is approximately 1 km from Mokronog in direction Sevnica. The ponds are surrounded with forest on one side and with meadows on the other. The surroundings are very neatly kept and you can park your car in the little forest near the fishing cabin. The carps to be caught on hook are being put in in the pond which is home to gibel carps, grass carps and smallfish, too.

name: Ribnik Češnjevek 1
description: Ribnik Češnjevek 1 je glinokopnega izvora, kjer so prisotni predvsem krapovci. Poleti je zelo priljubljen ribolov soma. Je članski ribnik, torej namenjen ribolovu članov. Dostop iz smeri Cerklje na Gorenjskem proti Velesovem (smer proti Preddvoru). V kraju Češnjevek zavijete desno za avtobusnim postajališčem. Po 1 km poti se pripeljete na ribnik. Ribnika sta dva in si sledita v zaporedju.

en.name: The pond Češnjevek 1
en.description: The pond Češnjevek 1 was built in the pit that was ones used to excavate clay. In the pond, cyprinids are mainly presented. Fishing is very popular in the summer. The pond is mainly dedicated to the members of the fishing family. Access is from the direction Cerklje na Gorenjskem to Velesov (direction towards Preddvor). Turn right at the bus stop in Češnjevek. After 1 km of the path, you will get to the pond. The ponds are two and follow in sequence.

name: Ribnik Češnjevek 2
description: Ribnik Češnjevek 2 je glinokopnega izvora, kjer so prisotni predvsem krapovci. Dostop je iz smeri Cerklje na Gorenjskem proti Velesovem (smer proti Preddvoru). V kraju Češnjevek zavijete desno za avtobusnim postajališčem. Po 1. km poti se pripeljete na ribnik. Ribnika sta dva in si sledita v zaporedju.

en.name: The pond Češnjevek 2
en.description: The pond Češnjevek 2 was built in the pit that was ones used to excavate clay. In the pond, cyprinids are mainly presented. Access is from the direction Cerklje na Gorenjskem to Velesov (direction towards Preddvor). Turn right at the bus stop in Češnjevek. After 1 km of the path, you will get to the pond. The ponds are two and follow in sequence.

name: Ribnik Črnelo 2
description: Ribnik Črnelo 2 je bogat predvsem s krapovci kot tudi plenilkami. Poleti ste vabljeni na ribolov soma. Dostop do ribnikov Črnelo je iz smeri Radomlje proti Rovam. Za nasadom platan (ob cesti na desni) zavijete desno na gozdno makadamsko pot, po kateri se peljete še 1,1 km in prispete neposredno pred ribnik Črnelo 2.

en.name: The pond Črnelo 2
en.description: Pond Črnelo 2 is rich mainly with the cyprinids as well as predators. In the summer, you are invited to go fishing for catfish. Access to the pond Crnelo is from the direction of Radomlje to Rove. After the plantation of trees (along the road on the right side) turn right onto the forest macadam road, after which you are still 1.1 km away and arrive directly in front of the Črnelo 2 pond.

name: Ribnik Dobje
subtitle: Dobje
description: Ribnik Dobje se nahaja na potoku Breg, zahodno od vasi Dobje. Zgrajen je bil tako, da je pregrada direktno zajezila vodo. Ni nam znano, kdaj je bil ribnik zgrajen (po nekaterih informacijah leta 1842). Z ribnikom so že pred več kot 150 leti upravljali stiški menihi, od leta 1963 naprej pa ga upravlja Ribiška družina Grosuplje. Ribnik napaja potok Breg, ki v sušnih letih tudi presuši. Samo območje je zavarovano pod Naturo 2000, ker je odličen habitat za mnoge živalske in rastlinske vrste. Primeren je za vse, ki želite ribariti v prelepem ribniku, katerega obdaja prečudovita naravna okolica.

index.name: Ribnik Dobje
index.subtitle: Dobje

en.name: The pond Dobje
en.subtitle: Dobje
en.description: The pond Dobje is situated on the creek Breg, from the village Dobje west. The water in the pond was dammed directly. The year of the making is unknown (probably around 1842) The monks of Stična had managed the pond almost 150 years ago but since 1963 the Ribiška družina Grosuplje has been managing it. The creek Breg gives the pond its water. The pond's area is protected under Natura 2000, being an excellent home to many animal and plant species. It is suitable for everyone who wants to fish on the beautiful pond surrounded by gorgeous natural environment.

name: Ribnik Florida
description: Ribnik Florida je bogat predvsem s krapovci in ščukami ter je umirjena lokacija za počitek. Dostop je iz smeri Dob proti Krtini - po stari cesti. Takoj pred nadvozom nad avtocesto LJ-MB se zavije levo. Po urejeni makadamski cesti se po ca. 1 km (drugi odcep levo pred drevesnim nasadom) pripeljete na ribnik.

en.name: The pond Florida
en.description: The Florida pond is rich mainly with carp and pike and is a suitable place to rest your mind. Access is from the direction of Dob towards Krtina - on the old road. Immediately before overpassing the LJ-MB motorway, turn left. After approx. 1 km of the macadam road (the second turn to the left in front of the tree plantation) brings you to the pond.

name: Ribnik Gaj
description: Ribnik gaj se nahaja v Mozirju, v neposredni bližini mozirskega gaja. Velik je 1 ha. Ob polovici ribnika je urejena trasa, ki omogoča ribolov invalidom, saj je dostopna z invalidski vozičkom. Obala ribnika je opremljena s klopmi, ki omogočajo sproščen ribolov. Ribnik je globok do 3 m, temperatura vode se giblje med 5 do 20 st. C. Poseljujejo ga krapi, amurji in ostale ciprinidne vrste rib. Prisotni so tudi plenilci (smuč in ščuka). Primeren je za beličarjenje krapa, amurja in ostalih ciprinidov in za vijačenje ob ribolovu plenilcev.

en.name: The pond Gaj
en.description: The pond Gaj is in Mozirje, in the near vicinity of Mozirski gaj. Its surface measures 1 ha. It has a very well managed course at the half of the pond with access to the wheelchairs. so fishermen with disabilities can fish here, too. The pond's shore is decorated with benches that enable relaxed fishing. The pond is 3 m deep, the water temperature varies from 5 to 20 C. It is home of carps, grass carps and other cyprinids, But you can also find some predatory fish here ( zander or pike. You can go float fishing here, for carps, grass carps or other cyprinids or go jigging while fishing for predatory fish.

name: Ribnik Glinokop
description: Ribnik Glinokop leži za naseljem Nemška vas. Ribiči Ribiške družine Ribnica so ga uredili v eno najbolj privlačnih vodnih površij na naši zemlji, polno belih brez in zanimivega življa. Krasijo ga štirje lokvanji, ki so jih posadili po celotni dolžini ribnika in ti, skupaj z ostalo naravo, tvorijo prvovrsten prostor za miren oddih. V ribniku prevladujejo pretežno krapi in ščuke.

en.name: The pond Glinokop
en.description: The pond Glinokop is situated behind the settlement Nemška vas. The fishermen of the Ribiška družina Ribnica have made it one of the most attractive water areas in our land, full with white birches and interesting life forms. The major embellisments are water lilies, which are planted along the whole length of the pond and together with the rest of the nature's beauty they create first class place to get some quiet rest. You can find mostly carps and pikes in the pond.

name: Ribnik Gustav Krmelj
description: Ribnik, ki je nastal v nekdanjem dnevnem kopu premogovnika Krmelj. Dosega globine do 5 m. Dostop po lokalni makadamski cesti iz naselja Krmelj, cca 0,6 km iz središča kraja. Okoli ribnika je skoraj v celoti gozd. V ribnik se redno vlagajo večje količine krapov za pod trnek, sicer pa v vodi žive še babuške in rdečeoke.

en.name: The pond Gustav Krmelj
en.description: This pond was made from the former opencast of the coal mine Krmelj. Its depths reach 5m. You can access it from the settlement Krmelj approximately 0,6 km from the village's centre. following the macadam road. The pond is almost entirely surrounded by forest. Larger quantities of carps to be caught on hook are regularly being put in but it also provides home for gibel carps and roaches.

name: Gramoznica Hoče
description: Gramoznico Hoče napaja podtalnica, zato je voda čista, hladna pod mostom avtoceste pa najdejo ribiči varno zavetje pred nevihtami in neurji. Dovoz je zagotovljen do parkirnega mesta ob gramoznici .V gramoznici Hoče so naseljeni kapitalni krapi in amurji.

en.name: The gravel pit Hoče
en.description:
The gravel pit Hoče is watered by a subterranean river, that's why the water is clear and cold, fishermen can take shelter from storms and thundershowers under the bridge of the highway. Driveway is secured to the parking lot near the gravel pit.

The gravel pit Hoče is home to some first class carps and grass carps.

name: Ribnik Univerze Pivola
description: Po svoji funkciji je bil ribnik prvotno namenjen namakanju sadovnjakov, ker presega te kapacitete je nastal lep in prijeten ribolovni objekt. Lahka dostopnost in vedno svež zrak mu dajezta še posebni čar. Ribnik je napajan iz pohorskega potoka, bogato naseljen s krapi in ščukami, veliko pa je tudi rdečeok in zelenik.

en.name: The pond of the University Pivola
en.description: The primary function of the pond was irrigation of the orchards but because it exceeded that capacity , it was made into nice and cozy fishing facility. It is especially charming due to easy access and constantly fresh air. The pond is watered by the creek from the Pohorje mountain and is rich in carps and pikes with plenty of roaches and bleaks.

name: Ribnik Jernejček
description:
Komercialni ribnik Jernejček se nahaja med krajema Zbelovo in Selski vrh.

Na ribniku je s tehniko beličarjenja ali na talni ribolov možen ribolov krapov in ribjega drobiža, prot zimskemu času pa vas vabi muharjenje oz. vijačenje na lepe smuče, ki v ribniku prevladujejo ter ščuke.

Vabljeni vsi ljubitelji idiličnega okolja, ki ga obdajajo drevesa bližnjega gozda in čudoviti travniki. Velja izpostaviti, da v ribniku ni somiča, tako da boste uživali v nemotenem ribolovu na večjo ribo.

en.name: The pond Jernejček
en.description:
The commercial pond Jernejček is situated between Zbelovo and Selski vrh.

You can float fish or ground fish for carps and smallfish but when the winter approaches it is an ideal time for fly fishing or spin fishing for beautiful zanders ( who reign the pond) and pikes.

All lovers of idyllic environment surrounded by trees of the nearby forest and beautiful meadows are most welcome. There is no blue catfish in the pond so you can enjoy fishing undisturbed for bigger fish.

name: Ribnik Križ
description: Ribnik Križ je bogat predvsem s krapovci in plenilkami. Dostop do ribnika je iz smeri iz Kamnika mimo Podgorja proti Križu pri Komendi. Takoj za koncem naselja Podgorje (pred znamenjem) zavijete desno. Po približno 200 metrih prispete do urejenega parkirišča ob ribniku.

en.name: The pond Križ
en.description: Pond Križ is rich mainly with carp and predators. Access to the pond is from the direction from Kamnik, passing Podgorje towards Križ pri Komendi. Immediately after the end of the settlement Podgorje (before the sign) turn right. After about 200 meters, you reach the parking lot by the pond.

name: Ribnik Krmelj
description: Velik ribnik, ki je nastal v nekdanjem dnevnem kopu premogovnika Krmelj. Dosega izredne globine do 20 m. Dostop po lokalni makadamski cesti iz naselja Krmelj, cca 0,7 km iz središča kraja. Okoli ribnika je na eni strani gozd, na drugi pa travniki, ob vodi je tudi ribiška koča RD Sevnica. Okolica je redno vzdrževana in urejena, parkirnih prostorov je na izbiro. V ribnik se redno vlagajo večje količine krapov za pod trnek, sicer pa v vodi žive še babuške, rdečeoke, linji, amurji, ščuke, smuči in som.

en.name: The pond Krmelj
en.description: This pond is big, made from an opencast of the coal mine Krmelj. Its depth can reach extraordinary 20 m. You can access it on the local macadam road that leads from the village Krmelj - approximately 0,7 km from the centre of the village. The pond is surrounded with forest on one side and with meadows on the other and the fishing cabin of the RD Sevnica is also situated here. The surroundings are well kept with numerous parking places. The larger quantities of carps to be caught on hook are being regularly put in in the pond but these waters are also home to gibel carps, roaches, tenches, grass carps, pikes, zanders and catfish.

name: Ribnik Lahovče
description: Ribnik Lahovče je bogat predvsem s krapovci in večjimi primerki somov. Dostop do lepo urejenega ribnika Lahovče je iz smeri Lahovče proti Brniku. V Lahovčah zavijete desno (pri gostilni Ambrož) in se po asfaltni cesti (ca. 1,5 km) peljete proti Zalogu. Ribnik boste zagledali na levi strani, čisto ob cesti.

en.name: The pond Lahovče
en.description: Pond Lahovče is rich mainly with carps and large specimens of catfish. Access to the beautifully arranged pond Lahovče is from the direction of Lahovce to Brnik. In Lahovce, turn right (at the Ambrož Inn) and take the asphalt road (approx. 1.5 km) towards Zalog. You will see the pond on the left side, right by the road.

name: Ribnik Lenc
description: V ribniku Lenc ribiči najpogosteje ujamejo krape, smuče, ščuke, amurje, ploščiče, rdečooke, zelenike in klene. Okolica je urejena z označeno pešpotjo.

en.name: The pond Lenc
en.description: In the pond Lenc the fishermen often catch carps, zanders, pikes, grass carps, common breams, common roaches, bleaks and chubs. The surroundings are neatly organised and walking path is marked.

name: Ribnik Loke
description: Ribnik je bil urejen v 70-tih letih, ima zelo lepo urejeno okolico, ob njem stoji Ribiški dom z gostinskim objektom. Gostilna nudi hrano, možen je tudi sprejem večjih skupin. Do ribnika se pripeljete po asfaltni cesti, ki povezuje dolino reke Save z Dolenjsko in je glavna prometna smer iz Sevnice za Novo mesto. Na voljo je veliko parkirišče, dostop je omogočen tudi invalidom. V ribniku so povečini krapi, pa tudi babuške, amurji, tolstolobik, linj in ribji drobiž.

en.name: The pond Loke
en.description: The pond has been designed and arranged in the 70s so its surroundings are very neat. The fishing cabin Ribiški dom is also situated there with an inn. The inn offers food and even bigger groups are accepted. You can drive to the pond on an asphalt road that connects the valley of the Sava with the Dolenjska region. This road is the main traffic direction from Sevnica to Novo mesto. You have a big parking lot at your disposal and access is enabled for the people with disabilities, too. You can find mostly carps, gibel carps, grass carps, silver carps, tenches and smallfish.

name: Ribnik Lokev v Logatcu
description: Idealen ribnik za začetne korake v svet ribolova. Številčnost rib, odprtost terena in malo ovir predstavlja dober poligon za začetnike ali malo izkušenejše ribiče, ki znajo ukrotiti krapa z bolognese palico.

en.name: The pond Lokev in Logatec
en.description: This is an ideal pond to take baby steps into the world of fishing. The number of fish, the open terrain and a few obstacles are good start for beginners or more experienced fishermen, that know how to keep the carp in line with a bolognese rod.

name: Ribnik Mačkovec
subtitle: Brestanica
description: Ribniki v Mačkovcih pri Brestanici so jedro zaokroženega zemljišča v lasti RD Brestanica-Krško. Ribiči uživajo v ribolovu na krapa, amurja, tolstolobika, rdečeoko, rdečeperko, linja, babuško in druge vrste rib.

index.name: Ribnik Mačkovec
index.subtitle: Brestanica

en.name: The pond Mačkovec
en.subtitle: Brestanica
en.description: The ponds in Mačkovci near Brestanica are encircled by the land belonging to the RD Brestanica-Krško. The fishermen enjoy in fishing for carps, grass carps, silver carps, common roaches, common rudds, tenches, gibel carps and other fish species.

name: Ribnik Mirna
description: Na tem mestu je bil starodavni grajski ribnik. RD Sevnica ga je prevzela v upravljanje 2006, od takrat se redno vlagajo krapi za pod trnek. Ima zelo lepo urejeno okolico, z mesti za počitek in klopcami v gozdičku. Do ribnika se pripeljete po asfaltni cesti Mirna - Gabrovka, približno 0,8 km od odcepa v središču kraja Mirna. Na voljo je veliko parkirišče, dostop je omogočen tudi invalidom. V ribniku so krapi, ploščiči, babuške, amurji in ribji drobiž.

en.name: The pond Mirna
en.description: In the original place of an old castle pond. The RD Sevnica manages this pond since 2006; from that time on the carps to be caught on hook are being regularly put in. The surroundings are very neatly arranged with resting places and benches in the forest. You can drive to the pond on the asphalt road Mirna - Gabrovka, approximately 0,8 km from the turn in the city centre of Mirna.You have a big parking lot at your disposal with access for the people with disabilities, too. In the pond you can find carps, common breams, gibel carps, grass carps and smallfish.

name: Ribnik Mokrice
description:
Ribnik se nahaja blizu gradu Mokrice, ki leži ob medkrajevni cesti od Čateža ob Savi proti Obrežju. Poleg občudovanja lepe narave in okolice pa se lahko ob ribniku sporostite z ribolovom na krape, amurje in klene.

Ribolov je zaradi aktivnosti bližnejga golf igrišča čez dan zaprt in je ribolov dovoljen samo od 1. maja do 1. novembra v dopoldanskih urah med 6h in 9h ter proti večeru, med 18h-21h.

en.name: The pond Mokrice
en.description:
The pond is situated in the proximity of the castle Mokrice on the road that leads from Čatež ob Savi to Obrežje. While you admire the beautiful nature and surroundings you can also relax fishing for carps, grass carps and chubs.

Due to nearby golf course's activities the pond is closed during the day and the fishing is possible only from May 1st to November 1st, in the morning from 6 to 9 and in the evening from 18 to 21 hrs.

name: Ribnik Moravče 2
description: Ribnik Moravče 2 je bogat predvsem s krapovci. V centru Moravč pri cerkvi zavijete levo proti Zalogu. Po približno 1,5 km zavijete za mostom čez Drtijščico desno in se peljete po asfaltni poti okrog 800 m. Prispeli boste do ribnikov Moravče, ki si sledijo v zaporedju. Ribolov je s to dovolilnico mogoč tako na drugem in tretjem ribniku v istem dnevu.

en.name: The pond Moravče 2
en.description: Pond Moravče is rich mainly with the cyprinids. At the Moravce center near the church, turn left towards Zalog. After about 1.5 km, turn right after the bridge over Drtijščica and take the asphalt road for about 800 m. You will arrive at Moravče fish ponds, which follow in sequence. Fishing is possible with this licence on both the second and third pond on the same day.

name: Ribnik Moravče 3
description: Ribnik Moravče 3 je bogat s krapovci. V centru Moravč pri cerkvi zavijete levo proti Zalogu. Po približno 1,5 km zavijete za mostom čez Drtijščico desno in se peljete po asfaltni poti okrog 800 m. Prispeli boste do ribnikov Moravče, ki si sledijo v zaporedju. Ribolov je s to dovolilnico mogoč tako na drugem in tretjem ribniku v istem dnevu.

en.name: The pond Moravče 3
en.description: Pond Moravče is rich mainly with the cyprinids. At the Moravce center near the church, turn left towards Zalog. After about 1.5 km, turn right after the bridge over Drtijščica and take the asphalt road for about 800 m. You will arrive at Moravče fish ponds, which follow in sequence. Fishing is possible with this licence on both the second and third pond on the same day.

name: Ribniki RD Mura-Paloma
description: Ribniki se nahajajo v neposredni bližini ribiškega doma ribiške družine Mura Paloma. V ribniku poleg kapitalnih krapov plavajo še ploščiči, rdečooke, zelenike in kleni. V ribnikih je dovoljen ribolov le po načelu »ujemi in spusti« z uporabo trnka brez zalusti in podmetalke. Priporočamo uporabo blazine.

en.name: The ponds of the RD Mura-Paloma
en.description: The ponds are situated in the very vicinity of the fishing lodge of the fishing family Mura Paloma. Besides some first class carps the ponds are also home to common breams, common roaches, bleaks and chubs. You can only fish "Catch and Release" style with barbless hooks and hand nets.

name: Ribniki Opekarna
description: Ribniki so dostopni po cesti iz smeri Brezine ali G. Lenarta. V ribnikih je veliko potopljenih dreves med katerimi se skrivajo in drstijo veliki primerki rib. Predvsem gre tu za krape in some. Najdejo pa se tudi ščuke in smuči.

en.name: The ponds Opekarna
en.description: You can access these ponds on the road from Brezina or G.Lenart. There are numerous sunken trees in these ponds which provide hiding and spawning places for big fish specimens, mostly carps and catfish but some pikes and zanders can also be found.

name: Ribnik Plastenka
description: Ribnik Plastenka (Ujemi in spusti) je bogat z večjimi krapi in amurji (10 kg in več). Dostopen je iz smeri Radomlje proti Rovam. Za nasadom platan (ob cesti na desni) se peljete še 100 m proti Rovam. Na levi strani se odpre pogled na ribnik. Ribolov ciprinidov se izvaja z največ dvema ribiškima palicama.

en.name: The pond Plastenka
en.subtitle: Radomlje
en.description: Pond Plastenka (C&R only) is rich in larger carp and grass carp (10 kg and more). It is accessible from the direction of Radomlje to Rove. After the plantation (along the road to the right), drive 100 meters towards Rove. On the left side, a view of the pond opens up. Fishing for cyprinids is allowed with up to two fishing rods.

name: Ribnik pod Debnim Vrhom
description: Ribnik pod Debnim Vrhom se nahaja v neposredni bližini Ljubljane in vam omogoča ribolov krapa in amurja vse leto.

en.name: The pond under the Debni Vrh hills
en.description: The pond under the Debni Vrh hills is situated in the close vicinity of Ljubljana and enables you to fish for carps and grass carps throughout the year.

name: Ribnik Preserje 1
description: Vas zanima kje loviti? Kje pustiti avto? Kakšne vabe so uspešne? Kliknite tukaj in preberite brezplačen vodič po ribnikih Preserje.Manjši ribnik v Preserju je Preserje 1 pod oskrbo RD Šempeter. Ribnik obsega 0,5 ha vodne površine.

en.name: The pond Preserje 1
en.description: The smaller pond in Preserje is named Preserje 1 and is managed by the RD Šempeter.It spreads on 0,5ha of water surface.

name: Ribnik Preserje 2
description: Vas zanima kje loviti? Kje pustiti avto? Katere vabe so uspešne? Kliknite tukaj in preberite brezplačen vodič po ribnikih Preserje.Največji ribnik v Preserju pod okriljem RD Šempeter. Obsega 3 ha vodne površine. Naseljujejo ga ščuka, smuč to so vse ribje vrste na katere lahko vijačimo. Izvajamo lahko beličarjenje ali talni ribolov na krapa, podust, klena, mreno, ploščiča, amurja, zeleniko in rdečeoko, za vsakega se kaj najde.

en.name: The pond Preserje 2
en.description: The biggest pond in Preserje managed by the RD Šempeter. It spreads on 3ha of water surface. It is home to pikes, zanders and catfish; the big fish you can spin fish for. You can also float fish or ground fish for carps, common nases, chubs, barbels, common breams, grass carps, bleaks and common roaches-every taste will be met.

name: Ribnik Preserje 4
description: Vas zanima kje loviti? Kje pustiti avto? Kliknite tukaj in preberite brezplačen vodič po ribnikih Preserje.Ribnik Preserje 4 se nahaja takoj čez most preko struge proti ribiškemu domu, na levi strani. Poleg ribnika stoji ribiški dom RD Šempeter. Možen je ribolov ciprinidov po načelu ''ujemi in spusti''.

en.name: The pond Preserje 4
en.description: The pond Preserje 4 is situated right across the channel's bridge towards the fishing lodge of the RD Šempeter, on the left. You can fish for cyprinids here-only Catch and Release style- and the price is very good.

name: Ribnik Bajer pri ribiški koči
description: Ribnik je nastal pri izkopavanju materiala za izdelavo opek, od ribjih vrst prevladuje predvsem linj, amur in krap vseh velikosti in teže. RD letno v bajer vloži kar nekaj konzumnega krapa, veliko pa je tudi manjših krapov in linjev, ki so plod drsti v prejšnjih letih. V bajerju so od ribjih vrst še rdečeperke in rdečeoke.

en.name: Pond at the fishing hut
en.description: The pond was created on the spot of the excavation of brick-making material. It is dominated by tench, grass carp and carp of all sizes and weight. In addition, the fishing family stocks a lot of carps annually. There is also a large number of smaller carps and other cyprinid fish species.

en.name: Prigorica pond
en.description: It is of a commercial character and is an additional place for fishing. The surface of the pond occupies an area of 5600 m2. The depth of the pond is approx. 2.50 m. The pond is inhabited by carps, tenches, rainbow trout, chubs, pike and other fish.

name: Ribnik Prilipe
description:
Ribnik Prilipe se nahaja ob krajevni cesti med Čatežem ob Savi in Obrežjem. V njem plavajo predvsem ciprinidne vrste kot so: krap, amur, klen, zelenika in rdečeperka. Ribnik je odprt le ob vikendih in v času od 1.3 do 1.11..

Ribiči se lahko odločijo za talni ribolov ali ribolov s plovcem, ribnik pa je znan po tem, da je skoraj nemogoče oditi brez ulova.

en.name: The pond Prilipe
en.description:
The pond Prilipe is situated along the local road between Čatež ob Savi and Obrežje. It is home to mostly cyprinid species: carps, chubs, bleaks and common rudds.The pond is open only on weekends in the period from 1.3 to 1.11.

The fishermen must decide whether they want to ground fish or float fish but it is almost impossible to leave this pond without a catch.

name: Ribnik Račnik
description: Jezerce je umetnega nastanka, nastalo je z zajezitvijo gojitvenega Želinjskega potoka, ki izvira v osrednjem delu nizke planote Udenboršt in se pri Tenetišah, po približno 5 km izliva v Parovnico - Rupovščico. Ribe v jezeru: pred vlaganjem krapov in tudi linjev so v vodi prevladali kleniči in kleni, pa tudi potočnice, rdečooke in perke. V jezeru je tudi nekaj amurjev in ščuk.

en.name: The pond Račnik
en.description: The little lake is of artificial origin, made by stemming of the Želinjski breeding stream: this stream springs in the middle of the Udenboršt plateau and outflows into the Parovnica-Rupovščica at Tenetiše, after approximately 5 km. Fish in the lake: the main fish species, before we put in carps and tenches, were little chubs and chubs as well as the brown trouts, roaches and common rudds. Some grass carps and pikes can be also found here.

name: Radvanje
description: Opuščen glinokop je danes zelo zanimiv beličarski revir.

en.name: Radvanje pond
en.description: The abandoned clay pit in Radvanje is today a very interesting coarse fishing district.

name: Jezero Rakitna
description: Vas zanima kje loviti? Katere vabe so najbolj uspešne? Kako pristopiti do jezera? Kliknite tukaj in preberite brezplačen vodič po ribniku Rakitna. Idilična planota Rakitna (800 m. nadm. v.) je prijetna izletniška točka, ki je od glavnega mesta Ljubljana oddaljena le dobrih 20 km. V istoimenskem jezeru so krapi, amurji, ostriži ter redkejše postrvi. Ob jezeru stoji sodobno opremljen hotel, ki ponuja udobje za zahtevnejše goste.

en.name: The lake Rakitna
en.description: An idyllic plateau Rakitna (800m altitude) is a nice tourist point and is only about 20 km far from the capital Ljubljana. In the lake of the same name you can fish for some healthy carps, grass carps, perches and trouts. There is a modern hotel by the lake which offers comfort even for the most demanding guests.

name: Ribnik Razvanje
subtitle: TRANSOM
description: Ribnik je nastal ob kopanju gline za opekarno. Bližina Maribora mu daje poseben čar, navsezadnje pa je le nekaj sto metrov celo postaja lokalnega avtobusa. Ribolovna mesta so lepo urejena, vsa okolica pa ima podobo mestnega parka. Kapitalni krapi, otočki iz vrbja, znamenitost ribnika, nudijo dovolj izzivov vsakemu športnemu ribiču. Primestna ribnika, stari in novi del, sta bogato naseljena s kapitalnimi krapi veliko pa je tudi srebrnega koreslja. Do ribnika je enostaven dostop, v poletni vročini pa je tudi nekaj sence.

index.name: Ribnik Razvanje
index.subtitle: TRANSOM

en.name: The pond Razvanje
en.subtitle: TRANSOM
en.description: The pond was made while digging for clay for the brickyard. The close proximity of Maribor gives it some special charm , after all the bus stop for the local bus is only few hundred meters away. The fishing places are neatly designed and all the surroundings resemble the city park. Some first class carps, little islands made of willows that are pond's attraction offer enough challanges to every recreational fisherman. The ponds - the old and the new part - are in the close proximity of the city, are full of some first class carp and many crucian carps as well. The pond is easy to access and offers even some shadows in summer heat.

name: Ribnik Reteče
description: Ribnik je verjetno eno tistih vodnih bogastev za katere vedo le ribiči in domačini, ki mu pravijo tudi Gramozno jezero. Ribnik ima peščeno dno, saj leži v jami, kjer so včasih izkopavali pesek. Ribnik ima največjo globino 3 m. Zelo nenavadna značilnost jezera je visoka vsebnost raztopljenega kisika v vodi, zaradi česar je v njem nekoč prebivala potočna postrv. V ribniku prebivajo številni krapi, ščuke in druge ribolovno zanimive ribje vrste. Zaradi velikosti ribnika je krmljenje na njem prepovedano.

en.name: The pond Reteče
en.description: The pond is probably one of those water bodies for which only fishermen and locals. It is known as a gravel pit lake. The pond has a sandy bottom, as it lies in a pit where the sand was sometimes excavated. The pond has a maximum depth of 3 m. A very unusual characteristic of the lake is the high content of dissolved oxygen in the water, which is why it was once inhabited by a brown trout. In the pond, many carp, pike and other fish species live. Due to the size of the pond, feeding on it is prohibited.

name: Ribnik Rogaška Slatina
description: Pot do ribnika iz smeri Rogaške Slatine: na vrhu naselja Tekačevo zavijemo z glavne ceste desno, takoj za gostiščem in prehodom čez železniško progo. Vožnjo nadaljujemo še dvesto metrov, nato pri lesenem smerokazu, ki označje ribnik, zavijemo levo navzdol na makedamsko cesto. Prevozimo še nekaj sto metrov in že smo na cilju. Avtomobil zapustimo ob rubu spodnjega ribnika. Ribnika naseljujejo razne vrste krapovcev kakor tudi roparice

en.name: The pond Rogaška Slatina
en.description: The way to the ponds from Rogaška Slatina: in Tekačevo we turn right off the main road (after the inn and railway crossing). We drive for two hundred meters and then, at the wooden signpost showing the pond, we turn left to the macadam road that we follow for another hundred meters and we have arrived. We leave the car at the edge of the lower pond. The ponds are home to different carp species and to some predatory fish as well.

name: Ribnik Rogoznica 1
description:
Ribnik je v osnovi opuščen glinokop, ki je bil preurejen v ribnik za športni ribolov. Vodna površina ribnika je 2.4 ha.

Ribnik je naseljen s krapi, amurji, srebrnimi koreslji in tolstolobiki, ploščiči in ostalimi ribami mirnih voda (rdečeoka, rdečeperka, klen, ščuka, smuč, som). Ribnik se nahaja v neposredni bližini mesta Ptuja ob cesti iz Ptuja proti Radencem. Ribnik je odprt za ribolov vse dni v tednu razen ponedeljka, ko je dan za čiščenje in urejanje okolice ribnika.

en.name: The pond Rogoznica 1
en.description:
The pond is actually an abandoned clay excavating site which was redesigned into the pond for recreational fishing. The total surface of the pond is 2,4ha.

The pond is home to carps, grass carps, crucian and silver carps, common breams and other still water fish ( Danube roaches, common rudds, chubs, pikes, zanders, catfish).It is situated near the city of Ptuj on the road from Ptuj to Radenci. It is opened for fishing all days of the week except on Mondays- it is a day for cleaning the pond and arranging the pond's surroundings.

name: Ribnik Rogoznica 2
description:
Ribnik Rogoznica 2 je narejen iz opuščenega glinokopa. Kot takšen nima stalnega napajanja z vodo, saj so edini pritok meteorne vode. Zaradi novo urejenih nabrežin v letu 2013 je dostop omogočen tudi ribičem z invalidskimi vozički, saj se se lahko pripeljejo čisto do vode.

Ribnik je namenjen ribičem, ki radi ribarijo po načinu ujemi & izpusti ter ljubijo sam ribolov, saj se bodo zaradi obilice rib v ribniku tudi nalovili.

en.name: The pond Rogoznica 2
en.description:
The pond Rogoznica 2 was made from an abandoned clay excavating site and the only inflow of water it has are the meteoric waters. Due to newly arranged banks , since 2013 the access is also possible for the fishermen in wheelchairs-almost directly to the water.

The pond is ideal for fishermen who love fishing itself and fish in catch&release style-the quantity of fish in the pond is high and so will their catch be.

name: Ribnik Sevnica
description: Stari ribnik, v samem mestu Sevnica. Kljub bližini in dostopnosti predstavlja ribnik mirni kotiček mesta, do koder ne prodre običajni vsakodnevni hrup. Dostop je odličen, dovolj je mesta za parkiranje. Do ribnika pridete po Prvomajski ulici v novem delu Sevnice. V ribniku so povečini krapi, pa tudi babuške, amurji, tolstolobik, linj in ribji drobiž.

en.name: The pond Sevnica
en.description: An old pond in the city of Sevnica. Though it is close and accessible the pond represents the quiet spot in the city where everyday noise doesn't bother you. Great access and parking places. The pond can be reached on the Prvomajska strret in the part of Sevnica. You can find mostly carps, gibel carps, grass carps, silver carps, tenches and smallfish.

name: Ribnik Stanečka vas
description: Ribnik poseljujejo številne ribje vrste, zanimive za športni ribolov. Dovoljen je le športni ribolov po načelu ujemi in spusti.

en.name: Pond Stanečka vas
en.description: The pond is inhabited by many fish species interesting for sport fishing. Only catch and release sport fishing is allowed.

name: Ribnik Strahomer
description: Vas zanima, kje loviti? Katere vabe so najbolj uspešne? Kako pristopiti do ribnika? Kliknite tukaj in preberite brezplačen vodič po jezeru Strahomer. Ribnik Strahomer je znano po lepi naravi, miru in zdravih ribah, zato na njem radi lovijo tudi znani državniki in tuji diplomati. Revir je obdan s temnimi gozdovi, v katerih živi rjavi medved. Prav tako kot njegova okolica je bogat tudi ribnik. Ribiči v njem lovijo velike amurje, ki dosežejo v dolžino 120 cm, ščuke, smuče in seveda čudovite krape, ki tehtajo do 17 kg. RIBOLOV JE LE NA NAČIN UJEMI IN SPUSTI. Pozor: območje medveda!

en.name: The lake Strahomer
en.description: The lake Strahomer is well known for its beautiful nature, peace and healthy fish and the famous statesmen and diplomats also love to fish here. The district is surrounded by dark forests where the brown bear still lives. The lake itself is also rich, especially in huge grass carps up to 120 cm, aggressive pikes, cautious zanders and, of course, beautiful carps. Warning: active bear area!

name: Ribnik Stražišče
description: Stražiški ribnik je sčasoma zaraslo vodno rastlinje, zato je bil ribnik leta 2009 saniran. Na delu jezera je urejena tudi obala, tako da je mogoč dostop tudi ribičem invalidom. RD Kranj v ribnik vlaga velike upe, da bo, čeprav ni velik, v prihodnje nudil veliko užitkov predvsem kraparjem, saj so v njem pogoji za dobro razmnoževanje in rast vrst, kot so krap, linj, ostriži in ostalih ciprinidnih vrst. Že v letu 2011 so bili tako ujeti primerki krapov nad 5 kg. Ribnik je tudi lepa sprehajalna točka za uživanje v lepi naravi, ki ga obdaja.

en.name: The pond Stražišče
en.description: The Stražišče pond was overgrown by water plants but the pond was cleaned in 2009. The shore is very well arranged so the fishermen with disabilities can have access, too. RD Kranj has great hopes for the pond although it is not a big one, but in the future the fishermen for carps will absolutely love it. The pond has all the necessary requirements for good breeding and growth of the carps, tenches, percoidei and the other cyprinids. In 2011 the carps over 5 kg have already been caught. The pond is also a beautiful walking place to enjoy nature surrounding it.

name: Ribnik Šmarje pri Jelšah
description: Dva krasna ribnika za beličarjenje in lov roparic. Bregovi so urejeni in lahko dostopni. Visoka drevesa v okolici nudijo obilo sence tudi v vročih poletnih mesecih. Ribinka se nahajata na začetku naselja Šmarje pri Jelšah iz smeri Celja.

en.name: The pond Šmarje pri Jelšah
en.description: These two ponds are wonderful for float fishing and fishing for predatory fish. The banks are regulated and easily accessible. Tall trees offer plenty of shade during hot summer months. The ponds are situated at the entrance to Šmarje ob Jelšah-from direction Celje.

name: Ribnik Šmartno pod Šmarno Goro
description: Ribnik Šmartno se nahaja pod Šmarno Goro poleg ribiškega doma RD Medvode. V njem plavajo tolstolobiki zavidljive velikosti, amurji ter krapi, med katerimi nas lahko preseneti tudi prijem kakšnega, ki tehta okoli 10kg.

en.name: The pond Šmartno under mountain Šmarna gora
en.description: The pond Šmartno is situated under the hill Šmarna gora near the fishing lodge. It is home to some capital silver carps, grass carps and carps - we may even be surprised with a catch around 10kg.

name: Ribnik Štrit
subtitle: Štritovsko jezero
description: Jezero Štrit je edino naravno jezero med revirji RD Sevnica. Dosega velike globine, ker je kraškega izvora. Jezero je poznano po kapitalnih krapih in ščukah. Poleg njih v njem žive še babuške, linji, amurji, rdečeoke, ostriži in drug ribji drobiž. Dostop je po asfaltni lokalni cesti (cca 2 km), katera se odcepi od glavne ceste Sevnica - Novo mesto pri vasi Dolenje Radulje. Parkirati je možno ob glavni cesti ali v dogovoru z domačini na njihovih zemljiščih.

index.name: Ribnik Štrit
index.subtitle: Štritovsko jezero

en.name: The pond Štrit
en.subtitle: the lake Štritovsko
en.description: The lake Štrit is the only natural lake in the districts of the RD Sevnica. It can go really deep due to its carst origin. It is well known for its first class specimens of carps and pikes.It also provides home for gibel carps, tenches, grass carps, roaches, percoidei and other smallfish. On the main road Sevnica -Novo mesto you take a turn at the village Dolenje Radulje and the asphalt road approximately for 2 km will lead you to your fishing place. You can park along the road or upon agreement with the locals , on their land.

name: Ribnik Trebče
description: Voda v ribniku je izredno bogata s kisikom, zaradi pritoka in odtoka v reko Bistrico. V ribniku lahko doživimo izredno lep ribolov z beličarjenjem ali pa vijačenje na roparice, ki prežijo pod vodnim rastlinjem.

en.name: The pond Trebče
en.description: The water in this pond is very rich in oxygen due to its inflow and outflow into the river Bistrica. We can float fish or spin fish for predatory fish hiding underneath the water vegetation; both experiences will prove as satisfactory.

name: Ribnik Videž III
description:
Komercialni ribnik Videž III (večji od dveh, ki se držijo skupaj) se nahaja ob cesti med krajema Videž in Levič.

Na ribniku je s tehniko beličarjenja ali na talni ribolov možen ribolov krapov, amurjev, tolstolobikov, srebrnih koresljev, linjev, rdečeperk, rdečeok. Mogoč pa je tudi ribolov na roparice (smuč in ščuka).

Velja izpostaviti, da v ribniku ni somiča, tako da boste uživali v nemotenem ribolovu na večjo ribo.

en.name: The pond Videž III
en.description:
The commercial pond Videž III (the bigger one of two that stick together) is situated on the road that connects Videž and Levič.

On this pond you can float fish or ground fish for carps, grass carps, silver carps, crucian carps, tenches, common rudds, Danube roaches. You can also fish for predatory fish here (zanders or pikes).

There is no blue catfish in this pond so you can enjoy in undisturbed fishing for bigger fish.

name: Ribnik Vonarje
description: Ribnik Vonarje se nahaja v neposredni bližini Term Olimia, kjer ima zelo urejeno okolico in nudi obilico užitvov vsem, ki radi beličarite.

en.name: The pond Vonarje
en.subtitle: the backwater Valek
en.description: The pond Vonarje is situated near the spa Terme Olimia. The surroundings are very neat and the pond offers plenty of joy to all who like to float fish.

name: Ribnik Zgornja Pristava
description: Ribnik v Zgornji Pristavi, ki se razprostira na 3,5 ha vodne površine in leži pod slikovitim haloškim hribovjem, je vabljiv za goste zaradi svoje lege in ribjega bogastva. Poleg krapov in amurjev izjemnih velikosti (ujeti tudi primerki težji od 30 kg) je ribnik naseljen s številnimi vrstami sladkovodnih rib. Poleg naštetih ciprinidov je v ribniku mogoče loviti tudi plenilske vrste in ujeti trofejnega soma, smuča ali ščuko.

en.name: Pond Zgornja Pristava
en.description: The pond in Zgornja Pristava, which spreads over 3.5 ha of water and lies under the picturesque Haloze hills, is attractive to guests due to its location and fish richness. In addition to carp and grass carp of exceptional size (specimens weighing more than 30 kg are also caught), the pond is inhabited by many species of freshwater fish. In addition to the cyprinids, there it is also possible to fish for predatory species in the pond and catch trophy catfish, zander or pike.

en.name: Pond Žalec
en.description: The pond covers 1 ha of water and is managed by members of the Žalec fishing club under the auspices of the Šempeter fishing family. It is inhabited by pike, zander and catfish - these are all fish species that you may fish there with a method of spinfishing. You can do float or ground fishing as well for carp, nase, chub, barbel, bream, grass carp, perch and roach.

name: Ribnik Želodnik
description: Ribnik Želodnik je bogat predvsem s krapi in amurji. Dostop do ribnika Želodnik je iz smeri Dob proti Prevojam. V kraju Želodnik (pri Rolteku) zavijete levo na asfaltno cesto. Po zaključku asfaltne ceste (približno 200 m makadamske gozdne poti) zavijete ponovno levo in se pripeljete do ribnika.

en.name: The pond Želodnik
en.description: Pond Zelodnik is rich mainly with carp and grass carp. Access to the pond Zelodnik is from the direction of Dob towards Prevoje. Turn left in the village of Želodnik (near Roltek) to the asphalt road. When the asphalt road ends (about 200 m of macadam forest road), turn left and then you reach the pond.

name: Ribnik Marof
subtitle: Mrzlo polje
description: Ribnik Marof se nahaja v Mrzlem polju nad Jurkloštrom v neokrnjeni naravi. Primeren je za ribolov krapovcev in roparic. Ob ribniku je ribiški dom, kjer se lahko okrepčate s hrano in pijačo. Za večje skupine lahko organiziramo prireditve ob predhodni najavi. Ribnik je odprt ob sobotah, nedeljah in praznikih.

index.name: Ribnik Marof
index.subtitle: Mrzlo polje

en.name: The pond Marof
en.subtitle: near Mrzlo polje
en.description: The pond Marof is situated in Mrzlo polje above Jurklošter in unblemished nature. It is suitable for fishing of carps and predatory fish. There is a fishing lodge along the pond where you can strenghten yourselves with food or drink. On prior arrangement we organize events for larger groups. The pond is opened on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays.

name: Ribniki Opekarna
subtitle: Divjak
description: Ribniki so nastali na starih glinokopih v Verdu. Zato sta še posebej oba večja ribnika ob robovih močno zaraščena z ostanki dreves, ki so zrasla v času kopanja gline. Prvi ribnik na levi je namenjen naravni reprodukciji rib, ostali so ribolovni. Za začetnike priporočamo manjša dva na levi strani nasipa, medtem, ko se naj na t.i. ribnik Divjak podajo loviti izkušenejši ribiči, ker je zaradi potopljenih dreves ribolov otežen. Prav ta ribnik je tudi poln prijetnih presenečenj saj poleg drugih rib notri plavajo tudi kapitalni somi.

index.name: Ribniki Opekarna
index.subtitle: Divjak

en.name: The ponds Opekarna
en.subtitle: the Divjak
en.description: The ponds Ribniki were made on the old clay pits in Verd. That is the reason that both bigger ponds are still overgrown with tree remains at the edges; the trees that grew when the clay had been excavating still. The first pond on the left side is meant for the procreation of fish , the rest of them are fishing ponds. For the fishermen beginners we recommend two smaller ponds on the left side, the more experienced ones should go to the Divjak, where sunken trees make fishing a lot harder. This very pond is full of surprises because along the other fish some first class catfish can be found here.

name: Ribniki Pragersko
subtitle: 1: Gaj - Gajski, A, B, 2: pri Brumcu, 3, 4: pri ribiški koči, 5, 6: Bana, 7, 8
description:
V določenih ribnikih v revirju je dovoljeno izvajati samo ribolov po načelu Ujemi in spusti. Za podrobnosti glej posamično dovolilnico. Po začetku ribolova je prestavljanje med ribniki prepovedano!Ribniki Pragersko, ki so tudi oštevilčeni, so sledeči: Gaj - Gajski (1), ob železnici (A), pri Opekarni (B), pri Brumcu (2), pri transformatorju (3), pri ribiški koči (4), tekmovalna trasa 1 (5), tekmovalna trasa 2 - Bana (6), na gmajni (7), pri strelišču (8).

Vsi ribniki, ki se nahajajo blizu naselja Pragersko, so polni rib, še posebej Gajski v katerem se nahajajo kapitalni krapi, amurji ter roparice. Prav tako pa je bolj poznana tudi Tekmovalna trasa 1, na kateri se izvajajo tudi tekmovanja v lovu rib s plovcem.

Ob ribniku 1:Gaj in 6:Bana je z nakupom ustrezne dovolilnice dovoljen nočni ribolov.

Vabljeni v lepo naravo z ogromno izbiro možnosti ribolova.

index.name: Ribniki Pragersko
index.subtitle: 1: Gaj - Gajski, A, B, 2: pri Brumcu, 3, 4: pri ribiški koči, 5, 6: Bana, 7, 8

en.name: The ponds Pragersko
en.description:
The ponds Pragersko are named and numbered as following : the pond Gajski ribnik (1), the pond Pri železnici -near railway-(2), the pond Pri Opekarni-the clay factory-(3), the pond Pri Brumecu (4), the pond Pri transformatorju-near transformer-(5), the pond Pri ribiski koči-near fishing lodge (6), the pond Tekmovalna trasa 1 -competition route 1- (7), the pond Tekmovalna trasa 2 (Bana) -competition route 2-(8), the pond Pri strelišču-near shooting range-(9) and the pond Na gmajni-wild, unkept meadow-(10).

All the ponds are in the vicinity of the settlement Pragersko and are full of fish but the most famous one is the pond Gajski ribnik where you can find some first class specimens of carps, grass carps and predatory fish. The pond Tekmovalna trasa 1 is also well known due to competitions in float fishing that take place here.

Come and visit our beautiful nature with vast possibilities for fishing.

name: Ribniki Prelesje
description: Ribniki so nastali po izkoriščanju glinokopov. So trije večji in več manjših vodnih kotanj. Dostop po poljski makadamski cesti z magistralne ceste Trebnje - Sevnica, odcep je pri mizarstvu Berk. Potrebno je prečkati železniško progo Sevnica - Trebnje. Ribniki so v prijetnem gozdnem okolju, kjer je dovolj prostora za parkiranje tik ob vodi. V ribnik se redno vlagajo krapi za pod trnek, sicer pa v vodi žive še babuške, amurji in ribji drobiž. Posebno so znamenite kapitalne ščuke.

en.name: The ponds Prelesje
en.description: The ponds were made after the clay pits were used and closed. There are three bigger and few smaller water basins. You can access the ponds from the macadam road that runs through the fields from the highway Trebnje - Sevnica,turning at the joinery Berk. It is necessary to cross the railroad Sevnica - Trebnje. .The ponds are situated in cozy forested area with enough space to park directly along water.The carps to be caught on hook are being regularly put in in the water which is also home to gibel carps, grass carps and smallfish.The ponds are also well known for their first class specimens of pikes.

code: Ribniki pri Ribiškem domu v Sinji Gorici
name: Ribnik pri Ribiškem domu v Sinji Gorici
description: Ribnik je plod udarniških akcij vrhniških ribičev v 60ih letih. Namenjen je starejšim članom in začetnikom, ker je lahek dostop, poln je najrazličnejših rib in brez večjih ovir v vodi. V bližini se nahaja tudi ribiški dom RD Vrhnika, kjer lahko pogasite žejo in se okrepčate s hrano po nizkih cenah.

index.name: Ribnik pri Ribiškem domu v Sinji Gorici

en.name: The pond at Ribiški dom in Sinja Gorica
en.description: The pond was made by Vrhnika's fishermen in the sixties. It is meant for older members and beginners, because the access is easy, it is full of different fish and no great obstacles can be found in water. The fishing lodge of the RD Vrhnika is also in the neighbourhood, where you can drown your thirst or strengthen yourself with good meal at very low prices.

name: Ribnik Slivnica 2
description: V ribnik se steka meteorna voda iz Pohorja, zato je voda malo hladnejša a tista prava, z malo vplivov kmetijstva in gospodinjskih odplak. V tem ribniku dominirajo krapi in ščuke. Ribnik je primeren za starejše ribiče, saj je dostop omogočen z avtomobilom neposredno do lovnega mesta. Ker je med gozdoma, vlada v njem skoraj brezveterje in prijetna mikroklima.

passes.name: Ujemi in spusti - talni ribolov (2 palici)

en.name: The pond Slivnica 2
en.description:
The meteor water from the Pohorje mountain flows into this pond and that's why the water is colder but more genuine, with little or no influence from farms or household sewages.n The pond is dominated by carps and pikes. It is also suitable for older fishermen becauese it can be reached by car directly. And because it is situated between two forests it is almost completely windless and has nice micro-climate.

The pond is situated along the old main road Maribor- Ljubljana and is surrounded with idyllic forests of the Pohorje mountain.

name: Ribniki Vinička vas
description: Ribolov je možen na ploščadih z mostom, na katerih lahko lovijo do 4 ribiči. Pri nas se lahko lovijo babuške, rdečeperke, krapi in ščuke. Ploščadi so delno tudi pokrite za primer dežja in v pokritem delu je miza in dve klopi.

name: Reka Rižana
description: Vas zanima kje loviti? Kje pustiti avto? Kakšno muho potrebujete? Kliknite tukaj in preberite brezplačen vodič po reki Rižani. Reka Rižana je značilna reka, ki teče od izvira do izliva v morje po slovenskem ozemlju. Izvira izpod kraško slavniške planote v bližini znamenite vasi Hrastovlje, znane po srednjeveških freskah. Rižana je dolga 14 km . V Rižani je avtohtona potočna postrv jadranskega fenotipa. Najdemo pa tudi soško postrv in križanca. Sicer, uradno je reka Rižana razdeljena na dva revirja, vendar za celotno reko velja enotna ribolovna dovolilnica.

en.name: The river Rižana
en.description: Do you want to know where to fish? Where to leave your car? What kind of of a fly do you need? Just click here and read for free the guide for the river Rižana. The river Rižana is a very characteristic river because it flows in slovenian territory from the spring to the outflow into the sea. Its spring is under the Kraško.-Slavniška plateau near the famous village Hrastovlje- it is well known due to medieval murals. The Rižana is 14 km long.You can find the indigenous brown trout of mediterranean phenotype here, as well as some marble trouts or hybrids. The river Rižana is officially divided into two districts but the single ticket is valid for the entire river.

subtitle: od izvira do izliva v Muro

subtitle: od mostu v Gaberju do izliva v Muro

index.subtitle: od mostu v Gaberju do izliva v Muro

en.subtitle: from the bridge in Gaberje to the outflow into the Mura

name: Reka Rupovščica
description:
Rečica Rupovščica zbira svoje povirne vode izpod zahodnega dela Storžiškega hribovja. izviri so na višinah od 600 do 1000 m/nadmorske višine. Največji pritoki, z leve strani izpod Storžiškega pogorja so Milka, Stražnica in Goričnica, z desne strani iz planote Udenboršt pa Želinski potok in Novaki. Zgornji tok od Golnika pa vse do sotočja s Stražnico pri Tenetišah se imenuje Parovnica, dol vodno do sotočja z Milko pri Bobovku pa se imenuje Kokrica in le spodnji del treh kilometrov, mimo Kokrice, Ilovke in Rupe se imenuje Rupovščica.

V delu vodotoka od izliva do jezu pri nekdanji žagi in mlinu na Ilovki je poleg potočnic, šarenk, klenov tudi precej lipanov. Nad jezom je najlepši in izredno težko dostopni kanjonski del vodotoka, pod nekdanjo žago na Kokrici pa so tolmuni globoki do 5 m. Na Kokrici so v vodi tudi ostriži, krapi , perke in oke, linji, ščuke in celo som.

en.name: The river Rupovščica
en.description:
The little river Rupovščica collects its waters from the west side of the Storžiško hribovje hills. The springs are on the 600 to 1000 m altitude. The biggest water inflows come from the Milka, the Stražnica and the Goričnica from the left side of the Storžiško hribovje hills, from the right side the ones that contribute the water are the Želinski stream and the Novaki, from the Udenboršt plateau.

We call the upper stream-from Golnik to the confluence with the Stražnica at Tenetiše -Parovnica, the area down the stream to the confluence with the Milka at Bobovek we call Kokrica, but only the last part of those three km , past Kokrica, Ilovka and Rupe is called Rupovščica.

In this part of the river- from the dam to the outflow at former mill- you can find a lot of graylings, besides brown trouts, rainbow trouts and chubs. Above the dam, there is the most beautiful part of the watercourse- the canyon- which is very hard to access. Underneath the former mill on Kokrica there are pools, up to 5 m deep. In the waters in Kokrica you can find percoidei, carps, roaches and common rudds , tenches, pikes and even catfish.

subtitle: Od izliva Črnega potoka do izliva Blanščice
description: Revir zajema dve akumulacijski jezeri hidroelektrarn. Voda je počasi tekoča. Globine so do 12 m. Zelo bogate vode s ciprinidi - podust, platnica, klen, mrena, ploščič, ogrica, zelenika… Zaradi obilja hrane so se močno razmnožile roparice, predvsem som, ščuka in smuč. Kapitalne primerke je moč uloviti zlasti v podslapju HE Boštanj in HE Blanca ter na izlivu reke Mirne. Dostopnost je odlična, ker so po obeh bregovih speljane utrjene vzdrževalne poti, zato lahko pridete z vsakim vozilom praktično do samega lovnega mesta. Na obrežju Save je več vstopnih mest, kjer lahko v vodo spustite tudi čoln.

en.description: This district consists of the power plant reservoirs. The water is running slow. The depths go up to 12 m. The water is rich in cyprinids - common nase, Danube roach, chub, barbel, common bream, vimba vimba fish, bleak...Due to plenty of food numerous predatory fish can be found, especially catfish, pike and zander. First class specimen can be caught foremost in the waterfalls of the hydropower plants Boštanj and Blanca and at the outflow of the river Mirna. The accessability is excellent due to well managed paths on the both banks and it is possible to reach your fishing spot with almost any vehicle. There are plenty access points on the banks of the Sava where you can even put the boat into the water.

description: Akumulacija HE Brežice je nastala zaradi novo zgrajene HE Brežice in se nahaja na mestu nekdanjih gramoznic Vrbina. V akumulacijskem jezeru so ujeli krapa, težkega 37.5 kg. Ujet in spuščen je bil aprila 2020. Revir se razteza od 1000 m pod Nuklearno elektrarno Krško (meja z RD Brestanica Krško) do 400 m nad HE Brežice. Znotraj revirja 20 se nahaja tekmovalna trasa (odsek na levem bregu akumulacijskega jezera med obema betonskima pomoloma), kjer je dovoljen le ribolov po načelu ujemi in spusti.

en.name: Sava 20 - accumulation lake, former Vrbina
en.description: The Brežice HPP reservoir was created due to the newly built Brežice HPP and is located on the site of the former Vrbina gravel pits. A carp weighing 37.5 kg was caught in the accumulation lake. He was caught and released in April 2020. The district stretches from 1000 m below the Krško Nuclear Power Plant (border with RD Brestanica Krško) to 400 m above the Brežice HPP. Within the district, there is a competition route (the section on the left bank of the accumulation lake between the two concrete piers), where only catch and release fishing is allowed.

name: Reka Sava
subtitle: od Rakovnika do potočka pred izlivom Tržiške Bistrice v Savo
description: Vas zanima kje loviti? Kje pustiti avto? Kakšno muho potrebujete? Kliknite tukaj in preberite brezplačen vodič po revirju Sava 4. Revir, ki sega od Rakovnika do izliva Tržiške Bistrice v reko Savo. V Revirju 4 sta že združeni Sava Dolinka in Sava Bohinjka. Skupni revir je dolg 23 km. Vsako leto v te revirje vložimo cca 20.000 dvoletni potočnih postrvi, vzgojenih v gojitvenih potokih, in cca 3000 kg šarenke. V revirju, s katerim upravlja RD Radovljica, bodo prišli na svoj račun ljubitelji divjine, neokrnjene narave, prelepih potočnic, lipana ter tudi kapitalnih naravnih šarenk.
