en.description: Do you want to know where to fish? Where to leave your car? What kind of of a fly do you need? Just click here and read for free the guide for the district Sava 4 The district, which extends from Rakovník to the outflow of the Tržiška Bistrica River into the Sava. The district 4 already unites the rivers Sava Dolinka and Sava Bohinjka-and the united district is 23 km long. Every year approximately 20,000 brown trouts -two years old-( that were grown in the breeding streams) are put into these districts along with approximately 3000 kg of rainbow trout. In this district, which is managed by RD Radovljica, the fans of wilderness will come to enjoy the unblemished nature, beautiful brown trouts, graylings as well as first class natural rainbow trouts.

name: Reka Sava
subtitle: Od Majdičevega jezu do pregrade HE Mavčiče, Trbojsko jezero, Mavčiče), reka Kokra
description:
Reka Sava priteče iz SZ dela Slovenije. Muharski del Save, s katerim upravlja RD Kranj se začenja pri Majdičevem jezu v Kranju in se konča pri mostu čez reko Savo pri tovarni Planika, 2 km nižje. V revir je vključena tudi reka Kokra od jezu HE Standard do sotočja s Savo v dolžini 200m. Revir je pravi raj za ribolov na salmonide, kjer si posebno mesto zaslužijo veliki lipani in postrvi. Reka je široka, z enim jezom, ter razgibanim reliefom, kjer se lahko preizkusite v lovu na suho muho, kot tudi težke potopke.

Od mostu pri tovarni Planika do jezu HE Mavčiče je akumulacijsko jezero, kjer se voda že nekoliko umiri in je zelo bogata z belo ribo, predvsem s podustjo in klenom. Ribolov si tu lahko privoščite tudi na urejeni tekmovalni trasi takoj na začetku revirja. Najpogosteje se tako tu lovi podusti in sicer na talni ribolov ali s plovcem. Jezero daje preživetje številnim roparicam, kot so ščuka, som in smuč, kjer v obilici hrane zrastejo do zavidljivih velikosti. Prav tako pa se na vijačenje lahko ujame velika šarenka ali potočna postrv. Ribolov na Savi je tako zelo raznolik, saj obsega muharjenje, vijačenje, talni ribolov in ribolov iz čolna, ujamete pa lahko tudi ribo vaših sanj. Najpogostejše vrste rib so potočna postrv, šareka, lipan, klen, podust, ščuka, linj, ostriž, krap, smuč, sulec, rdečeperka, rdečeoka, mrena in som.

en.name: The river Sava
en.subtitle: from the dam Majdičev jez to the barrier of the HEP Mavčiče,the lake Trbojsko jezero), and the river Kokra
en.description:
The river Sava comes from the north- west of Slovenia. The fly fishing district Sava, which is managed by RD Kranj, begins at the Majdičev dam in Kranj and ends at the bridge near the Planika factory, 2 km away. This district includes the river Kokra, too- from the dam of the hydropower plant Standard to the confluence with the Sava-200m. The district is really heaven for fishing of salmonids, especially for big graylings and trouts. The river is wide, with one dam and colourful landscape where you can try fishing with dry fly as well as with the heavy wet one.

From the bridge at the Planika factory to the hydropower plant Mavčiče there is a reservoir and its waters are pretty still and very rich in whitefish, especially common nases and chubs.You can fish here even in the organized and competitive way, right at the beginning of the district. The most common way to fish here is to fish for common nases- whether ground fishing or float fishing. The lake gives life to many predatory fish- mostly pike ,zander and catfish- which grow to remarkable sizes due to the plenty of food. If you jig, there is always a possibility to catch a large specimen of rainbow trouts or brown trouts. The fishing on the Sava varies: it may include fly fishing , jigging, ground fishing or boat angling and you can always catch the fish of your dreams. The most common fish are brown trouts, rainbow trouts, graylings, chubs, common nases,pikes, tenches, percoidei, carps, zanders, huchens, common rudds, roaches ,barbels and catfish.

name: Reka Sava - Zbiljsko jezero
subtitle: Od pregrade HE Mavčiče do pregrade HE Medvode
description: Po hidro centrali Mavčiče se tok Save ponovno nekoliko okrepi, vendar ga kmalu zaustavi drugo akumulacijsko jezero – Zbiljsko jezero. Jezero je še posebej v poletnih mesecih tudi lep turistični kraj, kjer je na levem bregu kamp Dragočajna, na desni pa čolnarna s spremljajočimi turističnimi objekti. Revir je znan predvsem po lovu ščuk, saj so bili tu ujeti rekordni primerki. Prav tako pa boste v jezeru lahko lovili podusti in velike postrvi. Najpogostejše vrste rib so šareka, klen, podust, ščuka, rdečeperka in rdečeoka.

en.subtitle: the river Sava
en.description: Soon after the hydropower plant Mavčiče the Sava's current gets stronger again, but it soon slows down because a reservoir Zbiljsko jezero stops it. The lake is a very nice tourist place to visit, especially in the summertime- on its left bank there is the camp Dragočajna, on its right bank you can find the boathouse with all the accompanying tourist objects. The district is well known for fishing of pikes because some first class pieces have been caught here. You can fish for common nases and big trouts as well. The most common fish to be caught are rainbow trouts, chubs, common nases, roaches and common rudds.

Mirnejši in globlji predeli pa so bogati s ciprinid na katere lahko beličarimo. Vse to le nekaj kilometrov stran od ljubljanskega vrveža.

name: Reka Sava Bohinjka
subtitle: od mostu pod Bohinjsko Bistrico do jezu v Soteski
description: Sava Bohinjka se muharju kaže kot prijazna alpska reka s smislom za praktičnost; skoraj v celotnem toku je dostopna z obeh bregov, zdaj s tega, zdaj z drugega brega in z nenevarnim prebredenjem. Iz dejstva, da izteka iz Bohinjskega jezera, izhaja, da je v primerjavi z zgornjimi tokovi drugih alpskih rek dobro prehranjena, lepo obrasla in osončena, zlasti na dolgih lipanskih pasažah. Muharju rada nakloni trofejne lipane in zelo barvite potočnice. Simpatično pragmatičnost izpričuje s tem, da drstenje dopušča šarenkam, ki tu zrastejo v prelepe mavrične ribe in trde bojevnice. Jutranji prijemi so tukaj previdni, v večerih visokega poletja, ko se lipanom pridružijo še postrvi, pa je večerni skok veličasten - muharju, ki mrzlično odšteva trenutke do stemnitve, kar travmatičen. Zato pa bo presenečen, ko bo ujel obilnega lipana sredi vročega poletnega dneva. Tičal bo na dnu močnega in globokega curka, brez pomisleka pa se bo pognal na velikega čarnika.

name: Sava Dolinka - trofejni revir Moste
subtitle: Od izliva potoka Javornik v Savo Dolinko do pregrade elektrarne v Mostah
description:
V tem revirju je največja verjetnost za kapitalni ulov. Ribolov je dovoljen z obale ali s plovnim pripomočkom t.i. belly boat-om (brez vseh vrst motornega pogona), po celotnem jezeru, do opozorilne table cca. 100 m pred spodnjo pregrado. Možnost ribolova z obale je v precejšnji meri odvisna od nivoja vodne gladine, ki v času deževja prekrije dostopne točke.

Revir je dostopen s ceste, ki vodi z Jesenic proti Žirovnici ali Jesenic proti Blejski Dobravi in poteka od sotočja Save Dolinke in potoka Javornik do pregrade elektrarne v Mostah. Vodna površina revirja znaša 60 ha.

index.subtitle: Od izliva potoka Javornik v Savo Dolinko do pregrade elektrarne v Mostah

en.name: The river Sava Dolinka - trophy district Moste
en.subtitle: from the confluence of the Sava Dolinka and the creek Javornik to the barrier of the power plant in Moste
en.description:
This district offers the strongest possibility of trophy catch. It is possible to fish even using a belly boat (without any kind of motorized propulsion) up to the sign for the power plant approximately 100 m before the lower barrier. The possibility of fishing from the shore largely depends on water levels - they can cover all the access points during the rain season.

You can access the district from the road that leads from Jesenice to Žirovnica or from Jesenice to Blejska Dobrava and it spreads from the confluence of the Sava Dolinka and the creek Javornik to the barrier of the power plant in Moste. The water surface of the district measures 60 ha.

name: Sava Dolinka
subtitle: Od mostu v Podkorenu do prodne pregrade na Javorniku), Bistrica
description: To je naš najdaljši ribolovni revir v dolžini 32km. Revir poteka ob cesti od Podkorena do Slovenskega Javornika. Celoten revir je sorazmerno lahko dostopen. Prednost zgornjega dela predstavlja čudovita narava z izjemno slikovito okolico, posebnost spodnjega dela, pa je tekmovalna trasa, ki je bila pred časom pripravljena za tekmo svetovnega prvenstva v muharjenju. Dodano vrednost revirju predstavlja potok Bistrica, ki teče skozi Mojstrano in je loven v spodnjem delu od slapu v Mojstrani do sotočja s Savo Dolinko. To je alpski potok, kjer je moč zaslediti avtohtono potočno postrv in šarenko. Dostop je možen skozi celotno vas.Pestrost celotnega revirja ponazarja prisotnost kapitalnih potočnih postrvi, šarenk, potočnih zlatovščic v zgornjem delu in lipana v spodnjem delu. Skupna vodna površina znaša 51.2ha.

index.name: Sava Dolinka
index.subtitle: Od mostu v Podkorenu do prodne pregrade na Javorniku), Bistrica

en.name: The river Sava Dolinka
en.subtitle: from the bridge in Podkoren to the pebble barrier in Javornik), the river Bistrica
en.description: This is our longest fishing beat, stretching 32 km. The beat runs along the road from Podkoren to Slovenski Javornik. The entire beat is relatively easy to access. The upper section stands out for its beautiful nature and exceptionally scenic surroundings, while the lower section is special for its competition course, which was prepared some time ago for a World Fly Fishing Championship event. Added value is provided by the Bistrica stream, which flows through Mojstrana and can be fished in the lower section from the waterfall in Mojstrana down to its confluence with the Sava Dolinka. This is an alpine stream where native brown trout and rainbow trout can be found. Access is possible throughout the entire village.The diversity of the whole beat is reflected in the presence of trophy-sized brown trout, rainbow trout, brook char in the upper section, and grayling in the lower section. The total water surface area is 51.2 ha.

name: Sava Dolinka
subtitle: Od pregrade v Mostah do sotočja s Savo Bohinjko), Radovna
description: To je najbolj slikovit predel ribjega življa v RD Jesenice. Začetek revirja se prične v bazenih pod pregrado HE Moste in zaključi na sotočju Save Dolinke in Save Bohinjke v Radovljici. Trasa vodotoka poteka skozi neokrnjeno naravo v dolini Piškovce, skozi povirja v Berjah in Lisicah ter mimo znamenitega Campa Šobec v Lescah. V vodi je moč zaslediti kapitalne potočne postrvi, šarenke, lipana, sulca, pa tudi klenu te vode niso tuje. Revir je dostopen z regionalne ceste Žirovnica, Lesce, Bled, Radovljica. Dodatno vrednost revirju predstavlja reka Radovna, ki je lovna od spodnje pregrade MHE Vintgar do sotočja s Savo Dolinko. Globoki tolmuni dajejo zavetje divji potočni postrvi in šarenki. Dostop z zgornje strani je možen mimo pokopališča na Blejski Dobravi, s spodnje strani pa mimo HE Moste. Skupna vodna površina znaša 39,95ha. Za ribolov Sulca velja poseben ribolovni režim ter posebna ribolovna dovolilnica.

en.subtitle: from the barrier in Moste to the confluence with the Sava Bohinjka river), the river Radovna
en.description:
It is the most pictureque area in fish life in the RD Jesenice.

The district begins in the pools under the hydropower plant Moste and concludes just before the confluence of the Sava Dolinka and the Sava Bohinjka in Radovljica. The route of this water basin runs through the unspoilt nature in the valley Piškovce, through rapids in Berje and Lisice and through the famous camp Šobec in Lesce. You can trace some first class specimen of brown, rainbow and brook trouts, graylings and huchens but even some chubs are not strangers to these waters.

The access to this district is mostly from the local road Žirovnica, Lesce, Bled, Radovljica and it spreads from the barrier in Moste to the confluence with the Sava Bohinjka in Radovljica. The water surface measures 39,1 ha.

The fishing for huchen falls under special fishing regime and has a special fishing licence.

name: Ribniki RD Straža-Sava
description: Ribniki pri domu ribičev RD Sava-Straža nudijo razburljiv ribolov krapovcev in ščuk po ugodni ceni dovolilnic.

en.name: The ponds of the RD Straža-Sava
en.description: The ponds near the fishing lodge of the RD Straža-Sava offer exciting fishing for carps and pikes for very reasonable ticket prices.

name: Potok Savica
description: Savica je potok, ki ga sestavljajo številni tolmuni in brzice in se izliva v Bohinjsko jezero. Naseljen je s potočno postrvjo in šarenko.

name: Reka Savinja
subtitle: od Grušovlje do Letuša
description: Revir Savinja, s katerim upravlja RD Mozirje se začne na Grušoveljskem jezu pri vasi Grušovlje in se konča na mostu preko Savinje v vasi Letuš. Dolg je 15,2 km. Povprečna globina Savinje v revirju je med 0,5 in 1,5 m, razen v tolmunih in pod jezovi. Dno je lapornato ali pokrito z gramoznimi nanosi apnenca. V revirju se brzice izmenjujejo z mirnejšimi odseki reke. Reka je široka med 25 do 40 m. povprečni pretok znaša 7 m3/s, povprečna temperatura je 7 st.C. Brežine so poraščene z obrečno vegetacijo. Od grušoveljskega jeza do Spodnje rečice se Savinja vije po široki strugi preko prodnatih nanosov, na posameznih mestih pa ustvarja tolmune. Ob Sp. Rečice do Letuša je struga reke stabilnejša, izmenjujejo se tolmuni z vtočnimi in iztočnimi brzicami in mirnejši predeli. V revirju je pet jezov. Revir nudi odlične pogoje za muharjenje. Prisotne so vse vrste salmonidov (potočna postrv, lipan, šarenka, sulec) in nekatere ciprinidne vrste (mrena, klen).

index.name: Reka Savinja
index.subtitle: od Grušovlje do Letuša

en.name: The river Savinja
en.subtitle: from Grušovlje to Letuš
en.description: The district Savinja, which is managed by RD Mozirje starts at Grušovlje dam in the village Grušovlje and ends at the bridge across the Savinja in the village Letuš. The average depth of the Savinja in this district is between 0,5 and 1,5 m, except in pools and below dams. The bottom is marl or covered with gravel limestone.The current changes in this district; the rapid parts are followed by still waters. The river is between 25 and 40 m wide.. The average flowrate is 7m3/s, the average temperature is 7C. The banks are covered with river vegetation. From the Grušovlje dam to Spodnja Rečica the Savinja makes a wide channel across the pebbled ground and makes pools alongside. From Spodnja Rečica to Letuš is the river channel more stable; inflowing and outflowing rapids are followed by still waters. This district has five dams. It offers excellent conditions for fly fishing. You can find all the salmonid species ( brown trout, grayling, rainbow trout, huchen) as well as some cyprinids ( barbel, chub).

name: Reka Savinja
subtitle: od mostu v Petrovčah do približno 600 m dolvodno od kolesarskega mostu v Tremerjih
description:
Savinja je reka, katere porečje poteka večinoma po Zgornji in Spodnji Savinjski dolini ter ima svoj tok tudi mimo mesta Celje. Je najdaljša reka, ki teče izključno po ozemlju Slovenije. Reka Savinja je v našem opravljanju od mostu v Petrovčah do betonskega kanala na desnem bregu Savinje približno 600 m dolvodno od kolesarskega mostu v Tremerjih, kjer je tudi meja z ribiško družino Laško.

V delu Savinje, kjer z njo upravlja RD Celje, boste svoj trenutek našli vsi ljubitelji muharjenja ter beličarji, ki uživate v ribolovu s plovcem. V Savinji vas pri lovu na muho pričakujejo potočne postrvi in šarenke, pri beličarski tehniki pa tudi podust, klen, platnica, krap, mrena, ogrica ipd...

index.name: Reka Savinja
index.subtitle: od mostu v Petrovčah do približno 600 m dolvodno od kolesarskega mostu v Tremerjih

en.name: The river Savinja
en.subtitle: from the bridge in Petrovče to about 600 m downstream from the bicycle bridge in Tremerje
en.description:
The river Savinja runs mostly through the valley Upper and Lower Savinjska dolina and passes the city of Celje. It is the longest river that runs exclusively on the slovenian teritory. We manage the Savinja from the bridge in Petrovče to the concrete channel on the right bank of the Savinja, about 600 m downstream from the bicycle bridge in Tremerje - where we border with the RD Laško.

In this part of the Savinja - managed by the RD Celje - all the fans of fly fishing and of float fishing will have their moment. Brown and rainbow trouts are waiting for you in the Savinja while you fly fish and common nases, chubs, danube roaches, carps, barbels, vimba vimba fish ... while float fishing.

name: Reka Savinja
subtitle: 600 m dolvodno od kolesarskega mostu v Tremerjih do Cestnega mostu v Zidanem mostu
description:
Celoten revir poteka od viadukta v Tremerjih do Cestnega mostu v Zidanem mostu. Savinja je zelo pestra in razgibana reka. Bogata je z veliko vrst rib in nudu ribičem obilo športnega užitka, še posebej pri lovu ciprinidov s plovcem.

Znamenita posebnost revirja je ribolovni del ujemi in spusti, ki poteka skozi mesto Laško in je na njem urejena tudi tekmovalna trasa. Revir je kratek in izredno bogat z ribami. Ribolovni del, v katerem velja režim ujemi in spusti, poteka od mostu v kraju Jagoče (pri Petrolu) do železniškega mostu v Laškem.

index.name: Reka Savinja
index.subtitle: 600 m dolvodno od kolesarskega mostu v Tremerjih do Cestnega mostu v Zidanem mostu

en.name: The river Savinja
en.subtitle: 600m downstream from the bicycle bridge in Tremerje to the road bridge in Zidani most
en.description:
The whole district expands from the viaduct in Tremerje to the road bridge in Zidani most. The Savinja is very dynamic river and its stream varies a lot. It is rich in various fish species and offers a lot of fun to all the fishermen - especially while float fishing for cyprinids .

The special feature of this district is the fishing part Catch and release that runs through the city of Laško and has competitopn route arranged. The district is short but extremely rich in fish. The district with valid Catch and release system spreads from the bridge in Jagoče ( at Petrol gas station) to the railroad bridge in Laško .

name: Reka Savinja
subtitle: od Letuškega mostu do Izliva Bolske v Savinjo
description: Vas zanima kje loviti? Kje pustiti avto? Kakšno muho potrebujete? Kliknite tukaj in preberite brezplačen vodič po reki Savinji - RD Šempeter. Revir Savinja 6, ki je pod upravljanjem RD Šempeter, se razteza od Letuškega mostu do izliva Bolske v Savinjo v dolžini 11,5 km. Na tem delu Savinje lahko najdemo raznolike vrste rib: velike sulce, krasne potočne postrvi, borbene šarenke, lipane, platnice, klene, mrene in podusti. Dovoljeno je muharjenje ali beličarjenje.

index.name: Reka Savinja
index.subtitle: od Letuškega mostu do Izliva Bolske v Savinjo

en.name: The river Savinja
en.subtitle: from the bridge in Letuš to the outflow of the Bolska into the Savinja
en.description: The district Savinja 6 is managed by the RD Šempeter and it extends from the bridge in Letuš to the outflow of the Bolska into the Savinja; it is 11,5km long.In this part of the Savinja various fish species can be found: big huchens, beautiful brown trouts, feisty rainbow trouts, graylings, Danube roaches, chubs, barbels and common nases. It is allowed to fly fish or to float fish.

name: Reka Savinja
subtitle: od izliva Bolske do mostu v Kasazah), kanal Podvinska struga
description: Vas zanima kje loviti? Kje pustiti avto? Kakšno muho potrebujete? Kliknite tukaj in preberite brezplačen vodič po reki Savinji - RD Šempeter. V revir Savinja 7 spada poleg Savinje od sotočja z Bolsko do mostu v Kasazah tudi del Podvinske struge od črpališča v Vrbju do izliva v Savinjo. V tem delu z reko upravlja RD Šempeter, ki z dolgoletno tradicijo skrbi za ribji živelj v reki. Reka vam ponuja odlične muharske izzive na salmonide potočne postrvi, lipane, šarenke. Lahko pa beličarite ciprinide, kot so: mrene, kleni, platnice in podusti.

index.name: Reka Savinja
index.subtitle: od izliva Bolske do mostu v Kasazah), kanal Podvinska struga

en.name: The river Savinja
en.subtitle: from the outflow of the Bolska to the bridge in Kasaze), the channel Podvinska struga
en.description: The district Savinja 7 consists of the Savinja from the outflow of the Bolska to the bridge in Kasaze and ncludes the part of the channel Podvinska struga from the pumping station in Vrbje to its outflow into the Savinja. The RD Šempeter manages this part of the river and takes care of the aquatic life for a very long time. The river offers you some great challanges in fly fishing for salmonids: brown trouts, graylings, rainbow trouts. You can fly fish or float fish for cyprinids as well: feisty barbels, chubs, Danube roaches and common nases.

name: Odtočni kanal HE Zlatoličje - SD1
description:
Razmeroma hitro tekoča voda, primerna predvsem za talni ribolov. Posebej še ob nedeljah je zjutraj vodostaj nizek, voda pa počasi tekoča. Površina tega revirja je cca 33 ha.

Dno in nabrežine kanala so prodnati. Na dnu je precej školjk, v katere so pogosto zaplete vrvica. Ker je dno poraščeno z algami, je voda primerna za življenje podusti, mren, ogric, klenov … Z obeh strani kanala je dostop mogoč kar s ceste, ki je cca 10 metrov od vodne površine.

en.name: The drain of the hydropower plant Zlatoličje-SD1
en.description:
This district's waters are relatively fast and are appropriate mostly for the ground fishing. The waters runs slow and the watercourse is low especially on Sunday mornings. The total surface of this district is 33ha.

The bottom and the banks of this canal are pebbled. There are lots of shells on the bottom where your fishing line might entangle. Due to the bottom covered with algae the water is suitable home mostly to common nases, barbels, vimba vimba fish,chubs....You can access both sides of the canal from the road which is only approximately 10m far from the water.

name: Reka Selška Sora
subtitle: od soteske Konjski brod do Okornevega jezu nad sotočjem obeh Sor
description: Selška Sora je prelepa hudourniška reka, salmonidnega značaja. Dolina reke je tesna, pobočja pa so strma in visoka. Voda šumi čez skale, vijuga skozi dolino in se zaustavlja v bistrih tolmunih. Rečno strugo, ki je še na precejšnem delu v naravnem stanju, sestavljajo peščenjak, konglomerat, apnenec in triasni dolomit. Reka je dobro zastopana s šarenko, lipanom in klenom, od časa do časa pa se ujame tudi potočna postrv.

index.name: Reka Selška Sora
index.subtitle: od soteske Konjski brod do Okornevega jezu nad sotočjem obeh Sor

en.name: The river Selška Sora
en.subtitle: from the canyon Konjski brod to the dam Okornov jez above the confluence of both Sora rivers
en.description: Selška Sora is a beautiful torrential river of a salmonid character. The valley of the river is tight and the slopes are steep and high. The water flows across the rocks, wanders through the valley and stops in clear pools. The riverbed, which is still in considerable part in its natural state, consists of sandstone, conglomerate, limestone and triassic dolomite. The river is well represented with rainbow trout, grayling and chub, and from time to time, a brown trout is caught.

name: Potok Skrabska
description: Mešani revir ponuja zanimiv športni ribolov krapovcev in plenilk, upoštevajoč varstvene dobe, skozi celo leto.

en.name: Brook Skrabska
en.description: The mixed district offers interesting sport fishing for cyprinids and predators, taking into account the protection periods, throughout the year.

name: Slivniško jezero
description: Slivniško jezero je nastalo kot posledica izgradnje pregrade Tratna leta 1976. Že v naslednjem letu je ribji živelj postal pod upravljanjem ribiške družinje Voglajna. V jezero so naselili razne ribe: amur, androga, babuška, bolen, jez, klen, koreselj, krap, linj, ostriž, ploščič, podust, rdečeoka, rdečeperka, smuč, som, ščuka, tolstolobik in zelenika. Vse so se izredno dobro prijele, saj jezero z obilo trstičja nudi veliko hrane vsem ribam. V novembra 2013 je bila ujeta tukaj največja sladkovodna riba na slovenskem in sicer som dolžine 255 in težak kar 95 kg.

en.name: The lake Slivniško jezero
en.description: The lake Slivniško jezero was made in 1976 when the barrier Tratna was built. The fishing family Voglajna has started managing the fishlife in the following year. Many different fish species were put in the lake: grass carp, silver bream, gibel carp, asp, ide, chub, crucian carp, carp, tench, perch, common bream, common nase, common roach, common rudd, zander, catfish, pike, silver carp and bleak. They all adapted pretty well due to the plenty of food the reed offers. In November 2013 the largest freshwater fish in Slovenia has been caught here. it was a catfish, 255 cm long and 95kg heavy.

name: Slomski potok
subtitle: od sotočja z Zagrajskim potokom do izliva v Voglajno
description: V Slomski potok redno migrirajo ribe iz reke Voglajne. Tako v Slomskem potoku lahko uspešno lovite :ploščič, babuška, klen, platnica, krap, linj, ostriž, podust, pohra, rdečeoka, rdečeperka, smuč, ščuka, zelenika Seveda ne manjkajo niti roparice: smuč in ščuka.

index.name: Slomski potok
index.subtitle: od sotočja z Zagrajskim potokom do izliva v Voglajno

en.name: The creek Slomski potok
en.subtitle: from the confluence with the creek Zagrajski potok to the outflow into the Voglajna
en.description: The fish from the Voglajna migrate to the creek Slomski potok on regular basis. You can successfully fish for common breams, gibel carps, chubs, Danube roaches, carps, tenches, perches, common nases, Mediterranean barbels, common rudds, common roaches and bleaks here. You may catch some predatory fish as well, mostly zanders and pikes.

name: Reka Soča
subtitle: od mostu pri hišni številki Trenta 1 do mostu v vasi Čezsoča
description: Ribič, domačin ali tujec, ki zakorači v azurno modrino Soče, ki teče čez slepeče bele prodnike, se sicer zave banalne okoliščine, da se dotika reke, v kateri lovi ribe. A to je tudi reka, ki je naredila prostor sebi in ribiču, da lahko njegov pogled navzgor po strmih pobočjih odkriva, kako mogočna je bila njena moč skozi tisočletja. Vznesenost minevanja in brezčasnosti. In trenutki potešitve v popolni lepoti. Postrvi tu pridejo iz skrivališč na plano šele tik pod večer, a izbirčne tedaj niso preveč. Lipane pa, kakor da so prosojni, izdajajo komaj vidni odtenki rožnatih repov, rasno čisti lipani pa so pri tleh sploh nevidni. Če pa jih muhar le odkrije na ležišču, se na zadosti vztrajno ponujanje nazadnje dvignejo, a brez velike naglice, nekako ležerno. Tudi sredi dneva. Poleti pa je vsekakor treba počakati ne večerni skok.

index.subtitle: od mostu pri hišni številki Trenta 1 do mostu v vasi Čezsoča
index.clubName: Ribiška družina Zavod za ribištvo Slovenije

en.name: The river Soča
en.subtitle: from the bridge near the address Trenta 1 to the bridge in the village Čezsoča

name: Reka Soča
subtitle: od izliva potoka Vogršček do meje z Italijo
description: Dolina smaragdne reke s prečudovito naravo. Ta revir predstavlja srednji del reke Soče s katerim upravlja RD Soča Nova Gorica. V tem delu Soče je mogoče videti vse oblike reke od tekočih brzic, tolmunov, mirnešje vode pa do globokih akumulacijskih jezer, kjer je dovoljen tudi ribolov s čolnom. Je tudi edini revir na reki Soči, kjer je dovoljeno tudi vijačenje na soško velikanko. Poleg avtohtone soške postrvi je še pester spekter ostalih ribolovnih ribjih vrst: križanci (potočna p. x soška p.), potočne postrvi, lipani, šarenke, ne manjka pa tudi kapitalnih štrkavcev (klenov) in grb (mren).

index.name: Reka Soča
index.subtitle: od izliva potoka Vogršček do meje z Italijo

en.name: The river Soča
en.subtitle: from the outflow of the creek Vogršček to the state border with Italy
en.description: The valley of the emerald river with beautiful nature. This district is the middle course of the river Soča, managed by the RD Soča. You can find all the water varieties here: flowing rapids, pools, stiller waters and even a deep lake where it is possible to fish from boat. It is the only district on the river Soča where it is allowed to spin fish for giant marble trout. Besides the indigenous marble trout you can find wide spectrum of fish here: hybrids, brown trouts, graylings, rainbow trouts and even some first class specimens of european chubs and italian barbels.

name: Reka Soča
subtitle: od mostu v vasi Čezsoča do izliva Tolminke
description: Soča sodi med najlepše evropske reke in je prepoznana kot naravni biser. Slovi kot zelo čista reka s čudovito izrazito smaragdno barvo. Izvira v Trenti na nadmorski višini 990 metrov v Triglavskem narodnem parku in se po 138 kilometrih v Tržaškem zalivu izlije v Jadransko morje. RDT upravlja njen del od mostu v Čezsoči do vtoka potoka Vogrščka pod jezom za HE Doblar. Celoten zgornji tok Soče od izvira do Tolmina je vključen v varstveno območje Natura 2000. Sočo naseljujejo predvsem postrvi: soška, ponekod še vedno njeni križanci in izjemoma potočna postrv ter šarenke za podporo športnemu ribolovu, potočni glavač, od sotočja z Lepeno navzdol pa tudi že lipan. Odvisno od zime je lahko Soča zaradi taljenja snega snežnica tudi do poletja. Po mirnem toku po bovški kotlini se Soča pod Srpenico spusti v divji tok med skalami in preko brzic, zajema sapo v globokih tolmunih ter se pri Kobaridu umiri, da se nato med belimi sipinami mehko pretaka proti Tolminu. Pod Kobaridom se ribjim vrstam, ki naseljujejo reko Sočo, pridružijo še štrkavec, grba, primorski blistavec, pisanec, mrenič in posamezni linji. Na celotnem delu pa lahko najdemo tudi laškega koščaka. Po združitvi s Tolminko se Soča vlije v akumulacijsko jezero za HE Doblar. Do jezu v Podselu je dolgo kar sedem kilometrov. V globinah jezera živijo največje soške postrvi, bogato pa je tudi z vsemi ostalimi ribjimi vrstami. Od jezu v Podselu do potoka Vogršček, kjer zapusti naš ribiški okoliš, ostane Soči še 1,3-kilometra precej siromašne podobe, saj je večina vode po ceveh speljana v elektrarno in struga sameva bolj prazna.

index.subtitle: od mostu v vasi Čezsoča do izliva Tolminke

en.name: The river Soča
en.subtitle: from the bridge in Čezsoča to the outflow of the Tolminka
en.description: The Soča is one of the most beautiful rivers in Europe and it is a true pearl of nature. It is famous for its clear waters and dazzling emerald colour. The source of the river is in the heart of the Triglav National Park, the Trenta valley, at the altitude of 990 m. After it covers the distance of 138 km, it enters the Adriatic Sea at the Gulf of Trieste. RDT manages a section of the river from the bridge at the village of Čezsoča to the confluence with the Vogršček stream below the dam of the HPP Doblar. The entire upper stretch of the Soča from its source to Tolmin belongs to the European nature protection area Natura 2000. The Soča is mainly inhabited by trout: marble trout, marble trout crossbreeds, the occasional brown trout and rainbow trout to support recreational fishing. The river is also home to Padanian goby and, downstream from the confluence with the Lepena stream, grayling as well. Depending on the winter and the amount of snow, the Soča may be a snowmelt river until summer. Following its gentle current in the Bovec basin, it enters a stretch of deep gorges and rapids below the village of Srpenica. As it reaches Kobarid, the flow becomes gentler again and winds its way slowly towards Tolmin. At Kobarid, the fish inhabiting the Soča are joined by Adriatic chub, Italian barbel, Leuciscus souffia muticellus, common minnow, Barbus meridionalis caninus and a few tench. Throughout the river’s course, one can also encounter Austropotamobius italicus. After joining the Tolminka, the Soča enters the reservoir of the HPP Doblar. The reservoir stretches for some 7 km to the dam at Podselo. The depths of the reservoir are home to the largest specimen of marble trout as well as numerous other fish species. The section of the river from the dam at Podselo to the Vogršček stream, where it leaves our fishing district, is rather humble. The Soča covers a distance of 1.3 km in this part, but mainly runs through the pipes leading to the power plant, leaving behind an almost empty river bed.

Od jezu v Podselu do potoka Vogršček, kjer zapusti naš ribiški okoliš, ostane Soči še 1,3-kilometra precej siromašne podobe, saj je večina vode po ceveh speljana v elektrarno in struga sameva bolj prazna.

en.name: The Soča River - lake
en.subtitle: from the confluence of the Tolminka and Bača rivers to the dam in Podselo
en.description: The Soča is one of the most beautiful rivers in Europe and it is a true pearl of nature. It is famous for its clear waters and dazzling emerald colour. The source of the river is in the heart of the Triglav National Park, the Trenta valley, at the altitude of 990 m. After it covers the distance of 138 km, it enters the Adriatic Sea at the Gulf of Trieste. RDT manages a section of the river from the bridge at the village of Čezsoča to the confluence with the Vogršček stream below the dam of the HPP Doblar. The entire upper stretch of the Soča from its source to Tolmin belongs to the European nature protection area Natura 2000. The Soča is mainly inhabited by trout: marble trout, marble trout crossbreeds, the occasional brown trout and rainbow trout to support recreational fishing. The river is also home to Padanian goby and, downstream from the confluence with the Lepena stream, grayling as well. Depending on the winter and the amount of snow, the Soča may be a snowmelt river until summer. Following its gentle current in the Bovec basin, it enters a stretch of deep gorges and rapids below the village of Srpenica. As it reaches Kobarid, the flow becomes gentler again and winds its way slowly towards Tolmin. At Kobarid, the fish inhabiting the Soča are joined by Adriatic chub, Italian barbel, Leuciscus souffia muticellus, common minnow, Barbus meridionalis caninus and a few tench. Throughout the river’s course, one can also encounter Austropotamobius italicus. After joining the Tolminka, the Soča enters the reservoir of the HPP Doblar. The reservoir stretches for some 7 km to the dam at Podselo. The depths of the reservoir are home to the largest specimen of marble trout as well as numerous other fish species. The section of the river from the dam at Podselo to the Vogršček stream, where it leaves our fishing district, is rather humble. The Soča covers a distance of 1.3 km in this part, but mainly runs through the pipes leading to the power plant, leaving behind an almost empty river bed.

name: Reka Soča
subtitle: od jezu v Podselu do pritoka Vogršček
description: Soča sodi med najlepše evropske reke in je prepoznana kot naravni biser. Slovi kot zelo čista reka s čudovito izrazito smaragdno barvo. Izvira v Trenti na nadmorski višini 990 metrov v Triglavskem narodnem parku in se po 138 kilometrih v Tržaškem zalivu izlije v Jadransko morje. RDT upravlja njen del od mostu v Čezsoči do vtoka potoka Vogrščka pod jezom za HE Doblar. Celoten zgornji tok Soče od izvira do Tolmina je vključen v varstveno območje Natura 2000. Sočo naseljujejo predvsem postrvi: soška, ponekod še vedno njeni križanci in izjemoma potočna postrv ter šarenke za podporo športnemu ribolovu, potočni glavač, od sotočja z Lepeno navzdol pa tudi že lipan. Odvisno od zime je lahko Soča zaradi taljenja snega snežnica tudi do poletja. Po mirnem toku po bovški kotlini se Soča pod Srpenico spusti v divji tok med skalami in preko brzic, zajema sapo v globokih tolmunih ter se pri Kobaridu umiri, da se nato med belimi sipinami mehko pretaka proti Tolminu. Pod Kobaridom se ribjim vrstam, ki naseljujejo reko Sočo, pridružijo še štrkavec, grba, primorski blistavec, pisanec, mrenič in posamezni linji. Na celotnem delu pa lahko najdemo tudi laškega koščaka. Po združitvi s Tolminko se Soča vlije v akumulacijsko jezero za HE Doblar. Do jezu v Podselu je dolgo kar sedem kilometrov. V globinah jezera živijo največje soške postrvi, bogato pa je tudi z vsemi ostalimi ribjimi vrstami. Od jezu v Podselu do potoka Vogršček, kjer zapusti naš ribiški okoliš, ostane Soči še 1,3-kilometra precej siromašne podobe, saj je večina vode po ceveh speljana v elektrarno in struga sameva bolj prazna.

name: Reka Sora
subtitle: od Okornovega jezu nad sotočjem obeh Sor do jezu v Goričanah
description: Reka Sora nastane z združitvijo Selške in Poljanske Sore v Škofji Loki. Spada v skupino salmonidnih voda, saj je razmeroma čista in hitro tekoča. Strugo prepletajo globoki tolmuni, brzice in prelivi. Ljudje v preteklosti niso veliko posegali vanjo, zaradi odmaknjenosti od naselij in izrazito hudourniškega značaja. Reka Sora ponuja raznovrsten ribolov, poln izzivov, ki očara marsikaterega ribiča. Posebno zanimiv je jesensko-zimski sulčelov, in ribolov lipana. Poleg lipana in sulca lahko v reki uspešno lovimo tudi klena, mreno, podust, šarenko in potočno postrv. V tem revirju je mogoč tudi ribolov sulca. Za ribolov sulca se prosimo obrnite na RD Sora (kontakt).

index.name: Reka Sora
index.subtitle: od Okornovega jezu nad sotočjem obeh Sor do jezu v Goričanah

en.name: The river Sora
en.subtitle: from the dam Okornov jez above the confluence of both Sora rivers to the dam in Goričane
en.description: The Sora River is formed by the merger of Selška and Poljanska Sora in Škofja Loka. It belongs to the group of salmonid waters because it is relatively pure and rapidly flowing. The river bed is intertwined with deep pools, rapids and overpasses. In the past, people did not encroach much on it, because of the distance from the settlements and the extremely torrential character. The Sora River offers a diversified fishing full of challenges that fascinate many fishermen. Especially interesting is the autumn-winter huchen fishing and the grayling fishing. In addition to the grayling and huchen, the river in interesting for fishing the chub, barbel, nase, rainbow trout and brown trout. Huchen fishing is also possible in this district. For huchen fishing please contact RD Sora (contact).

name: Reka Sora
subtitle: Od jezu v Goričanah do zadnjega jezu pred izlivom v Savo
description: Sora pred izlivom v Savo ponuja ribiču beličarske predvsem pa muharske izzive. Muharjenje na Sori je zelo raznoliko. Reka sama ponuja številne brzice, pltivine in tolmune, zato ne preseneča če pod vsakim grmom zagledamo kakšno velikanko. Reka nudi idealen habitat za postrvi, mrene in klene.

index.name: Reka Sora

en.name: The river Sora
en.subtitle: from the dam in Goričane to the last dam before its outflow into the Sava).
en.description: Just before its outflow into the river Sava, the river Sora offers its fishermen float fishing but mostly fly fishing challanges. Fly fishing on the Sora varies; the river offers numerous rapids, shallows and pools so it is no surprise to find some extra large fish under every bush. The river is ideal home to trouts, barbels and chubs.

name: Reka Sotla
subtitle: od izvira do mostu v Orešju
description: Reka Sotla izvira v južnem vznožju Maclja v treh izvirih. Zaradi svojega počasnega toka nudi dobre življenske pogoje za krape, amurje, linje, tolstolobike, mrene, ploščiče, bolene, babuške, ščuke, smuče, jeze in posebnost jesetre.

index.name: Reka Sotla

en.name: The river Sotla
en.subtitle: from the spring to the bridge in Orešje
en.description: The river Sotla springs in three places in the southern foot of the mountain Macelj. Due to its slow current, it offers very comforable living conditions for carps, grass carps, silver carps, barbels, common breams, asps, gibel carps, pikes, zanders, ides and sturgeons ( which are the special feature of this area).

name: Reka Sotla
subtitle: Od mostu v Orešju do državne meje pri Sp. Rigonce
description: Reka Sotla teče ob meji med Slovenijo in Hrvaško. Ob njenih bregovih so številne naravne in kulturne lepote. Lažje dostopna je le v okolici naselij in naravnem parku Jovsi pri Dobovi. V njej plavajo kleni, platnice, krapi, mrene in kapitalne ščuke.

index.name: Reka Sotla

en.name: The river Sotla
en.subtitle: from the bridge in Orešje to the state border in Spodnje Rigonce
en.description: The river Sotla runs along the state border between Slovenia and Croatia. It encounters many natural and cultural beauties on its journey. It is easier to access it in the vicinity of the settlements and in landscape park Jovsi near Dobova. The Sotla is home to chubs, Danube roaches, carps, barbels and some first class pikes.

name: Jezero Stara jama
description: V revirju je dovoljen le ribolov po načelu ujemi in spusti!

name: Potok Studena
description: Potok Studena je najbolj obiskana salmonidna športno-ribolovna voda v našem revirju. Zaradi izrazitih meandrov in številnih tolmunov, ki jih potok dela v svojem srednjem toku, je ribolov potočne postrvi zanimiv in poseben ribiški izziv.

en.name: The creek Studena
en.description: The creek Studena is the most visited salmonid water for recreational fishing in our district. Due to prominent meanders and numerous pools made by the creek itself in its middle stream, the fishing for brown trouts is an interesting and special challenge.

name: Reka Suhodolnica
description:
Reka Suhadolnica predstavlja glavni vir pitne vode za Slovenjegraško kotlino, kar pomeni, da je reka v zgornjem delu izredno čista. V tem delu reku lahko najdemo celo ogroženega potočnega raka. Struktura tal je apnenčasta in kamnita.

Reka v svojem spodnjem toku ustvarja številne tolmune ter manjše brzice, v katerih plavajo potočne ter ameriške postrvi.

en.name: The river Suhodolnica
en.description:
The river Suhodolnica is the main source of drinking water for the Slovenj Gradec basin due to its extra clear upper stream. Even the endangered species can be found here, especially freshwater crayfish. The bottom is lime and stone.

The river creates numerous pools in its lower course as well as smaller rapids where brown and brook trouts live.

The entire district spreads from the little reservoir Kovač to the outflow into the river Mislinja but it is divided according to the fishing system : catch and take part - from the little reservoir Kovač to the road bridge for Kotlje and trophy part ( catch and release) from the road bridge for Kotlje to the outflow into the river Mislinja.

name: Potok Sušica
description: Sušica je dolg, precej »muhast« potok in, kot že samo ime pove, velikokrat presuši. Ker večinoma teče po kraškem terenu, na določenih mestih ponikne in je struga suha. Pojav je izrazitejši v poletnih mesecih ter ob pomanjkanju padavin. Za ribolov je zanimiv predvsem odsek od vodnega zajetja pod vasjo Dol do ribogojnice v Podbočju.

en.name: The creek Sušica
en.description: The creek Sušica is long but rather "whimsical" creek that dries up often ( the word suša means drought in Slovenian, hence the name of the creek). It runs mostly through the karst terrain, often goes underground and leaves the channel dry. This happens more often in the summer months or when the precipitations are scarce. The most interesting part to fish in is from the reservoir below the village Dol to the fish farm in Podbočje.

subtitle: od Žihlave do izteka v reko Muro
description: Reka Ščavnica je zelo bogata s ciprinidi, saj iz Gajševskega jezera ob visokih vodah v Ščavnico uide zelo veliko rib, predvsem krapov, srebrnih koresljev,rdečeok, ščuk, smučev in drugih, iz Mure pa tudi občasno ob visokih vodah prihajajo podusti, ogrice, kleniči in kleni. Reka Ščavnica je v celoti regulirana reka, zato za ribiče ni preveč zanimiva in atraktivna, čeprav je bogata z ribjim življem. Obišče jo največ ribičev, ki so navdušeni nad beličarjenjem, pa tudi nekaj ribičev, ki vijačijo.

en.name: The river Ščavnica
en.subtitle: from Žihlava to the outflow into the river Mura
en.description: The river Ščavnica is very rich in cyprinids due to the facts that large number of fish runs from the lake Gajševsko jezero into the Ščavnica when the waters are high - mostly carps, silver carps, roaches, pikes, zanders and others and from the river Mura sometimes - also when the water are high - common nases, vimba vimba fish, common daces and chubs come to the Ščavnica as well. The river is entirely regulated and it isn't very interesting or attractive for fishermen although it is very rich in fish life. The most frequent visitors are fishermen who love to float fish and some who spin fish.

name: Škalsko jezero
description: V jezeru prevladuje krap, smuč ter ščuka. Jezero pa je znano po kapitalnih somih dolžine nad 2 m in kapitalni krapih.

en.name: The lake Škalsko jezero
en.description: The lake is home mostly to carps, zanders and pikes. But it is also well known for its first class specimens of catfish-some over 2m long- and carps.

name: Škofeljski graben
subtitle: od jarka v Novih talih do izliva v Iščico
description: Škofeljski graben je manjši vodotok na vzhodnem delu Ljubljanskega barja; teče od Škofljice in se izliva v Iščico. Kljub majhnosti bo previdni ribič v njem lahko ujel klene, krape, ščuke in manjše predstavnike krapovcev.

index.name: Škofeljski graben

en.name: The district Škofeljski graben
en.description: The Škofeljski graben is a small watercourse on the east side of the bog Ljubljansko barje , it runs from Škofljica and then flows into the Iščica. Despite its small size, a careful angler will be able to catch chub, carp, pike and smaller representatives of cyprinids in it.

name: Šmartinsko jezero
description:
V jezeru so ujeli krapa, težkega 34.6 kg. Ujet in spuščen je bil novembra 2013.

Šmartinsko jezero so ustvarili leta 1970. Dostopno je z več strani in se razprostira na 113 ha površine s čimer si lasti mesto med največjimi umetnimi jezeri v Sloveniji. Povprečna globina, ki je okoli 4 do 6 m, je bila izmerjena v okolici polotoka Brezova, v bližini brane ter zapornice pa je voda globoka med 8 ter 9 metrov, na določenih mestih tudi 10 m.

V jezeru plavajo krap, beli amur, sivi tolstolobik, linj, rdečeperka, rdečeoka, zelenika, ploščič, androga, som, smuč ter ščuka.

en.name: The lake Šmartinsko jezero
en.description:
The lake Šmartinsko jezero was created in 1970. It can be reached from various directions and spreads on 113 ha of water surfaces - that makes it one of the largest artificial lakes in Slovenia. The average depth is somewhere between 4 and 6m and it was measured in the vicinity of the peninsula Brezova. The water near the dam and the barrier is between 8 and 9m deep.

The lake is home to carps, white grass carps, grey silver carps, tenches, common rudds, roaches, bleaks, common breams, silver breams, catfish, zanders and pikes.

name: Potok Tesnica
description:
Potok Tesnica teče mimo Frankolovega in se pri Vojniku zlije v Hudinjo. Vsem navdušencem muharjenja potok predstavlja poseben izziv, ravno zaradi svoje majhnosti in v njem plavajočih potočnih postrvi, ki so izredno plašne. Zaradi okolja je muharjenje na daljavo po večini nemogoče in je to še dodaten izziv za prijem.

Manjše potočnice vas znajo prijetno presenetiti s številnimi prijemi in ni izključeno, da vas ne preseneti kakšna večja...

en.name: The creek Tesnica
en.description:
The creek Tesnica runs by Frankolovo and flows into the Hudinja in Vojnik. This creek is a special challange to all the fans of fly fishing due to its smallness and its brown trouts that are extremely timid. Fly fishing from distance is mainly impossible due to the environment and that fact represents yet another challenge.

Smaller brown trouts get hooked a lot but even some bigger ones can pleasently surprise you...

name: Tolminka
description: Reka Tolminka izvira v Pologu v dolini Tolminke, alpski dolini pod Bogatinom v Triglavskem narodnem parku. Tolminka je 10,2-kilometra dolga reka v Posočju, ki s svojo količino vode predstavlja enega glavnih vodotokov na Tolminskem. Pot proti Soči si je utrla skozi ozko dolino, včasih divjo sotesko, ki je najlepša v predelu znamenitih Tolminskih korit. Ko se Tolminka prebije skoznje, se spusti v Tolminsko kotlino, kjer se umiri in se pod Bučenico izlije v Sočo. V kratki dolžini se spreminjajo tudi značilnosti toka reke, ki je v zgornjem delu tipično visokogorski, v zadnjem delu pa se umiri, čeprav ima še vedno predalpske značilnosti. Tolminka ima ogromne zaloge kakovostne pitne vode, vendar ni namenjena vodooskrbi. Tolminka je ribolovna reka, le predel znamenitih naravnih Tolminskih korit je za ribolov zaprt. Tolminko naseljujejo vse vrste postrvi in glavač, v delu ob Tolminu pa je tudi veliko lipana, včasih tudi kakšen štrkavec.

en.name: The river Tolminka
en.subtitle: from the spring to the outflow
en.description: Its source is in the Polog mountain above the Tolminka valley, an alpine valley below Bogatin in the Triglav National Park. It is a 10.2-km long river flowing through the Soča valley with a large volume of water, making it one of the major rivers in the Tolmin area. It has carved its course towards the Soča through a narrow valley, which sometimes turns into a wild gorge and is at its most spectacular in the section of the famous Tolmin gorges. When it leaves the gorges, it enters the Tolmin basin where it slows down and flows into the Soča at the foot of the Bučenica hill. The course of the river keeps changing throughout its length. In its upper course, the river is a typical alpine river, while its lower course is calmer but its alpine characteristics still persist. It contains huge supplies of quality drinking water, but is not intended for water supply. The majority of the river is open to fishing, save for the section of the Tolmin gorges. The Tolminka is inhabited by all species of trout and Cottus gobio. When it reaches Tolmin, one can also encounter grayling and the occasional Adriatic chub.

Izvirnih 5,7-kilometra vode je rezervat in gojitvena voda za soško postrv, preostali del pa je ribolovna voda. Dolina, po kateri teče je ozka, a številna manjša prodišča omogočajo prehod ob globokih tolmunih in mimo kaskad in brzic. Je ena najlepših rek v RDT. Trebuščico naseljujejo vse vrste postrvi. Vanjo rade prihajajo na drst velike soške postrvi, lipan, glavač, v spodnjem delu pa tudi belice, predvsem mreniči, blistavci in štrkavci.

en.name: The creek Trebuščica
en.subtitle: from the bridge in Gorenja Trebuša to the outflow
en.description: Its source is at the foot of Mrzla Rupa and from there it covers 14 km before entering the Idrijca at the village of Trebuša. The upper stretch of the river - the first 5.7 km - is a reserve and is used as breeding waters for the marble trout. The remaining sections of the river are open to anglers. The valley through which it runs is narrow, but numerous smaller gravel deposits allow crossings near deep pools and past cascades and rapids. It is among the most beautiful rivers managed by RDT. The Trebuščica is inhabited by all species of trout. Large marble trout often enter it to spawn, as well as grayling and Cottus gobio. The lower stretches of the river are inhabited by Alburnus a. alborell, especially Barbus meridionalis caninus, Leuciscus souffia muticellus and Adriatic chub.

name: Učja
subtitle: od državne meje do izliva
description: Učja priteče iz Italije in do izliva v Sočo naredi 6,1-kilometra dolgo pot. Je hitra alpska reka, a zelo težko dostopna. Nekoliko lažje dostopna je le tik ob državni meji in v izlivnem delu pod vasjo Žaga. Učjo naseljujejo postrvi, glavač, v spodnjem toku tudi lipan.

index.name: Učja
index.subtitle: od državne meje do izliva

en.name: The river Učja
en.subtitle: from the state border with Italy to the outflow into the Soča
en.description: The Učja comes from Italy and covers a distance of 6.1 km before it enters the Soča. It is a swift alpine river, but very inaccessible. Access is somewhat easier only at the country border and near its confluence with the Soča, below the village of Žaga. Its waters are inhabited by trout and Cottus gobio, while in the downstream parts of the river, grayling can also be found.

name: Reka Unica - ciprinidni del
subtitle: od mostu v Lazah do ponikev
description: Spodnji odsek Unice je odličen revir za uživaški ribolov linjev, krapov in ščuk. Rečni okljuki in nedotaknjena okolica bodo ribiču pričarali vrhunsko ribiško izkušnjo!

name: Reka Unica - salmonidni del
subtitle: od izvira do mostu v Lazah
description: Kraški muharski revir svetovnega formata. Uživajte v ribolovu potočnih postrvi in lipanov. Velika raznovrstnost vodnih žuželk, enodnevnic, mladoletnic in prodnic, med katerimi si mnoge izbirajo na mikrolokacije omejen življenjski prostor, nudi muharju možnosti lova čez ves dan in s popolnoma različnimi muhami. Z vztrajnim izbiranjem najmanjših suhih muh je na Unici mogoče premamiti lipana tudi sredi poletne pripeke. Prijel bo na drobnega čarnika ali sivega romarja.

name: Vanganelsko jezero
description:
Vanganelsko jezero meri cca 2,5 ha in doseže globino 18 m, kjer kraljujejo veliki somi. Jezero je naseljeno s krapi, amurji, somi, ščukami, smuči, kleni in ostriži.

Iz Kopra se peljemo v smeri Pula. Na krožišču pri hipermarketu Mercator, zavijemo levo za Marezige. Po 4 km vožnje prispemo v naselje Vanganel. Samo še 500 m ceste v hrib in že smo pri čudovitem zajetju - Vanganelsko jezero.

en.name: The lake Vanganelsko jezero
en.description:
The Vanganelsko jezero measures approximately 2,5 ha and reaches the depth of 18 m and is home to some royal specimen of catfish. Carps, grass carps, catfish, pikes, zander, chubs and percoidei all live in it.

From Koper we drive in the direction of Pula. At the roundabout near the hypermarket Mercator we turn left in the direction of Marezige. After approximately 4 km we arrive to the settlement Vanganel. Then 500 more m up the hill and wee are there- the beautiful reservoir Vanganelsko jezero.

name: Velenjsko jezero
description: Jezero se nahaja v Šaleški dolini ob mestu Velenje in je nastalo kot posledica stoletne rudarske dejavnosti na tem območju. Voda v jezeru je izredno čista ter bogata z raznovrstnimi ribami. Pogosti so ulovi kapitalnih predatorjev (smuč, ščuka in som) in pa velikih divjih krapov.

en.name: The lake Velenjsko jezero
en.description: The lake is situated in the valley Šaleška dolina near the city of Velenje and was formed as a consequence of hundreds of years of coal mining in this area. The water in this lake is crystal clear and rich in various fish.The main catches are some first class predatory fish (zander, pike, catfish) and some huge wild carps.

name: Reka Vipava
subtitle: Od starega mostu v Vipavi do jezu pod Brjami
description: Revir predstavlja celoten tok reke Vipave s katerim upravlja RD Ajdovščina. Ta revir delimo na 2 dela, in sicer Vipava Muharski revir ter ciprinidni revir. V revirju najdemo skoraj vse vrste rib, od trofejnih soških postrvi in križancev, do potočne postrvi ter natur šarenke in lipanov. Od ciprinidov prevaladujejo štrkavci, mrene ter podusti pa tudi krapi in linji niso redki. V revirju je povsod tekoča voda bogata s tolmuni, prelivi in kaskadami. Ob vodi je bujno rastje, ki s svojo senco in vodnimi koreninami ustvarja naravno zavetje ribam. Okolica pa so v glavnem polja in travniki ter nekaj vinogradov.

index.name: Reka Vipava
index.subtitle: Od starega mostu v Vipavi do jezu pod Brjami

en.name: The river Vipava
en.subtitle: From the old bridge in Vipava to the dam in Brje
en.description: The district includes the whole current of the river Vipava, which is managed by the RD Ajdovščina. The district is further divided in to two subdistricts: Vipava fly fishing district and cyprinid district. All the fish species of our fishing environment can be found in this district : trophy marble trouts, hybrids, brown trouts, natural rainbow trouts and graylings. The dominating cyprinid species are European chubs, barbels and common nases but it is not uncommon to find some carps and tenches. Running waters with pools, channels and cascades prevail in all the district. Along the water the rich vegetation with its shadows and roots makes a natural haven for the fish. The district is surrounded mainly with fields, meadows and some wineyards.

name: Reka Vipava
subtitle: Od jezu v Kasovljah/Brje do otoka pod vasjo Selo).
description:
Revir je salmonidnega značaja. Je idealen revir za muharje, ki obožujejo ribolov lipana. Je lepo prehoden po vodi. V njem je prisotnih kar nekaj brzic in obrežnih tolmunčkov. Lovi se izključno po načinu ujemi & spusti s trnkom brez zalusti.

Idealen revir za vse ljubitelje muharjenja!

index.name: Reka Vipava
index.subtitle: Od jezu v Kasovljah/Brje do otoka pod vasjo Selo).

en.name: The river Vipava
en.subtitle: from the dam in Kasovlje/Brje to the island below the Selo village).
en.description:
This district spreads from the inflow of the old channel to the little river island in Batuje- just below the village of Preserje and is salmonid in character. It is an ideal district for fly fishermen who love the fishing for graylings. You can easily walk through water in this district and even meet some small rapids and hillside pools. You can only fish in catch&release style here with barbless hooks.

An ideal district for all fly fishing lovers!

name: Reka Vipava
subtitle: Od otoka pod vasjo Selo do železniškega mostu v Prvačini
description:
Revir poteka od otoka pod vasjo Selo do železniškega mostu v Prvačini in je salmonidnega značaja. Daljši in globlji tolmuni so idealni za domovanje velikih soških postrvi, medtem ko so plitvejši in hitrejši predeli poseljeni z lipani in šarenkami.

Predel tega revirja od železniškega mostu v Prvačini do jezu HE Gradišče je ribolov prepovedan – REZERVAT (drstišče divjega krapa).

Idealen revir za vse ljubitelje muharjenja na kapitalno ribo!

index.name: Reka Vipava
index.subtitle: Od otoka pod vasjo Selo do železniškega mostu v Prvačini

en.name: The river Vipava
en.subtitle: from the island below the Selo village to the railway bridge in Prvačina).
en.description:
The district spreads from the little river island in Batuje-just below the village of Preserje to the inflow of the creek Oševljek in Arčoni and is salmonid in character. Big and deep pools make an ideal home to large marble trouts, smaller and shallower ones are mostly home to graylings and rainbow trouts.

The part of the district from the bridge for Gradišče at sewage treatment in Prvačina to the inflow of the creek Oševljek is RESERVATION where fishing is forbidden except for fishing of catfish.

An ideal district for all fly fishing lovers who want to catch some first class fish!

name: Reka Vipava
subtitle: od jezu HE Gradišče do državne meje v Mirnu
description: Izrazito ciprinidni revir reke Vipave poteka od jezu HE Gradišče do državne meje v Mirnu. Revir zaznamujejo velike globine in umirjen tok. V njem imajo dom kapitalni somi, krapi, ščuke in podusti.

en.name: The river Vipava
en.subtitle: from the dam of the HPP Gradišče to the state border in Miren).
en.description: This part of the river Vipava is especially cyprinid and it spreads from the inflow of the creek Oševljek to the state border in Miren. The district is known for the great depths and slow current. It is home to some first class specimens of catfish,pikes and common nases.

subtitle: od mostu v Višnji gori do mostu Krška vas - Sinja gora
description: Potok Višnjica je na večjem delu toka ozka in precej zaraščena, tako da je ribolov na njej zahteva malo več znanja in potrpljenja. So pa tudi daljši pasovi, kjer je mogoče loviti postrvi in klene.

en.description: The creek Višnjica is mostly very narrow and covered in vegetation so the fishing demands more knowledge and patience. But there are some longer parts where it is possible to fish for trouts and chubs.

name: Reka Voglajna
subtitle: Od mostu Tratna do izliva v Savinjo
description: Reka Voglajna se steka iz Slivniškega jezera in se v svojem počasnem toku vije dolgih 35 km vse do izliva v Savinjo. V svojih številnih pritokih ter vijugah skriva veliko različnih vrst rib. Ribiči v Voglajni pogosto ujamejo: ameriški somič, androga, babuška, jez, klen, koreselj, krap, linj, mrena, ostriž, podust, pohra, rdečeoka, rdečeperka, ščuka, zelenika, pseudorazbora. Seveda ne manjkajo niti roparice: bolen, smuč, som in ščuka.

index.name: Reka Voglajna

en.name: The river Voglajna
en.subtitle: from the bridge Tratna to the outflow into the Savinja
en.description: The river Voglajna flows down from the lake Slivniško jezero and runs its 35km long journey to the outflow into the Savinja in a very slow current. Its many tributaries and windings hide many different fish species. Fishermen mostly catch following fish in the Voglajna: blue catfish, silver bream,gibel carp, ide, chub, crucian carp, carp, tench, barbel, perch, common nase, Mediterranean barbel, common rudd, common roach, bleak and stone moroko (topmouth gudgeon). You can find some predatory fish as well: asp, zander, catfish and pike.

name: Mrtvica Voglajne
subtitle: Od Prožniške vasi do izliva v Voglajno
description: Mrtvica reke Voglajne v Prožniški vasi nudi ribam iz reke obilo hrane in dobro skrivališče.

en.description: The Voglajna's backwaters in Prožniška vas offer plenty of food and good hiding places for the fish from the river.

name: Vogršček 4 - veliko jezero
description:
Vogršček - veliko jezero - se nahaja na levi strani avtoceste smer Ajdovščina - Nova Gorica.

Vogršček je akumulacijsko jezero, ki meri v dolžino približno 4 km, nahaja se pa v bližini Šempasa. Nastalo je leta 1988 za namene namakanja Vipavske doline ter žaščito pred visokimi vodami. Zaradi dobrih pogojev (višje temperature) in konstantnega vlaganja pa je jezero polno velikih in borbenih rib, kot so: krapi, ščuke in linji.

Vabljeni vsi, ki hočejo preiskusiti svoje ribiške veščine v lepi naravi in družbi prijaznih domačinov.

en.name: The reservoir Vogršček-the big lake
en.description:
The lake Vogršček is approximately 4km long reservoir situated near Šempas. It was made in 1988 for the needs of irrigation of the valley Vipavska dolina and for protection from the high waters.Due to excellent conditions (higher temperatures) and constant putting in of fish the lake is full of large and feisty fish:carps, pikes and tenches. You can find the lake on the left side of the highway Ajdovščina-Nova Gorica.

All of you, who want to test your fishing skills in beautiful nature and in company of friendly locals, are most welcome.

name: Vogršček 5 - srednje jezero
description:
Vogršček - srednje jezero se nahaja na desni strani avtoceste smer Ajdovščina - Nova Gorica. Je revir v katerem velikokrat potekajo tudi tekmovanja v ribolovu s plovcem, saj se v njem nahajajo borbeni krapi in veliko belice.

Celoten Vogršček je akumulacijsko jezero, ki meri v dolžino približno 4 km, nahaja se pa v bližini Šempasa. Nastalo je leta 1988 za namene namakanja Vipavske doline ter žaščito pred visokimi vodami. Zaradi dobrih pogojev (višje temperature) in konstantnega vlaganja pa je jezero polno velikih in borbenih rib, ko so: krapi, ščuke in linji.

en.name: The reservoir Vogršček-the middle lake
en.description:
The lake Vogršček is approximately 4km long reservoir situated near Šempas. It was made in 1988 for the needs of irrigation of the valley Vipavska dolina and for protection from the high waters.Due to excellent conditions (higher temperatures) and constant putting in of fish the lake is full of large and feisty fish:carps, pikes and tenches. You can find the lake on the left side of the highway Ajdovščina-Nova Gorica.

The reservoir Vogršček-the middle lake- is situated on the right side of the highway Ajdovščina- Nova Gorica. It is the district where the competitions in float fishing often take place due to some feisty carps and whitefish that live in it.

name: Vogršček 6 - malo jezero
description:
Vogršček - malo jezero je manjša akumulacija, v katerem se nahaja veliko drobiža nekaj krapov in prav tako ščuk. Nahaja se na desni strani avtoceste in je drugi po vrsti smer Ajdovščina - Nova Gorica (manjši ribnik).

Celoten Vogršček je akumulacijsko jezero, ki meri v dolžino približno 4 km, nahaja se pa v bližini Šempasa. Nastalo je leta 1988 za namene namakanja Vipavske doline ter žaščito pred visokimi vodami. Zaradi dobrih pogojev (višje temperature) in konstantnega vlaganja pa je jezero polno velikih in borbenih rib.

en.name: The reservoir Vogršček-the little lake
en.description:
The lake Vogršček is approximately 4km long reservoir situated near Šempas. It was made in 1988 for the needs of irrigation of the valley Vipavska dolina and for protection from the high waters.Due to excellent conditions (higher temperatures) and constant putting in of fish the lake is full of large and feisty fish:carps, pikes and tenches. You can find the lake on the left side of the highway Ajdovščina-Nova Gorica.

The reservoir Vogršček-the little lake is a small reservoir that is home to large numbers of smallfish, some carps and also some pikes. It is situated on the right side of the highway Ajdovščina-Nova Gorica (smaller pond).

name: Zadrževalnik Srednja Vas
description: Jezerce je umetnega nastanka in služi kot zadrževalnik hudourniških voda potoka Olševnica. Sam zadrževalnik ima dva dela in sicer mali zadrževalnik, kjer je ribolov mogoč, sledi pa mu večji zadrževalnik, ki služi kot ponikalnica. Ker je jezero majhno je v njem mogoč le ribolov "Ujemi in spusti". Ker je okolica urejena tudi z lepimi in vzdrževanimi potmi je ribnik primeren predvsem za mlajše ribiče in ribiče invalide, pa tudi ostali boste ob pogostih prijemih uživali v ribolovu. V njem se nahajajo predvsem krapi, nekaj klenov, ujame pa se tudi kakšna postrv.

en.name: The reservoir Srednja Vas
en.description: This little lake is of artificial origin and works as a reservoir of the torrent waters of the Olševnica creek. The reservoir itself is built from two parts: the lttle reservoir, where it is possible to fish and the big reservoir which is in fact a subterranean river. Due to the smallness of the lake only " catch and release" is possible. The surroundings are very nicely designed with many walking paths- the pond is an ideal place for younger fishermen or for fishermen with disabilities, but the rest of you will also enjoy fishing very much, because the fish bite here. The pond is home mostly for the carps, some chubs and even some trout.

name: Potok Želimeljščica
subtitle: od domačije Žumer pod Turjaškim gradom do izliva v Iščico
description: Vas zanima kje loviti? Katere muhe so najbolj uspešne? Kje pustiti avto? Kliknite tukaj in preberite brezplačen vodič po potoku Želimeljščica. Želimeljščica je čudovit potok, ki izvira pod Turjakom, nekdanjim sedežem plemiške rodbine Auersperg, ter se na barju izliva v Iščico. Na Želimeljščici najlepše lovimo zgodaj spomladi, ko je voda malce napeta in obrežje še ni preveč zaraščeno. Ujamemo domorodne potočne postrvi, redkejše lipane, šarenke in borbene klene. Ribolov na Želimeljščici je zelo zahteven, zato ga predlagamo le najbolj izkušenim ribičem. Pozor: območje medveda!

index.name: Potok Želimeljščica
index.subtitle: od domačije Žumer pod Turjaškim gradom do izliva v Iščico

en.name: The creek Želimeljščica
en.subtitle: from the homestead Žumer under the castle Turjaški grad to the outflow into the Iščica
en.description: The Želimeljščica is a wonderful creek that springs under the castle Turjak, where the noble family Auersperg once lived and then flows into the Iščica in the bog. Early spring is the most beautiful time to fish on the Želimeljščica when the waters are stil snowy and the hills are not yet grown in by the river vegetation. You can catch some indigenous brown trouts, big rainbow trouts and feisty chubs. Fishing on Želimeljščica is extremely demanding, so we suggest it only to the most experienced fishermen. Warning: active bear area!

name: Ribnik Žeje
description:
Ribniki so na lepi lokaciji v vznožju vasice Žeje tik ob gorenjski avtocesti. Pestrost vrst rib omogoča vsakemu ribiču nekaj nepozabnih užitkov z možnostju ulova tudi kapitalnih primerkov. Teren je primeren in dostopen prav za vsakega ribiča in omogoča tudi družinskim članom sprostitev s sprehodom ali otrokom veselje na igralih. Med ribolovom si žejo in lakoto lahko potešite v ribiškem domu po ugodnih cenah. Ob ribniku je možen najem prostora za piknik ali postavitve šotora za prenočitev.

Obiščite nas, ne bo vam žal in radi se boste vrnili.

en.name: The pond Žeje
en.description:
The ponds are situated on nice location at the base of the little village called Žeje, very near the highway across Gorenjska region. Variety in fish species guarantees some unforgettable moments of joy for every fisherman - even with a possibility to catch some first class specimens. The terrain is accessible and appropriate for any fisherman and also enables relaxation time for family members with long walks and for the children with multiple toys on the playground. When you fish, you can sate your hunger and drown your thirst in the fishing lodge; the price are very reasonable. You can also rent a place near the pond for picnics or place a tent to stay over night.

Visit us, you won't be sorry and you will sure return!

name: Rudniško
subtitle: Kočevsko) jezero
description: Rudniško jezero, tudi Kočevsko jezero, se nahaja na Kočevskem polju, v severovzhodnem delu Kočevja, ob predelu Trata, Rudnik in naselju Šalka vas. Nastalo na dnu rudniške kotanje, v kateri so z dnevnim kopom izkoriščali rjavi premog. V času delovanja rudnika je v kotanjo pritekal Rudniški potok, polnil je dve večji luži, katerih vodo pa so v času obratovanja rudnika prečrpavali in jo uporabljali pri separaciji premoga. Vodo so po velikih ceveh odvajali v bližnjo reko Rinžo. Leta 1978 se je delo v rudniku prenehalo, voda pa je polagoma napolnila kotanjo. Jezero je globoko do 40 m, njegova površina je okrog 1,5 km2, obala pa meri okrog 3 km. Okoli jezera je speljana naravoslovna učna pot. Jezero danes ponuja številne rekreacijske možnosti, čolnarjenje, plavanje, potapljanje, ter pozimi drsanje. Leta 1989 je Ribiška družina Kočevje začela v jezero vlagati večje količine rib, veliko iz reke Rinže, v letu 2003 pa tudi iz Reškega jezera. V jezeru so kleni, linji, krapi, somi, rdečeperke, ščuke, amurji, idr.

name: Reka Sava
subtitle: od izliva Tržiške Bistrice do jezu pri Tekstilindusu - Aquasavi, vključno z Majdičevim kanalom
description:
Izjemno lepa narava s čisto vodo, ki je sicer na nekaterih delih malce težje dostopna. Voda je izredno bogata s salmonidnimi vrstami. V revirju se je leta 2012 odvijalo svetovno prvenstvo v muharjenju.

Voda je namenjena športnemu ribolovu in je izrazito salmonidna. Poseljujejo jo potočna postrv, šarenka in lipan. V revirju kraljujejo kapitalni sulci.

Poleg bogate in čiste vode, pestre in lepe pokrajine je ta revir primeren za vse vrste ribičev. Dostopen je tako z leve kot z desne strani struge. Izjemen je "kanjon", kjer velike skale spreminjajo tok reke in omogočajo še pestrejši ribolov.

Vse ljubitelje športnega ribolova vabimo, da obiščejo naš revir na reki Savi in se sami prepričajo o lepotah, ki jih nudijo vode, s katerimi upravlja Ribiška družina Tržič. Vsem obiskovalcem želimo dober prijem in mnogo prijetnih trenutkov v našem okolišu.

en.name: The river Sava
en.subtitle: from the outflow of the Tržiška Bistrica to the dam at Tekstilindus - Aquasava, including the Majdič's channel
en.description:
The nature is beautiful and the water is clean and hard to access in some areas. The water is rich in salmonids and in 2012 the world championship in fly fishing took place in this district.

The water is meant for sports fishing and is extremely salmonid in character - here live brown trouts, rainbow trouts and graylings and in the district you can find some first class specimen of huchen.

Besides the rich and clean water, vivid and beautiful nature this district offers challanges for all types of fishermen. It can be reached from the right or the left side of the channel. The most extraordinary place is the "canyon" where big rocks change the course of the river and enable even more varied fishing.

All the fans of recreative fishing are invited to visit our district on the Sava to make sure of its beauty of waters managed by the RD Tržič. We wish you all a good catch and many pleasant moments while visiting us.

name: Tržiška Bistrica
subtitle: s pritokom Mošenik
description:
Vas zanima kje loviti? Kje pustiti avto? Kakšno muho potrebujete? Kliknite tukaj in preberite brezplačen vodič po Tržiški Bistrici. Od Jelendola do Tržiča teče Bistrica večinoma po kanjonu skozi znano "Dovžanovo sotesko". Od Tržiča do izliva v reko Savo pa je tok mirnejši v pravi rečni strugi z večimi jezovi in pragovi, ki popestrijo ribolov.

Vsi pritoki Tržiške Bistrice, razen potoka Mošenik, so gojitveni potoki. Gojitveni rezervati so tudi vsi vodni kanali in grape. Del pritokov nad Jelendolom ima gensko čisto potočno postrv, ki sicer na tem delu ni lovna.

Revir je loven od mostu pri športnem igrišču v Jelendolu do izliva v Savo.

Si želite muhariti v idiličnem okolju in bogati reki s salmonidi? Izberite TRŽIŠKO BISTRICO - ne bo vam žal!

index.name: Tržiška Bistrica
index.subtitle: s pritokom Mošenik

en.name: The Tržiška Bistrica
en.subtitle: the chine Dovžanova soteska
en.description:
Do you want to know where to fish? Where to leave your car? What kind of a fly do you need? Just click here and read for free the guide for the river Tržiška Bistrica. From Jelendol to Tržič the Bistrica runs mostly through the canyon well known as "Dovžanova soteska". The current steadies itself from Tržič to the outflow into the Sava with bigger dams and thresholds that make fishing even more interesting.

The Mošenik and all other tributaries of the Tržiška Bistrica are breeding streams. All the water canals and ravines are also breeding reservations. In number of tributaries above Jelendol live genetically clean brown trouts but you cannot fish for them here.

In this district you can fish from the bridge at the playground in Jelendol to the outflow into the Sava.

Do you want to fly fish in an idyllic environment and on the river rich in salmonids? Choose tTHE TRŽIŠKA BISTRICA - you won't be sorry!
